name: Rum & Grapeshot
description: Roll the distance for Stumbling Drunk before the direction is chosen with the feat. There is no range to Rum & Grapeshot, it effects the whole play area.

name: Structure base size
description: A structure uses its printed base size for volume and drawing LOS. If it has no base, such as a targetable piece of terrain, it is considered to have a 120mm base.

name: Blessing of the Gods
description: Play this card any time during your activation on one of your models. That model’s weapons gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical this activation.

name: Break Through
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models/units. Those models gain Unstoppable this activation.

name: Careful Reconnaissance
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models/units. Those models gain Pathfinder this activation.

name: Defenses
description: Play this card at the start of the game after turn order has been determined and standard terrain and objectives have been placed for the scenario, but before deploying models. If you are the first player, you can place up to two Defenses. If you are the second player, you can place up to three Defenses. If both players play the Defenses Command Card, take turns placing Defenses starting with the second player. A player can only place Defenses within 24" of the rear edge of their Deployment Zone. Additionally, Defenses cannot be placed at the start of the game within 3" of an objective, obstruction, obstacle, or another Defense terrain feature.

name: Duck and Cover!
description: Play this card at any time during the activation of one of your warrior units. Those models gain cover and Resistance: Blast for one round.

name: Hit & Run
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models. That model gains Reposition [3"] this activation. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Lucky Penny
description: Play this card at the start of a friendly model’s activation to give that model one corpse token, essence point, focus point, fury point, rage token, or soul token.

name: Old Faithful
description: Play this card during your Control Phase before allocating focus. Remove d3+1 damage from a friendly Cohort model or battle engine in your army.

name: Put the Fires Out
description: Play this card at the start of your Maintenance Phase on one of your model/units. If the affected models were knocked down, they stand up. If the affected models were stationary, the stationary status expires. If the affected models were suffering continuous or shakable effects, like Blind or Shadow Bind, those effects expire.

name: Sapper
description: Play this card at any time during your turn. Immediately remove a Defense from the table.

name: Heavy Airdrop
description:
Starting on round two, you can play this card any time during the activation of one of your Gravedigger models/units. When you play this card, choose whether to airdrop either a Heavy Weapon Crate or a Squad Class light warjack (Blocker, Raider, or Skirmisher). Add the selected model to your army.

Place the airdropped model 1" away from the model/unit this card was played on.

You can only choose to airdrop a Squad Class light warjack if you played this card on a Gravedigger model/unit with 'Jack Marshal that is not already controlling warjack. The warjack is considered to be controlled by the model/unit this card was played on. An airdropped warjack must forfeit its Normal Movement or Combat Action the turn it enters play.

name: Light Airdrop
description:
Starting on round two, you can play this card any time during the activation of one of your Gravedigger models/units. When you play this card, choose one of the activating models and whether to drop an Ammo Crate, Fuel Canister, Mantlet, or a Medical Crate. Add the selected defense or model to your army.

Place the airdropped model within 1" away from the chosen activating model.

name: Military Engineering
description: Play this card at any time during your turn. When you play this card, you can choose to either immediately remove a Defense from the table or to cause a friendly warrior model to become Dug In. (A model with Dig In gains cover, gains Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged.)

name: Accursed
description: Play this card on a friendly Grymkin warlock during its activation. While in the Grymkin warlock’s control range, enemy models lose Incorporeal, Tough, and Undead, and cannot have damage removed from them. Additionally, enemy non-warbeast models lose Construct while in the Grymkin warlock’s control range. If your leader is The King of Nothing, while within his control range friendly Grymkin model’s weapons gain Blessed. Accursed lasts for one round.

name: Fortune’s Path
description: Play this card on a friendly Grymkin warlock during its activation. Friendly Grymkin models gain +1 to attack and damage rolls against enemy  models in the Grymkin warlocks control range. If your Leader is The Heretic, increase the bonus to +2. Fortune’s Path lasts for one round.

name: Ill Omens
description: Play this card on a friendly Grymkin warlock during its activation. While in the Grymkin warlock’s control range, enemy models suffer –1 attack and damage rolls agaisnt friendly Faction models. If your Leader is The Dreamer, models in her battlegroup also gain Dodge. Ill Omens lasts for one round. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

name: Labyrinth
description: Play this card on a friendly Grymkin warlock during its activation. Enemy models starting their activation in the Grymkin warlock’s control range suffer –2 SPD that activation. If your Leader is the Wanderer you can also immediately place one model in his battlegroup completely within 3" of its current location.

name: Ruin
description: Play this card on a friendly Grymkin warlock during its activation. Once during the round, when an enemy model casts a spell while in the Grymkin warlock’s control range, you may choose for that spell to not take effect. The spell is still considered to have been cast and its COST remains spent. Additionally, all enemy upkeep spells in the Grymkin warlock’s control range expire. If your leader is The Child she gains 1 fury. Ruin lasts for one round.

name: Sacrifice
description: Play this card on a friendly Grymkin warlock during its activation. Once during the round, when a friendly Grymkin warlock is damaged by an enemy attack. After the attack is resolved, remove all damage from friendly Grymkin models in the warlock's control range. Sacrifice lasts for one round.

name: Shroud
description: Play this card on a friendly Grymkin warlock during its activation. While in the Grymkin warlock’s control range, friendly Grymkin models gain Stealth. Shroud lasts for one round.

name: For the Motherland
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your warrior models/units. Those models gain Tough for one round.

name: Castle
description: Play this card at any time during your activation. Your Leader can immediately advance up to 5" but cannot end this movement closer to an enemy model than it started.

name: Invisibility
description: Play this card at any time during your turn. Choose one friendly model. That model cannot be targeted by ranged attacks for one round

name: Plunder
description: Play this card after destroying the last model in a unit. The attacking model can immediately advance up to 2". Receive 1 additional War Chest point at the end of this match.

name: REVERSE TACTICS
description: Play this card at the start of the activation of one of your models/units. During that activation, the model/unit can make its Combat Action before its Normal Movement.

name: REVIVIFICATION
description: Play this card at any time during your turn to return one destroyed Grunt to its unit. The Grunt returns with all of its damage boxes unmarked. Place the returned Grunt within 2" of another model in its unit. The returned Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn it is returned to play.

name: Overwatch
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models/units. Those models gain Sentry Fire for one round. (Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement or is placed within 8" of a model with Sentry Fire, the model with Sentry Fire can immediately make one basic ranged attack targeting the enemy model.)

name: Cryxian Monstrosity
description:
This model is a monstrosity that can be included in a Cryxian warcaster's battlegroup. A Cryxian warcaster can allocate focus points to this model as if it was a warjack. If this model's warcaster is destroyed or removed from the table, it becomes autonomous. A Cryxian warcaster can take control of an autonomous friendly Cryxian monstrosity. To do this, a Cryxian warcaster must spend 1 focus point during its activation while B2B with the autonomous Cryxian monstrosity. The monstrosity must forfeit its Combat Action the turn it becomes controlled. The monstrosity becomes a part of the battlegroup of the warcaster that took control of it.

At any time during its activation, a Cryxian warcaster can spend focus points to heal damage a monstrosity in its battlegroup in its control range has suffered. For each focus point spent this way, remove 1 damage point.

name: Crater
description:
This terrain feature is rough terrain.

A model completely within the area of this terrain feature has cover from attacks made by models that are not within the area of the same terrain feature. Models completely within this terrain feature do not suffer blast damage unless the origin of the damage is centered in the area of the same terrain feature. When drawing line of sight to a model not completely within a crater terrain feature, ignore models that are completely within a crater, open grave template, or one or more trench templates.

name: Forests
description:
This terrain feature is rough terrain and provides concealment to a model completely inside its area.

When drawing line of sight to or from a point to or from a point within a forest terrain feature, the line of sight can pass through up to 3" of the forest without being blocked; anything more blocks it. When a model outside a forest attempts to draw line of sight to another point also outside that forest, the forest blocks line of sight to anything beyond it. Thus, a model can see 3" into or out of a forest but not completely through one regardless of how thick it is. 

Forest do not block line of sight to huge-based models.

name: Orgoth Monstrosity
description:
This model is a monstrosity that can be included in any Orgoth warcaster's battlegroup. An Orgoth warcaster can allocate focus points to this model as if it was a warjack. If this model's warcaster is destroyed or removed from the table, it becomes autonomous. An Orgoth warcaster can take control of an autonomous friendly Orgoth monstrosity. To do this, an Orgoth warcaster must spend 1 focus point during its activation while B2B with the autonomous Orgoth monstrosity. The monstrosity must forfeit its Combat Action the turn it becomes controlled. The monstrosity becomes a part of the battlegroup of the warcaster that took control of it.

At any time during its activation, an Orgoth warcaster can spend focus points to heal damage a monstrosity in its battlegroup in its control range has suffered. For each focus point spent this way, remove 1 damage point.

description: This model gains +2 to its attack rolls.

name: •Dopamine Boost
description: This model gains Overtake, and Swift Hunter. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".) (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

description: When a frienly model with 5" of this model or Gallant is destroyed or removed from play by an enemy attack, this model gains a power token. This model can have up to three power tokens at any time. This model can spend power tokens for the following:

name: •Free Spell
description: This model immediatly casts a spell without spending focus.

name: •Divinly Inspired
description: This model gains Divine Inspiration. (a model with Divine Inspiration gains an addtional die on melee attack and damage rolls. Discard the lowest dice of each roll.)

name: Morrow's Support
description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly model with one of this model's upkeep spells, this model gains +2 to melee attack damage rolls.

name: Divine Bulwark
description: During your control phase, this model gains 1 focus point for each enemy model within 5 of it.

name: Morrow's Strength
description: If this model is within its battlegroup controler's control range, it can spend power tokens on that model for the following:

name: •Morrowan Fleet
description: During its activation, this model can spend a power token to gain +2 SPD and Flight for one turn.

name: •Reverse Thrusters
description: During it's activation, this model can spend a power token to gain Reposition [5"] for one turn.

name: •Morrow's Anchor

name: Morrow's Gang

name: Shield Guard

That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. name: •Reloader (★ Action)
description: During its Combat Action this turn, this model’s warcaster can make one additional ranged attack.

name: •Spyglass (★ Action)
description: Target an enemy model in this model’s LOS. That model loses Stealth for one round.

name: Defenses
description: A Defense is removed from the table if it is contacted by a model with an extra-large or huge base.

name: Obstacle
description: This terrain feature is an obstacle.

name: Barrier
description: When a large- or smaller-based model without Flight or Pathfinder attempts to cross this terrain feature, reduce the distance the model moves by 2".

name: Cover
description: This terrain feature grants cover.

name: Barrier
description: A Barrier is 4" in length, 1/2" wide, and 3/4" tall.

name: Fire Hazard
description: This terrain feature is a hazard. A model without Flight entering the area of this terrain feature suffers the Fire continuous effect. If a trooper model without Flight advances through the area of this terrain as part of its unit’s Normal Movement, all models in the unit suffer the fire continuous effect.

name: Illumination
description: Models lose Stealth while within 5" of this terrain feature.

name: Exploding!
description: This terrain feature explodes and is removed from play if an extra-large or huge-based model contacts it. This terrain feature also explodes if a model contacts it as a result of slam or throw movement. This terrain feature explodes immediately after a Throw targeting it has been resolved. This terrain feature explodes if an attack targeting it results in a critical hit. When this terrain feature explodes, all models within 2" of it suffer a POW 15 blast damage roll, and this terrain feature is removed from the table.

name: Targetable
description: This terrain feature can be targeted by basic ranged and melee attacks as a small-based model. This terrain feature can be targeted by attacks made by either player’s models.  This terrain feature does not suffer damage or any other effects from attacks targeting it.

name: Throwable
description: Medium-based and larger models with the Throw Power Attack weapon quality can target this terrain feature with Throw Power Attacks. This terrain feature is automatically hit by the attack. For the purposes of resolving a throw, this terrain feature is considered to be a medium-based model. This terrain feature is moved 2 additional inches when thrown. A model hit by this terrain feature when it is thrown suffers collateral damage normally.

name: Demolition
description: A medium-based and larger models with the Throw Power Attack weapon quality within 1" of this terrain feature can make a Demolition (★ Action) special action during its activation. When it does so remove this terrain feature and another Defense within 10" of it from the table.

name: Spike Hazard
description: This terrain feature is a hazard. An enemy model without Flight entering or ending its activation within 1" of this terrain feature suffers a POW 10 damage roll. If an enemy warjack without Flight enters this terrain feature, in addition to the POW 10 damage roll, the warjack also suffers 1 damage point to its first available Movement System box. Your models do not suffer damage from these terrain features if you placed them.

name: Rough Terrain
description: This terrain feature is rough terrain.

name: Spike Trap
description: A Spike Trap's dimensions are 50mm square area terrain.

name: Auto-Repair
description: During your Control Phase, remove d3 damage points from this model.

name: Flying High
description: Ranged attacks targeting this model suffer –3 RNG. Friendly models can advance through this model if they have enough movement to move completely past its base. This model loses Flying High if it loses Flight.

name: Propelled
description: This model cannot aim, charge, or become knocked down.

name: Shooting Gallery
description: This model gains +2 to ranged attack rolls against models within 5" of it.

name: Reposition [5"]
description: At the end of this model/unit’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, this model can advance up to 5", then its activation ends.

name: Magic Ability
description: Performing a Magic Ability special action or special attack counts as casting a spell.

name: •Puppet Master (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly model/unit. If the target model/unit is in range, you can have one affected model reroll one attack or damage roll, then Puppet Master expires. Puppet Master lasts for one round.

name: •Spell Slave (★Action or ★Attack)
description: This model must be in its Leader’s control range to make the Spell Slave special action. When it does, it casts one of the spells on its Leader’s card with a COST of 3 or less. This model cannot cast upkeep spells or spells with a RNG of SELF or CTRL. When casting an offensive spell, Spell Slave is an arcane attack.

name: •Marionette (★Attack)
description: Marionette is a RNG 10 arcane attack. Target enemy model/unit. You can have one affected model reroll one attack or damage roll, then Marionette expires. Marionette lasts for one round.

name: Battle Wizard
description: Once per turn, when this model destroys or removes from play one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved it can make one Magic Ability special attack or special action.

name: Jump
description: After it makes a full advance during its Normal Movement but before it performs its Combat Action, you can place this model anywhere completely within 5" of its current location.

name: Prey
description: After deployment but before the first player’s turn, choose an enemy model/unit to be this model/unit’s prey. This model gains +2 to attack and damage rolls against its prey. When the prey is destroyed or removed from play, choose another model/unit to be the prey.

name: Swift Hunter
description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".

name: Treewalker
description: This model ignores forests when determining LOS. While completely within a forest, this model gains +2 DEF against melee attack rolls.

name: Inhuman Resolve
description: When a friendly warrior model within 10" of this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved this model can remove 1 damage point. When this model is disabled, it becomes knocked down instead of becoming boxed and its activation immediately ends. While this model is disabled, it cannot activate. If this model is disabled at the beginning of your Maintenance Phase, it is destroyed.

name: Force Barrier
description: This model gains +2 DEF against ranged attack rolls and gains Resistance: Blast.

name: Shout it Out (★ Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Force Barrier for one round. (A model with Force Barrier gains +2 DEF against ranged attack rolls and gains Resistance: Blast.)

name: Path of Flames
description: During its activation, this model can forfeit its Normal Movement to use Path of Flames. If it does, place this model anywhere completely within 8" of its current location. Other models within 2" of this model after it is placed immediately suffer a POW 13 fire damage roll.

name: Hyper-Regeneration
description: Remove d3 damage points from this model at the start of each of its activations.

name: It Burns!
description: If this model is hit by a melee attack, immediately after the attack is resolved the attacking model suffers the Fire continuous unless this model was destroyed or removed from play by the attack.

name: Destructive Power
description: During its activation, this model can suffer 1 damage point to boost an attack or damage roll. This damage is suffered immediately after the attack is resolved.

name: Body Snatcher: Grave Robber [10"]
description: When a living or undead model is destroyed while within 10" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model's corpse token. This model can have up to five corpse tokens at any time. This model can spend corpse tokens for the following:

name: •Death Howler
description: At any time during its activation, this model can spend one corpse token to gain Mortal Fear. Death Howler lasts for one round. (While within 8" of a model with Mortal Fear, living enemy models suffer –2 to damage rolls.)

name: •Shadow Gate
description: Once per turn during its activation immediately after resolving an attack in which it hit an enemy model with a melee attack, this model can spend 1 corpse or soul token to be placed completely within 2" of its current location.

name: Divine Manifestation
description: This model is not a living model, cannot become knocked down, and never suffers Blind. Opponents cannot take control of this model.

name: •Meat for the Beast
description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend corpse tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.

name: Blinding Radiance
description: While within 3" of this model, enemy models suffer –2 to attack rolls.

name: Divine Inspiration
description: This model gains an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls. Discard the lowest die of each roll.

name: Soul Ward
description: Enemy models cannot gain soul tokens from friendly models destroyed within 6" of this model.

name: Veteran Leader [Morrowan]
description: While within 10" of this model, other Morrowan models gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: Ashen Veil
description: This model has concealment. Living enemy models without Resistance: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls while within 2" of this model.

name: Righteous Fury
description: When one or more friendly Faction warrior models are destroyed by an enemy attack while within 10" of this model, this model gains +2 ARM and +2 to its melee attack damage rolls for one round.

name: Righteous Vengeance
description: If one or more friendly Faction warrior models were destroyed or removed from play by enemy attacks while within 5" of this model during the last round, during your Maintenance Phase this model  can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.

name: Beloved of Thamar
description: When a friendly Thamarite model within 10" of this model misses an attack roll, it can reroll that attack roll. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Beloved of Thamar.

name: True Sight
description: This model ignores cloud effects when determining LOS. This model also ignores Stealth.

name: Dark Shroud
description: While within 2" of this model, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.

name: Entropic Force
description: While within 5" of this model, enemy models lose Tough and cannot have damage removed from them.

name: Soul Taker: Spectral Scavenger
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living model is destroyed in this model’s control range, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

name: •Strength of Death
description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend soul tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.

name: •Soul Phase
description: This model can spend a soul token at any time during its activation to gain Incorporeal for one turn.

name: Void Walk
description: Once per activation, immediately after resolving an attack in which it destroyed a living or undead enemy model with an attack during its Combat Action, you can place this model anywhere completely within 8" of its current location.

name: Mother’s Embrace
description: When a friendly model is destroyed by an enemy attack while within 10" of this model, after the attack is resolved you can remove d3 damage points from a friendly model.

name: Shepherd’s Call (★Action)
description:
Remove up to 1 fury point from each friendly living Faction warbeast currently within 3" of this
model.

name: Threads of Life
description: Once per turn, when another friendly living non-Leader Faction warrior model within 10" of this model is hit by an attack, this model can suffer d3 damage points to use Threads of Life. If it does so, the friendly model does not suffer a damage roll from the attack.

name: Shield Wall
description: While this model is B2B with one or more models in its unit, it gains +2 ARM and cannot be knocked down.

name: Granted: Divine Inspiration
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Divine Inspiration. (A model with Divine Inspiration gains an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls. Discard the lowest die of each roll.)

name: Granted: Inspiration
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: Granted: Rise
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit that are knocked down at the beginning of your Maintenance Phase stand up.

name: Bond [Caine]
description: If Ace begins the game in Caine's’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Ace is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. Each time Ace makes a Rune Shot Cannon ranged attack while bonded to Caine and in his control range, choose one of the following special rules:

name: •Shadow Fire
description: A model hit with this attack does not block LOS for one turn.

name: •Thunderbolt
description: Enemy models hit are pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model. On a critical hit, the enemy model becomes knocked down after being pushed.

name: •Ricochet
description: When this model directly hits an enemy model with an attack with this weapon, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can make another ranged attack with this weapon targeting another model within 4" of the model originally hit, ignoring LOS and this weapon’s RNG. Attacks gained from Ricochet cannot generate additional attacks from Ricochet.

name: Prowl
description: While this model has concealment, it gains Stealth.

name: Tried & True
description: When this model is affected by a Repair special action, remove 1 additional damage point from it.

name: Shield Guard
description: When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.

name: Heavy Boiler
description: This model gains +2 SPD when running.

name: Crane
description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can choose one other friendly large-based or smaller model within 2" of it. You can place that model anywhere completely within 2" of its current location, and if it is knocked down, it immediately stands up. A model can only be placed once per turn as a result of Crane.

name: Mind Thief
description: When this model hits an enemy model with an attack, it gains a Mind Token. This model can spend mind tokens for the following effects;

name: •Mind Expansion
description: This model may immediately cast a spell it has not already cast this tun.

name: •Fortified Mind
description: This models next attack and damage roll are boosted.

name: •Mind Shift
description: once per turn this model can be placed completely within 5" of its current location

name: •Psychic Assault (★Attack)
description: Psychic Assault is a RNG SP 8, POW 12 arcane attack. This attack ignores LOS.

name: •Mind Bomb (★Attack)
description: Mind Bomb is a RNG 10, POW 10 arcane attack. when this attack boxes a living or undead model, you can immediately take control of it and make a 3" advance, enemy models within 2" take a POW 10 magical blast damage roll, the boxed model is then destroyed and removed from play.

name: •Ghost Walk (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Ghostly for one turn. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

name: Long Shadows
description: When one or more living enemy models are destroyed by an arcane attack while in this model’s control range, this model gains one focus or fury point.

name: Mage Static
description: Spells cast by enemy models within 10" of this model suffer +1 COST and –3 RNG.

name: Telemetry
description: Other friendly Faction models gain +2 to arcane attack rolls against enemy models within 8" of this model.

name: •Tune Up (★ Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction Cohort model. If the Cohort model is in range, it immediately stands up and is no longer stationary, continuous effects on the model expire, and it gains Pathfinder for one turn.

name: Reposition [3"]
description: At the end of this model/unit’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, this model can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.

name: Defensive Line
description: While this model is B2B with one or more models in its unit, it gains +2 DEF and cannot become knocked down.

name: Defensive Line
description: While this model is B2B with one or more models in its unit, it gains +2 DEF and cannot become knocked down.

name: Hunter
description: This model ignores concealment and cover when making ranged attacks.

name: Cleave
description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can make one additional melee attack. This model can gain only one additional attack from Cleave each activation.

name: Battle Wizard
description: Once per turn, when this model destroys or removes from play one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved it can make one Magic Ability special attack or special action.

name: •Dominate Undead (★Attack)
description: Dominate Undead is a RNG 10 arcane attack. Take control of target enemy non-Leader undead warrior model hit. You can immediately make a full advance with that model followed by a basic melee attack, then Dominate Undead expires. A model can be affected by Dominate Undead only once per turn.

name: •Grim Returns (★ Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly trooper model. If the model is in range, return one destroyed Grunt to its unit. The Grunt returns with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunt within 2" of the target trooper model. The returned Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn it is returned to play.

name: •Hellfire (★Attack)
description: Hellfire is a RNG 10, POW 14 magic attack. Models disabled by Hellfire cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by Hellfire are removed from play.

name: Wages of Death
description: When this model makes an attack or damage roll, it can suffer 1 damage point to reroll the roll. Each attack or damage roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Wages of Death.

name: Grapnel
description: At the end this models activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, this model can be placed completely within 3" of its current location, then its activation ends.

name: Arcane Precision
description: If this model uses its Normal Movement to aim, it ignores cloud effects when determining LOS and ignores Stealth that activation.

name: Head Shot
description: Models disabled by a ranged attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll. Models destroyed by a ranged attack made by this model are removed from play.

name: Girded
description: This model and friendly models B2B with it gain Resistance: Blast.

name: Spyglass (★ Action)
description: Target an enemy model in this model’s LOS. That model loses Stealth for one round.

name: Artillerist (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction model. If the model is in range, it gains +2 RAT when making a ranged attack with an AOE weapon. Artillerist lasts for one round.

name: Smoke Bombs (★Action)
description: Center a cloud effect template on this model. This template remains in play for one round.

name: Alchemical Mask
description: This model does not suffer gas effects. When determining LOS or resolving attacks, this model ignores cloud effects and concealment granted from cloud effects.

name: Arcane Pulse
description: When this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, enemy upkeep spells on models within 8" of it expire.

name: Dark Power
description: This model gains an additional die on arcane attack and arcane attack damage rolls. Discard the lowest die in each roll.

name: Hell Marked
description: Models destroyed by attacks made by this model never generate soul tokens.

name: •Death Rattle (★Attack)
description: Death Rattle is a RNG 10, POW 12 arcane attack. When Death Rattle boxes a living or undead non-Leader enemy warrior model, you can immediately take control of the model. The boxed model immediately makes one basic attack, then it is removed from play.

name: Gate Walker
description: Once per activation, immediately after this model casts a spell, you can place this model anywhere completely within 5" of its current location.

name: Arcane Void
description: When a model is targeted by an enemy spell within 5" of this model, the enemy spellcaster immediately suffers d3 damage points. If the enemy spellcaster is destroyed as a result of this damage, the spell does not take effect.

name: Magic Ability
description: Performing a Magic Ability special action or special attack counts as casting a spell.

name: •Bleed (★Attack)
description: Bleed is a RNG 8, POW 10 arcane attack. When Bleed damages a living enemy model, this model can remove d3 damage points.

name: •Unbinding (★Action)
description: Enemy upkeep spells on models/units within 5" of this model expire. For each upkeep spell that expires as a result of Unbinding, the model maintaining the spell suffers d3 damage points.

name: Marked Soul
description: This model is a Marked Soul.

name: Mental Force
description: This model can use Mental Force at the beginning of each attack. If it does, all attack and damage rolls resulting from the attack are boosted. After the attack is resolved, this model suffers d3 damage points.

name: •Hex Blast (★ Attack)
description: Hex Blast is a RNG 10, AOE 2, POW 13/8 arcane attack. Enemy upkeep spells and animi on the model/unit directly hit by Hex Blast immediately expire.

name: Ammo Crate
description: Once per attack, when a friendly Gravedigger model within 2" of this model makes a ranged attack during its activation, it can cause this model to suffer 1 damage point. If it does so, the attacking model’s ranged weapon gains +2 POW when resolving that attack.

name: Immobile
description: This model has no Normal Movement or Combat Action, cannot become knocked down or be moved, and is automatically hit by melee attacks.

name: Crate
description: This model cannot have damage removed from it.

name: Arcane Ammunition
description: While within 2" of this model, friendy Faction models' ranged weapons gain Damage Type: Magical.

name: Inconsequential
description: This model can not score or contest Objectives, Scenario terrain, or Caches.

name: Medical Crate
description: At any time during its activation, a friendly living Faction model within 2" of this model can cause it to suffer 1 damage point. If it does so, either remove d3+2 damage from the living model or return one destroyed non-character model to its unit. The model returns with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned model within 2" of the model that caused this model to suffer damage. The returned model must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is returned to play.

name: Battlefield Medicine
description: When a friendly model with Tough is disabled while within 2" of this model, it can cause this model to suffer 1 damage point. If it does so, remove 1 damage point from the model with Tough; it is no longer disabled and does not become knocked down.

name: Weapon Crate
description: When a friendly Valiant warjack without a Heavy Weapon contacts this crate, it can gain a Heavy Flamethrower, Howitzer, or Rocket Pod Heavy Weapon, then the crate is removed from play. The warjack gains the heavy weapon and +1 ARM for the rest of the game. Additionally, the turn the warjack gains the Heavy Weapon it also gains one focus point.

name: Relentless Charge
description: While advancing as part of a charge, this model gains Pathfinder.

name: Heavy Weapon Hardpoint
description: This model can have an airdropped heavy weapon.

name: Evasive
description: When this model is hit by an enemy ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can advance up to 2".

name: Set Defense
description: Models suffer –2 on charge and slam power attack rolls against this model.

name: Rapid Fire
description: This model can make one basic ranged attack during your Maintenance Phase.

name: Elite Cadre [Jack Marshal]
description: When a model controlling this warjack makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of this warjack the controller gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.)

name: Mantlet
description: Friendly medium and small-based warrior models in base contact with this defence gain +3 ARM against ranged attack damage rolls.

name: Fuel Canister
description: At any time during its activation before making its Normal Movement a friendly Gravedigger construct model within 2" of this model can cause this model to suffer 1 damage point. If it does so, the construct model gains +2 SPD that activation.

name: Augment
description: Once per attack, when a friendly Gravedigger construct model within 2" of this model makes a melee attack during its activation, it can cause this model to suffer 1 damage point. If it does so, the attacking model gains +2 to its next melee damage roll.

name: Arcane Fuel
description: At the start of its activation, a friendly Gravedigger cohort model within 2" of this model can cause this model to suffer 1 damage point. If it does so, the cohort model gains 1 focus point.

name: Reality Anchor
description: Enemy models cannot be summoned within 10" of this model.

name: Roiling Earth
description: When an enemy model advances and ends its movement within 3" of this model, the enemy model suffers Shadow Bind for one round. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers –3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)

name: Sturdy
description: This model cannot be pushed.

name: •Breath Taker (★Action)
description: For one round, living enemy models suffer –2 DEF and –2 to their melee attack damage rolls while within 5" of this model.

name: •Winter Storm (★Action)
description: Enemy models that begin their activations within 10" of this model lose Eyeless Sight, Flight, and Pathfinder that activation. Winter Storm lasts for one round.

name: •Hoarfrost (★ Attack)
description: Hoarfrost is a RNG 8, AOE 2, POW 14/8 arcane attack that causes cold damage. On a critical hit, models hit become stationary for one round unless they have Resistance: Cold.

name: Defensive Strike
description: Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement or is placed in this model’s melee range, this model can immediately make one basic melee attack against it.

name: Spell Ward
description: This model cannot be targeted by spells.

name: Blood-Quenched
description: This model gains a cumulative +1 ARM and +1 to its melee damage rolls for each enemy model it destroys with a melee attack during its activation. This bonus lasts for one round.

name: Hyper-Aggressive
description: When this model suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance directly toward the attacking model.

name: Killing Spree
description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, after that attack is resolved this model can advance up to 1" and make one additional melee attack.

name: Poltergeist
description: When an enemy model misses this model with an attack, immediately after the attack is resolved you can choose to push the enemy model d3" directly away from this model.

name: Ancient Shroud
description: When a damage roll against this model exceeds its ARM, it suffers 1 damage point instead of the total rolled.

name: Dark Prophecy
description: When this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, enemy models within 8" lose their essence points and cannot cast spells, channel spells, or be forced for one round.

name: •Grip of Shadows (★Action)
description: This model gains Telemetry for one round. (Other friendly models gain +2 to arcane attack rolls against enemy models within 8" of this model.)

name: •Whispers at the Gate (★Action)
description: Remove 1 essence point from each enemy infernal model currently within 5" of this model. Add 1 essence point to each friendly infernal model currently within 5" of this model.

name: •Word of Ruin (★Action)
description: This model gains Master of Ruin for one round. (Other models suffer -2 ARM while within 5" of a model with Master of Ruin.)

name: Inquisitor’s Talisman
description: This model begins the game with three power tokens. During its activation, this model can spend power tokens to make additional melee attacks or to boost attack or damage rolls. It can make one additional attack or boost one roll for each token spent.

name: •Chain Lightning (★ Attack)
description: Chain Lightning is a RNG 10 arcane attack. A model hit by Chain Lightning suffers a POW 10 electrical damage roll, and lightning arcs from that model to d3 consecutive additional models. The lightning arcs to the nearest model it has not already arced to within 3" of the last model it arced to, ignoring this model. Each model the lightning arcs to suffers a POW 10 electrical damage roll. Lightning arc damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Chain Lightning damage rolls are simultaneous.

name: •Stealth (★Action)
description: This model gains Stealth for one round.

name: Power Vortex
description: This model can immediately negate any spell that targets it or a model within 3" of it by spending 1 power token. The negated spell does not take effect, but its COST remains spent.

name: Dismember
description: This model gains an additional die on its melee and ranged damage rolls against warbeasts.

name: Reconnaissance (★Action)
description: RNG 8. Target friendly warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Pathfinder. Reconnaissance lasts for one turn.

name: Side Step
description: When this model hits an enemy model with an initial melee attack or a melee special attack, it can advance up to 2" after the attack is resolved.

name: Take Up
description: If this model is destroyed by an effect other than Take Up, you can choose a grunt in this unit within 1" of it to be destroyed instead. Remove that grunt from the table instead of this model. This model has the same number of unmarked damage boxes as the chosen grunt.

name: Finisher
description: This model gains an additional die on damage rolls against damaged models.

name: Prey
description: After deployment but before the first player’s turn, choose an enemy model/unit to be this model/unit’s prey. This model gains +2 to attack and damage rolls against its prey. When the prey is destroyed or removed from play, choose another model/unit to be the prey.

name: Granted: Advance Deployment
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Advance Deployment.

name: Granted: Reposition [3"]
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Reposition [3"]. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Quick Work
description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after that attack is resolved this model can make one basic ranged attack.

name: Granted: Hunter
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit ignore concealment and cover when making ranged attacks.

name: Hot Meal
description: This model can use Hot Meal once per game at any time during its activation. Remove all damage from friendly living warrior Faction models within 5" of this model.

name: Shield Guard
description: When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.

name: Anchor
description: Friendly warrior models cannot be knocked down while B2B with this model.

name: Limited Battlegroup [Razor]
description: The only warjack that can be in this model’s battlegroup is Razor.

name: Shield Wall
description: While this model is B2B with one or more models in its unit, it gains +2 ARM and cannot be knocked down.

name: Marksman
description: When damaging a warjack or warbeast with a ranged attack, choose which column or branch suffers damage.

name: Magic Ability
description: Performing a Magic Ability special action or special attack counts as casting a spell.

name: •Blizzard (★Action)
description: Choose a friendly Faction model within 5" of this model. Center a cloud effect template on the chosen model. The template remains centered on the model for one round. If the chosen model is destroyed or removed from play, remove the template from play.

name: •Razor Wind (★Attack)
description: Razor Wind is a RNG SP 10, POW 12 arcane attack. On a critical hit on a warjack or warbeast, fill in the unmarked damage boxes or circles on the last column or branch damaged.

name: Medicate [d3+1] (★Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly living warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, remove d3 +1 damage points from it.

name: Enrage (★Action)
description: RNG 3. Target friendly warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, it gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls. Enrage lasts for one turn.

name: Condition (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, you can place 1 fury point on it or remove 1 fury point from it.

name: Strafing Run
description: This model gains an additional die on ranged attack damage rolls. Discard the lowest die in each roll.

name: Crash and Burn
description: When this model is disabled, make a RNG 7, AOE 4, POW 15/10 ranged attack then remove this model from play. Models hit suffer the fire continuous effect.

name: Drive: Shatter
description: While within 10" of this model, the melee weapons of a warjack under its control gain Shatter. (A weapon with Shatter gains an additional damage die against stationary models.).

name: Fabricated Defense
description: Once per game, during its activation this model can place a Barrier, Fire Pit, Powder Keg, or Spike Trap Defense within 1" of this model. You can not place this defense within 3" of another defense, overlapping a model, obstruction or obstacle."

name: Repairable
description: This model can be targeted with Repair special actions as if it were a construct model.

name: Steady
description: This model cannot become knocked down.

name: Fleet
description: Once per activation, this model can spend 1 focus point to gain +2 SPD that activation.

name: Follow Up
description: When this model slams an enemy model, immediately after the slam is resolved this model can advance directly toward the slammed model, up to the distance the slammed model was moved.

name: Grand Slam
description: This model can make slam power attacks without spending a focus point. Models slammed by this model are moved an additional 2".

name: Battle Plan
description: This model can use one of the following plans at any time during its activation:

name: •Desperate Pace [Immortal]
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Immortal trooper model. If the model is in range, the models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

name: •Fight to the Last
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Tough for one round.

name: •Wings of Death
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Construct warrior model. If the model is in range, it gains Incorporeal for one round. If the model is in range and is a trooper model, the models in its unit also gain Incorporeal for one round.

name: Soul Vessel
description: This model generates soul tokens as if it were a living model.

name: Alpha Hunter
description: Warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup beginning their activations in its control range can run, charge, or make power attacks without being forced. When this model destroys one or more enemy models during its activation, warbeasts in its battlegroup beginning their activations in its control range gain +2 SPD and MAT for one turn.

name: Exorcist
description: While within 10" of this model, enemy models lose Incorporeal.

name: Leadership [Blighted Ogrun]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Blighted Ogrun models gain Rise.

name: Rise
description: If this model is knocked down at the beginning of your Maintenance Phase, it stands up.

name: Spiritual Conduit
description: While its Leader is within 10" of this model, when the Leader casts a spell and is the point of origin for the spell, the spell gains +2 RNG.

name: Unbinding (★Action)
description: Enemy upkeep spells on models/units within 5" of this model expire. For each upkeep spell that expires as a result of Unbinding, the model maintaining the spell suffers d3 damage points.

name: Spontaneous Mutation
description: This model can suffer damage at any time during its activation to gain one of the following special rules for each damage point suffered. This damage cannot be transferred. Each special rule lasts until the start of this model’s next activation.

name: •Warp Strength
description: This model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls.

name: •Wings
description: This model gains +1 SPD and Flight.

name: •Ashen Veil
description: This model has concealment. Living enemy models without Resistance: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls while within 2" of this model.

name: Regeneration [d3]
description: This model can be forced to remove d3 damage points once per activation. This model cannot use Regeneration during an activation it runs.

name: Snacking
description: When this model boxes a living model with a melee attack, it can choose to remove the boxed model from play. When it does, this model can remove d3 damage points.

name: Exigent
description: Enemy models engaged by a model with Exigent suffer –2 to attack rolls when attacking models without Exigent.

name: Plasma Nimbus
description: If this model is hit by a melee attack, immediately after the attack is resolved you can choose to have the attacking model suffer a POW 10 electrical damage roll unless this model was destroyed or removed from play by the attack.

name: Reposition [2"]
description: At the end of this model/unit’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, this model can advance up to 2", then its activation ends.

name: Roadblock
description: This model provides cover to friendly models as if it were an obstacle. This model loses Roadblock while it is incorporeal or knocked down

name: Repair [1] (★ Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove 1 damage point from it.

name: Strip (★ Action)
description: This model can make this special action only when B2B with an enemy warjack. The warjack suffers 1 damage point to the column of your choice.

name: Force Mastery
description: This model cannot become knocked down. While in this model's control range, friendly Faction models gain Resistance: Blast and do not suffer collateral damage.

name: •Precision Strike
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly models ignore other friendly models when determining LOS. Friendly models can advance through other friendly models within 10" of this model if they have enough movement to move completely past them. Precision Strike lasts for one turn.

name: Annoyance
description: Living enemy models within 1" of this model suffer –1 to attack rolls.

name: •Stand Your Ground
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Set Defense for one round. (Models suffer –2 on charge and slam power attack rolls against a model with Set Defense.)

name: •Special Orders
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Reposition [3"] for one turn. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Focused Strike
description: When this model damages a warjack or warbeast with a melee attack, choose which column or branch suffers the damage.

name: Accumulator [Ellowuyr]
description: When this model begins its activation within 3" of one or more friendly Ellowuyr warrior models, this model gains 1 focus point.

name: Inscrutable
description: Opponents cannot take control of this model.

name: Duelist
description: This model gains +2 DEF against melee attack rolls.

name: Riposte
description: When it is missed by an enemy melee attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can make one basic melee attack against the attacking model.

name: Sprint
description: At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, this model can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.

name: Revelations of the Outer Darkness
description: Once per turn, when a friendly Faction warrior within 12" of this model is destroyed or removed from play by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can cast a spell without spending essence, focus, or fury.

name: Soul Taker: Soul Ripper
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed within 2" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. After this model replenishes its essence during your next Control Phase, replace each soul token with 1 essence point.

name: Field Marshal [Sacred Ward]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Sacred Ward. (A model with Sacred Ward cannot be targeted by enemy spells.)

name: •Harmonious Exaltation (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target this model’s Leader. If it is in range, once this turn when the Leader casts a spell, reduce the COST of the spell by 1.

name: Willing Vessel
description: When an infernal master summons a horror and chooses this model to remove from play, the infernal master does not need to spend any essence points to summon the horror.

name: Anathema
description: When this model is summoned, center a cloud effect template on it. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round.  A model without Resistance: Corrosion entering or ending its activation in the template suffers 1 point of corrosion damage.

name: Psycho Static
description: Spells channeled through this model the turn it is summoned suffer –3 RNG.

name: Channeling
description: While this model is in its controller’s control range, its controller can channel spells through it

name: Soul Parasites
description: Living non-soulless enemy models and enemy models with Soul Vessel suffer –2 to their attack rolls while within 4" of this model.

name: Wailing
description: While within 5" of this model, enemy models cannot cast spells or be used to channel spells.

name: Soul Claiming
description: When a living enemy model is destroyed within 4" of this model while this model is in its controller’s control range, its controller gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

name: Soul Void
description: Enemy models are not eligible to gain soul tokens from enemy models destroyed within 6" of this model.

name: •Influence (★Attack)
description: Influence is a RNG 10 arcane attack. Take control of target enemy non-Leader warrior model hit. The model immediately makes one basic attack, then Influence expires. A model can be affected by Influence only once per turn.

name: •Instigate (★Action)
description: While within 5"of this model, friendly large-based and smaller monstrosities gain +2 on attack and damage rolls. Instigate lasts for one turn.

name: Sacrificial Pawn [Monstrosity]
description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Monstrosity within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

name: Agonies
description: Once at any time during its activation, this model can be forced to use one of the following effects:

name: •Gnawing Pain
description: While within 8" of this model, enemy models suffer –2 to their melee attack damage rolls. Gnawing Pain lasts for one round.

name: •Maddening
description: Enemy warbeasts currently within 6" of this model gain 1 fury point.

name: •Spiritual Affliction
description: While within 8" of this model, living enemy models cannot cast spells. Spiritual Affliction lasts for one round.

name: Apparition
description: During your Control Phase, place this model anywhere completely within 2" of its current location.

name: •Sigil of Power (★ Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. Sigil of Power lasts for one turn.

name: •Black Waters (★Action)
description: While within 3" of this model, models treat open terrain as shallow water and gain Resistance Fire. Black Waters lasts for one round.

name: Tactician
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly models ignore other friendly models when determining LOS. Friendly models can advance through other friendly models within 10" of this model if they have enough movement to move completely past them.

name: Soul Taker: Spirit Harvester
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed within 5" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to five soul tokens at any time. At the start of this model’s activation, you can remove soul tokens from this model to give it 1 focus point for each token removed.

name: Acid Cloud
description: This model can use Acid Cloud once per activation at any time. Center a cloud effect template on this model. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. Models in the template when it is placed or that enter or end their activation in the template suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.

name: Bond [Aiakos]
description: If Kharybdis begins the game in Aiakos’ battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Kharybdis is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Kharybdis is bonded to Aiakos and in his control range, it gains Prowl. (While a model with Prowl has concealment, it gains Stealth.)

name: Body Snatcher: Heart Eater
description: When this model destroys a living or undead enemy model with a melee attack, this model gains the destroyed model’s corpse token. This model can have up to three corpse tokens at any time. This model can spend corpse tokens for the following:

name: •Crucible of Death
description: This model can spend up to three corpse tokens at the start of its activation to gain 1 focus point for each corpse token spent.

name: Body Snatcher: Grave Robber [5"]
description: When a living or undead model is destroyed while within 5" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model's corpse token. This model can have up to five corpse tokens at any time. This model can spend corpse tokens for the following:

name: •Death Industry
description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can spend up to three corpse tokens to return one destroyed small- or medium-based friendly Faction undead Grunt to play for each token removed. Grunts return with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts completely within 12" of this model and within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit thier Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

name: Blade Rush
description: While making a trample power attack, this model does not stop when it contacts a model with a medium or larger base, an obstacle, or an obstruction. This model makes trample attacks against models regardless of their base size. This model cannot hit models occupying buildings with its trample power attacks.

name: Innate Power
description: Reduce the COST of spells cast by this model by 1.

name: Entropic Presence
description: This model can be forced to gain Master of Ruin once per activation. Entropic Presence lasts for one round. (Other models, friendly or enemy, suffer -2 ARM while within 5" of a model with Master of Ruin.)

name: •Heal [d3+3] (★Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly living Faction model. If the model is in range, remove d3+3 damage points from it.

name: •Enliven (★Action)
description: RNG 3. Target friendly Faction Cohort model. If the target is in range, the next time it suffers damage from an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved the target can make a full advance, then Enliven expires. Enliven lasts for one round.

name: •Tune Up (★ Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction cohort. If the cohort is in range, it immediately stands up and is no longer stationary, continuous effects on the cohort expire, and the cohort gains Pathfinder for one turn.

name: Insidious Plans
description: This model can use one of the following plans at any time during its activation:

name: •Curse [Horror]
description: RNG 10. Target enemy model/unit. If the target enemy model/unit is in range, friendly horrors gain +2 to attack rolls against it. Curse lasts for one turn.

name: •Shadow
description: RNG 10. Target enemy model. If the target enemy model is in range, when it advances or is placed, after its movement or placement is resolved one friendly non-trooper warrior model within 10" of this model can make a full advance. Shadow lasts for one round.

name: Granted: Spell Ward
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit cannot be targeted by spells.

name: Death Magic
description: During its activation, this model can remove friendly Grunt models in its unit from play to make additional melee attacks or to boost attack or damage rolls. It can make one additional melee attack or boost one roll for each model removed. When this model would suffer damage, you can choose one or more models in its unit to suffer any number of those damage points instead, divided as you choose. If you do, this model does not suffer that damage. A model cannot suffer more damage as a result of Death Magic than it has unmarked damage boxes.

name: •Craft Thrall Rune (★Action)
description: Choose a Risen Grunt in this unit and replace it with a Thrall Warrior solo. Remove the Risen Grunt model from play.

name: Body Snatcher: Stir the Dead
description: This model can gain corpse tokens. When a living model is destroyed within 10" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s corpse token. At the end of your next Control Phase, remove all corpse tokens from this model and add one Risen Grunt to this unit for each corpse token removed. Place Risen Grunts within 2" on another model in this unit. This unit cannot have more than ten Risen Grunts in play at any time.

name: Created
description: This model does not begin the game in play.

name: •Grave Summons (★Action)
description: When this model uses Grave Summons it can spend any number of soul tokens. For each soul token spent put one friendly Thrall Warrior solo into play anywhere completely within 3" of this model.

name: •Spectral Vortex
description: This model can immediately negate any spell that targets it or a model within 3" of it by spending 1 soul token. The negated spell does not take effect, but its COST remains spent.

name: •Soul-Powered
description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend soul tokens to make additional melee attacks. It can make one additional attack for each token spent.

name: •Null Magic (★Action)
description: For one round, models cannot cast spells while within 10" of this model.

name: •Power of Death (★Action)
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly undead models gain +2 to their melee attack damage rolls. Power of Death lasts for one turn.

name: Flank [Undead]
description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of a friendly Undead model, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

name: Leadership [Undead]
description: While a friendly Undead is within 10" of this model, it gains Shield Guard. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

name: Passive Necromancy
description: Once per turn when another living warrior model is boxed while within 10" of this model, you can choose to remove the boxed model from play and replace it with a Thrall Warrior model. The Thrall Warrior must forfeit its Combat Action the turn it is put into play.

name: Channeler
description: While this model is in a friendly Faction Leader’s control range, the Leader can channel spells through it.

name: Ionization [5"]
description: When a model without Resistance: Electricity suffers an electrical damage roll while within 5" of this model, add +2 to the roll.

name: Iron Sentinel
description: While B2B with a friendly Faction Cohort model, this model gains +2 DEF and ARM and cannot become knocked down.

name: Shifting Sands Stance
description: During its activation, this model can forfeit its Normal Movement or Combat Action to gain +2 DEF. If an enemy attack misses it at any time except while it is advancing, after the attack is resolved this model can immediately make a full advance. Shifting Sands Stance lasts for one round.

name: Monster Hunter
description: When this model hits a warbeast with an attack, the warbeast suffers d3 + 3 points of damage to the branch of your choice.

name: Ritual Slaughter
description: Once during each of your turns when another friendly Blighted Ogrun model destroys an enemy model with an attack while in this model’s control range, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can cast a spell without spending fury. This model can spend fury to boost attack and damage rolls on spells cast as a result of Ritual Slaughter.

name: Espionage (★Action)
description: RNG 8. Target enemy Leader model. If the enemy Leader is in range, one friendly faction model within 8" of this model can immediately advance 3".

name: Mark Target
description: Other friendly Faction models gain +2 to ranged attack rolls against enemy models within 5" of this model and in its LOS.

name: Gifts of Annihilation
description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can use one of the following effects. Gifts of Annihilation effects last for one round.

name: •Dark Rituals
description: This model can channel spells through friendly Faction warrior models in its control range. Immediately after a spell is channeled through a model as a result of Dark Rituals, the model it was channeled through suffers d3 points of magical damage.

name: •Fate Binder
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Shield Guard. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

name: •Night Reaper
description: This model gains Carrion Feast and Entropic Force. (When a living or undead model is destroyed while within 5" of a model with Carrion Feast, you can choose to have that model be removed from play. If a model is removed from play as a result of Carrion Feast, it does not generate a corpse token and the model with Carrion Feast can remove d3 damage points.) (While within 5" of a model with Entropic Force, enemy models lose Tough and cannot have damage removed from them.)

name: Limited Battlegroup [Barrow Ghoul and Charnel Hound]
description: The only warbeasts that can be in this model’s battlegroup are Barrow Ghoul and Charnel Hound.

name: Cursed
description: While within 5" of this model, enemy models suffer –1 ARM.

name: Taste of Death
description:
When a living or undead enemy model within 5" of this model is
destroyed, this model’s controller can gain 1 focus or fury point. A model’s focus or fury point total cannot exceed its ARC as a result of Taste of Death.

name: Mage Static
description: Spells cast by enemy models within 10" of this model suffer +1 COST and –3 RNG.

name: Defensive Strike
description: Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement or is placed in this model’s melee range, this model can immediately make one basic melee attack against it.

name: Soul Taker: Requiem
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a friendly living model is destroyed while within 10" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

name: •Spirit-Driven
description: At the beginning of this model’s activation, it can spend one soul token to gain +2 SPD that activation.

name: Arcane Disruption
description: Spells targeting a model within 5" of this terrain feature, suffer +1 COST and –3 RNG.

name: Targetable
description: This terrain feature can be targeted by basic ranged and melee attacks as a small-based model. This terrain feature can be targeted by attacks made by either player’s models.

name: Overtake
description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".

name: Steady
description: This model cannot become knocked down.

name: •Craft Talisman (★ Action)
description: RNG 5. Target a friendly Leader model. If the Leader is in range, when it casts a spell and is the point of origin, the spell gains +2 RNG. Spells with RNG SELF or CTRL are not affected. Craft Talisman lasts for one turn.

name: •Blood Ritual (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly living Faction model. If the model is in range, remove it from play. If target model was removed from play, then choose one friendly Faction warrior model within 5" of this model. That model either gains Divine Inspiration for one turn or d3 corpse tokens. (A model with Divine Inspiration gains an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls. Discard the lowest die of each roll.)

name: •Invoke the Beast (★Action)
description: RNG 8. Target friendly Marked model. If the target is in range, replace it with Shapeshifer model that has not yet been put into play. The replaced model is removed from play. When a Shapeshifter model replaces a model that has entered play this turn or that had already activated this turn, it must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action this turn. When the Shapeshifter model replaces a  model, that model is not considered to have entered an area and does not trigger effects triggered by entering that area. When the Shapeshifter is destroyed, remove it from play.

name: •Rites of Spring (★Action)
description: Remove d3 damage points from each friendly living Faction model currently within 6" of this model.

name: Savagery
description: This model's melee attack rolls against non-Leader warrior models are boosted.

name: Soul Matrix [Asphyxious]
description: When this model destroys an enemy living model with an attack, Asphyxious gains the destroyed model’s soul token.

name: Bond [Lukas]
description: If Apollo begins the game in Lukas’ battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Apollo is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. If Apollo is bonded to Lukas and is in his control range at the start of Lukas’ activation, Lukas can remove d3 damage points.

name: Arcane Realignment
description: While within this model's Leader's control Range, that Leader can reroll one failed arcane attack roll each turn.

name: Arcane Repeater
description: While this model’s Leader is within 5" of it, that Leader’s control range is extended 2".

name: Ghost Shield
description: This model gains +1 ARM for each soul token currently on it.

name: •Guidance (★ Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly model. If the model is in range, it gains Eyeless Sight and its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical for one turn.

name: Soul Tap
description: If this model is in its Leader’s control range during your Control Phase, the Leader can spend soul tokens on this model to upkeep one spell for each token spent.

name: Carapace
description: This model gains +4 ARM against ranged attack damage rolls.

name: Hunting Pack [Aradus]
description: This model gains a +1 cumulative bonus to melee attack and damage rolls for each other friendly Aradus warbeast with the target of this model’s melee attack in its melee range. This cumulative bonus cannot exceed +3.

name: •Arcane Reinforcement (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warjack. If the target warjack is in range, its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. Arcane Reinforcement lasts for one turn.

name: •Empower (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction warjack. If the target warjack is in range and it was suffering Disruption, it is no longer disrupted. The warjack gains 1 focus point.

description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d3 +1 damage points from it.

description: RNG 1. Target Nemo. If Nemo is in range, they gain an additional die on electrical attack and electrical damage rolls. Discard the lowest die of each roll. Super Tune lasts for one turn.

name: Empower (★ Action)

description: This model can use Moment of Clarity once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. This activation, models in this unit gain True Sight. (A model with True Sight ignores cloud effects when determining LOS. A model with True Sight also ignores Stealth.)

name: •Concentrated Power (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction warjack. If the warjack is in range, it gains +2 on melee damage rolls this turn.

name: •Empower (★ Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction warjack. If the target warjack is in range and it was suffering Disruption, it is no longer disrupted. The warjack gains 1 focus point.

name: Focused Power
description: If this model uses its Normal Movement to aim, its ranged weapon gains +2 RNG and it gains +2 to its ranged attack damage rolls that activation.

name: Polarity Field
description: This model cannot be targeted by a charge or slam power attack made by a construct model.

name: Blood-Quenched
description: This model gains a cumulative +1 ARM and +1 to its melee damage rolls for each enemy model it destroys with a melee attack during its activation. This bonus lasts for one round.

name: Field Marshal [Shield Guard]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Shield Guard. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

name: •March
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Pathfinder for one turn.

name: •War Cry
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains +2 MAT. War Cry lasts for one turn.

name: •Reveille
description: Knocked down friendly Faction models within 10" of this model immediately stand up. Models that became knocked down this turn are not affected by Reveille.

name: Drive: Reposition [3"]
description: While within 10" of this model, a warjack under its control gains Reposition [3"]. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Extended Control Range

name: Dig In (★Action)
