name: Activate Lightning Pod
description: Once per activation, after the Stormwall’s Normal Movement, you can place one Lightning Pod anywhere completely within 10" of this model. When a Lightning Pod is placed, enemy models whose bases are intersected by a line drawn from the center of the Lightning Pod’s base to the center of this model’s base suffer a POW 10 electrical damage roll. name: Bond [Nemo]

name: Soul Taker: Cull Soul

name: Death Reaper
description: When a living enemy model is destroyed while within 10" of this model, Asphyxious gains the destroyed model’s soul token.

name: Field Marshal [Dark Shroud]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Dark Shroud. (While within 2" of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.)

name: Generator
description: When this model would suffer damage, it can immediately spend up to 1 focus point to reduce the damage it would suffer by 5. This model cannot spend focus points to reduce damage while its Generator (G) or Head system (H) is crippled

name: •Sneak
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Prowl for one round. Sneak lasts for one round. (While a model with Prowl has concealment, it gains Stealth.)

name: •Wet Work
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Anatomical Precision and Overtake for one round. (When a model with Anatomical Precision’s melee damage roll fails to exceed the ARM of the living model hit, that model suffers 1 damage point. A model disabled by a melee attack made by a model with Anatomical Precision cannot make a Tough roll.) (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

name: Take Up

name: Field Alchemy

name: Traumatic Transformation

Damage points in excess of this model’s remaining unmarked damage boxes are not applied to Big Alyce’s damage boxes. name: Menoth’s Gaze

name: Accumulator [Storm Knight warrior]

name: Spring Blades

name: Threshing Blades
description: This model gains +4 to its trample power attack damage rolls.

name: Flame Trail
description: When this model advances into B2B contact with an enemy model during its activation, the enemy model suffers the Fire continuous effect.

name: Fuel for the Flames [5"]
description: When an enemy model without Resistance: Fire suffers a fire damage roll while within 5" of this model, add an additional die to the damage roll

name: Blade Glide
description: While making a trample power attack, this model gains +3 SPD and does not stop when it contacts a model with a medium or larger base, an obstacle, or an obstruction. This model makes trample attacks against models regardless of their base size. This model cannot hit models occupying buildings with its trample power attacks.

name: Bond [Kryssa]
description: If this model begins the game in Kryssa’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While this model is bonded to Kryssa and in her control range, it gains Reposition [3"̋]. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

If it does, choose a location completely within this model’s control range that is completely within a forest. Remove this model from the forest and place it in the chosen location. This model cannot use Forest Walk while knocked down.

name: Serpent's Coil

(Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement or is placed in the melee range of a model with Defensive Strike, the model with Defensive Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against it.)

name: Ghostly
description: This model can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.

description: This model can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.

name: Vengeance

name: Ghostly
description: This model can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.

description: While within 2"  of this model, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.

name: Soul Taker: Soul Cage
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed within 2" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model's soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

name: Field Marshal [Relentless Charge]

name: Body Snatcher: Bone Pile

This model can have up to three corpse tokens at any time.

name: Sacrificial Pawn [Bone Shaker]
description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Bone Shaker within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

name: Tide of Skulls
description: During your Control Phase, Barnabas can spend one or more corpse tokens to put a Bone Shaker model into play. For each corpse token spent, add one Bone Shaker model. You cannot have more than three Bone Shaker models in play at any time. Place the Bone Shaker models completely within 3" of Barnabas. Bone Shaker models must forfeit their Combat Action the turn they are put into play.

name: •Parlay (★Action)
description: While within 5" of this model, enemy warrior models cannot target this model or its Leader with attacks. Parlay lasts for one round.

name: •Swamp Gas (★Action)
description: Center a cloud effect template on this model. The template is a gas effect and hazard that remains centered on the model for one round. While in the template, living enemy models suffer –2 to attack rolls.

name: Adrenalize

(When a model with Berserk destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.) description: Once per turn immediately after this model’s controller channels a spell through it, this model can advance 3".

name: Initiate Secondary Coiling Bypass
description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can spend one focus point to remove d3 damage points from itself.

name: Insulated Cortex
description: This warjack cannot be disrupted.

name: Arc Web
description: When this model's controller channels a spell through it, this model can channel the spell through another friendly Faction warjack with the Arc Node advantage within 10" of this model. The other model with the Arc Node advantage becomes the channeling model.

name: Granted: Gang
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Gang. (When making a melee attack targeting an enemy model in the melee range of another model in this unit, a model with Gang gains +2 to melee attack and melee damage rolls.)

name: Trollkin
description: This model is a Trollkin model.

name: Bond [Sorscha]
description: If Beast 09 begins the game in Sorscha’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Beast 09 is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Beast 09 is bonded to Sorscha and in her control range, it gains Shield Guard. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack during your opponent’s turn while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard directly hit instead. It is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

name: Field Marshal [Pathfinder]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Pathfinder.

name: Maltreatment
description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can remove 1 fury point from a warbeast in its battlegroup that is in its control range and add 1 fury point to its own current total. The warbeast suffers d3 damage points.

name: Field Marshal [Fight-or-Flight]
description: Warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup can run or charge without being forced.

name: Limited Battlegroup [Beast Mistress]
description: The only warbeasts that can be in this model’s battlegroup are non-character Faction lesser warbeasts.

name: Flank [friendly Faction warbeast]
description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Faction warbeast, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

name: Advanced Sub-Cortex
description: The S boxes of this warjack's damage grid represents its Advanced Sub-Cortex system. While this warjack's Sub-Cortex system is not crippled, it gains Gunfighter and its ranged attack rolls are boosted.

name: Massive
description: This model is treated as having the massive rule as if it were a Colossal.

name: Sub-Cortex
description: The S boxes of this warjack's damage grid represent its Sub-Cortex system. While this warjack's Sub-Cortex system is not crippled, its ranged weapons gain Powerful Attack. (When attacking with a weapon with Powerful Attack, a model can spend 1 focus point to boost all attack and damage rolls for the attack.)

name: Bond [Bethayne, Voice of Everblight]
description: Belphagor begins the game bonded to Bethayne. Belphagor is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While Belphagor is bonded to Bethayne and in her control range, she can channel spells through it.

name: Flank [Sasha]
description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of Sasha, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

name: Berserk
description: When this model destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.

name: Dark Rituals
description: This model can channel spells through friendly Faction warrior models in its control range. Immediately after a spell is channeled through a model as a result of Dark Rituals, the model it was channeled through suffers d3 points of magical damage.

name: Flesh Meld
description:
Bethayne can use Flesh Meld at any time during her activation while B2B with Belphagor. Remove Bethayne from the table. Upkeep spells she cast do not immediately expire, and warbeasts in her battlegroup do not go wild. Any effects on Bethayne when she melds are applied to Belphagor. Remove the fury points currently on Belphagor. If there are any fury points on Bethayne when she melds, place them on Belphagor. Belphagor cannot activate later in a turn in which it becomes flesh melded.

While melded, Belphagor becomes a warlock warrior model, loses Soulless, takes control of Bethayne’s battlegroup, and can upkeep spells cast by Bethayne. While melded, Belphagor loses its FURY and THR stats and gains AAT 7, ARC 7, and CTRL 14. While melded, Belphagor can cast Bethayne’s spells and use her feat. While melded, Belphagor is not considered to be a warbeast and loses its animus. While melded, Belphagor suffers damage like a warbeast but does not suffer the effects of crippled aspects. Effects modifying the amount of damage to or the manner in which damage is applied to a warbeast still apply to Belphagor, even while it is melded. If Belphagor is destroyed or removed from play while melded, Bethayne is also destroyed.

Bethayne can separate from Belphagor during your Maintenance Phase. When she returns to play, place her B2B with Belphagor. Bethayne returns to play with the same amount of damage she had when she was removed from the table as a result of Flesh Meld. After Bethayne returns to play, she can upkeep spells cast by Belphagor when they were melded.

name: Purge
description: If this model is hit by a melee attack, immediately after the attack is resolved the attacking model suffers the Corrosion continuous effect.

name: •Disbinding (★Action)
description: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on this model and its unit immediately expire.

name: Concentrated Fire
description: This activation, models in this unit gain a +1 cumulative bonus to ranged damage rolls for each other model in this unit that has hit an enemy model with a ranged attack this activation.

name: Sacrificial Pawn [Privateer warrior]
description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Privateer warrior model within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

name: Granted: Side Step
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Side Step. (When a model with Side Step hits an enemy model with an initial melee attack or a melee special attack, the model with Side Step can advance up to 2" after the attack is resolved.)

name: Bond [Harkevich]
description: If Black Ivan begins the game in Harkevich’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Black Ivan is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Black Ivan is bonded to Harkevich and in his control range, it gains Swift Hunter. (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

name: Blood-Bound
description: When this model destroys a living enemy model with an attack, after the attack is resolved you can return one destroyed model in its unit to play. Place the returned model completely within 3" of this model. The returned model cannot activate the turn it returns to play. The destroyed enemy model is removed from play and does not provide a soul or corpse token.

name: Gang
description: When making a melee attack targeting an enemy model in the melee range of another model in this unit, this model gains +2 to melee attack and melee damage rolls.

name: •Earth’s Power (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction construct warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, it gains +2 to its melee damage rolls this turn.

name: •Repair [d6] (★Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d6 damage points from it.

name: •Stone Spray (★Attack)
description: Stone Spray is a RNG SP 8, POW 12 arcane attack. On a critical hit, models hit become knocked down.

name: •Phase Jump (★ Action)
description: If it is within 2" of a friendly Shifting Stone model, place this model anywhere completely within 12" of its current location. Otherwise, place it completely within 2" of a friendly Shifting Stone model anywhere on the table. After using Phase Jump, this model’s activation ends.

name: •Hunter’s Mark (★Attack)
description:
Hunter’s Mark is a RNG 10 arcane attack that causes no damage.
Friendly models can charge or make a slam power attack against target enemy model hit by Hunter’s Mark without being forced or spending focus. A friendly model charging or power attack slamming an enemy model hit by Hunter’s Mark gains +2 SPD while resolving the charge or slam. Hunter’s Mark lasts for one turn.

name: •Unbinding (★Action)
description: Enemy upkeep spells on models/units within 5" of this model expire. For each upkeep spell that expires as a result of Unbinding, the model maintaining the spell suffers d3 damage points.

name: •Ice Bolt (★Attack)
description: Ice Bolt is a RNG 10 arcane attack. A model hit suffers a POW 12 cold damage roll. On a critical hit, the model hit becomes stationary for one round unless it has Resistance: Cold.

name: •Ice Cage (★Attack)
description: Ice Cage is a RNG 10 arcane attack. On a direct hit a model hit suffers a cumulative –2 DEF for one turn unless it has Resistance: Cold. When a model without Resistance: Cold is affected by two or more directly hitting Ice Cage attacks in the same turn, it becomes stationary for one round.

name: •Kiss of Lyliss (★ Attack)
description: Kiss of Lyliss is a RNG 10 arcane attack. When a friendly Faction model makes a damage roll against a model/unit hit by Kiss of Lyliss, add +2 to the roll. Kiss of Lyliss lasts for one turn.

name: •Cloak of Mist (★Action)
description: Model's in this unit gain Stealth for one round.

name: Bond [Severius]
description: If this model begins the game in Severius’ battlegroup, it is bonded to him. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. Once per turn, when Severius channels a spell through this model, he gains +2 to that spell’s attack and damage rolls.

name: Veteran Leader [Blighted]
description: While within 10" of this model, Blighted models gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: Bond [Anamag]
description: If Golab begins the game in Anamag’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Golab is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Golab is bonded to Anamag and in her control range, Anamag and Golab both gain Swarm. (A model with Swarm gains concealment. Living enemy models suffer –2 to attack rolls while within 2" of a model with Swarm.)

name: Carrion Feast
description: When a living or undead model is destroyed while within 5" of this model, you can choose to have that model be removed from play. If a model is removed from play as a result of Carrion Feast, it does not generate a corpse token and this model can remove d3 damage points.

name: Veteran Leader [Blighted Rotwing]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Blighted Rotwing models gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: Vault
description: Once per activation, after making a full advance as its Normal Movement but before performing its Combat Action, this model can be forced to be placed completely within 5" of its current location.

name: Bond [Thagrosh]
description: If Typhon begins the game in Thagrosh’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Typhon is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. When Typhon is forced to use Regeneration while bonded to Thagrosh and in his control range, instead of rolling to determine how many damage points this model removes, Typhon and Thagrosh can each remove up to 3 damage points.

name: Blighted Breath
description: At the beginning of this model’s activation, choose one of the following Blighted Breath effects. While within 6" of this model, models are affected by the chosen effect. Blighted Breath effects last for one round. If this model frenzies, it must choose Withering Ash at the start of its activation.

name: •Dragon's Breath
description: Affected friendly Faction warrior models gain +2 ARM and +2 to their melee attack damage rolls.

name: •Spiritual Corruption
description: Affected enemy models cannot cast or channel spells.

name: •Withering Ash
description: Affected models gain concealment.

name: Hunting Pack [Blight Wasp]
description: This model gains a +1 cumulative bonus to melee attack and damage rolls for each other friendly Blight Wasp with the target of this model’s melee attack in its melee range. This cumulative bonus cannot exceed +3.

name: Granted: Combined Arms
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Combined Arms. (When a model with Combined Arms misses an attack roll for a combined ranged attack, it can reroll that attack roll. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Combined Arms.)

name: Granted: Ready Ammo
description: While this model is in play, the ROF of Nyss Longbows on models in this unit becomes 2.

name: Vengeance
description: During your Maintenance Phase, if one or more models in this unit were damaged by enemy attacks during the last round, each model in the unit can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.

name: Medicate [d3] (★Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly living warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, remove d3 damage points from it.

name: Aerial Coordination
description: Friendly Faction warbeasts with Flight beginning their activations within 10" of this model can charge without being forced.

name: •Deathly Power (★Action)
description: This model gains Dark Shroud for one turn. (While within 2" of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.)

name: •Wind Ravager (★Action)
description: While within 6" of this model, enemy models cannot make ranged attacks.

name: Granted: Cleave
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Cleave. (When a model with Cleave destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved the model can make one additional melee attack. A model can gain only one additional attack from Cleave per activation.)

name: Granted: Overtake
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Overtake. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

name: Granted: Defensive Strike
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Defensive Strike. (Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement or is placed in the melee range of a model with Defensive Strike, the model with Defensive Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against it.)

name: Blade Shield
description: This model gains +2 DEF against ranged attack rolls.

name: Leadership [Blighted Nyss Swordsmen]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Blighted Nyss Swordsmen models gain Blade Shield.

name: No Quarter
description: This model can use No Quarter once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. This activation, models in this unit gain Pathfinder. A model in this unit that charges as part of its Normal Movement gains +2 SPD. No Quarter lasts for one round.

name: Granted: Prey
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Prey. (After deployment but before the first player’s turn, choose an enemy model/unit to be this unit’s prey. A model with Prey gains +2 to attack and damage rolls against its prey. When the prey is destroyed or removed from play, choose another model/unit to be the prey.)

name: Granted: Relentless Charge
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Relentless Charge. (While advancing as part of a charge, a model with Relentless Charge gains Pathfinder.)

name: Sitting Vulture
description: While B2B with this model, enemy models suffer –1 DEF.

name: No Sleeping on the Job [Blighted Trollkin]
description: This model and friendly Blighted Trollkin models within 10" of it cannot become knocked down.

name: Battery Fire (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction weapon crew model. If the model is in range, it can make one additional ranged attack during its activation this turn.

name: Leadership [Bloat Thralls]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Bloat Thrall models gain Reposition [3"].

name: Thrall Bomb
description: When this model is disabled, models within 2" of it suffer a POW 8 blast damage roll, then this model is removed from play.

name: Veteran Leader [Bloat Thralls]
description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Bloat Thrall models gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: Bond [Thyra]
description: If Blood of Martyrs begins the game in Thyra’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Blood of Martyrs is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Blood of Martyrs is bonded to Thyra and in her control range, it gains Apparition. (During your Control Phase, place models with Apparition anywhere completely within 2" of their current locations.)

name: Hand of Vengeance
description: When one or more friendly Faction warrior models are destroyed or removed from play by enemy attacks while within 5" of this model, this model gains +2 on melee attack and melee damage rolls for one round.

name: Leadership [Bloodweavers]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Bloodweavers models gain Killing Spree.

name: Unyielding
description: This model gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.

name: Flank [Privateer]
description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Privateer model, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

name: Stumbling Drunk
description: This model cannot become knocked down. If it is hit by an enemy attack at any time except while it is advancing, after the attack is resolved a model with Stumbling Drunk is pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model.

name: •Shepherd’s Call (★Action)
description: Remove up to 1 fury point from each friendly living Faction warbeast currently within 3" of this model.

name: Birds Eye
description: While in this model’s control range, models in its battlegroup can ignore cloud effects, forest terrain, and intervening models when determining LOS.

name: Toil and Trouble
description: While within 3" of this model, +1" for every corpse token on this model,  enemy models gain an additional die on attack rolls. Discard the highest die of each roll.

name: •Peak and Pine (★ Attack)
description: This model can spend a corpse token to make a range 8, POW 12 arcane attack. If this attack damages an enemy model, this model’s Leader can transfer damage to the affected model one time, then Peak and Pine expires. Peak and Pine lasts for one round.

name: •Fog and Filthy Air
description:
During its activation, this model can spend a corpse token to use
Fog and Filthy Air. Target friendly Faction model within 5" of this model. If the model is in range, it gains Concealment for one round.

name: Live Deliciously
description: Friendly faction Shapeshifter models within 5" of this model gain Bloodthirst. (When a model with Bloodthirst charges a living or undead model, this model gains +2" movement.)

name: Distant Deployment [9"]
description: This model can be placed at the same time as your models with Advance Deployment, up to 9" beyond your deployment zone.

name: Spirit Nexus
description: This model begins the game with 1 fury point. During your Control Phase, this model receives 1 fury point if it does not have any. This model cannot have more than 1 fury point at any time. During a friendly Faction warlock’s activation, it can remove 1 fury point from this model in its control range and gain that fury point. Each warlock can do this only once per turn. When a warlock removes a fury point from this model, roll a d6. On a roll of 1 or 2, the spirits become angry and curse the warlock. A cursed warlock suffers –1 DEF and ARM for one round.

name: •Tenacity
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Feign Death for one round. (A model with Feign Death cannot be targeted by ranged or arcane attacks while knocked down.)

name: •Cacophony
description: While within 10" of this model, enemy models cannot cast or channel spells. Cacophony lasts for one round.

name: •Stir the Blood
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, each affected model gains +2 to its next melee attack damage roll this turn.

name: Accumulator [Storm Forge warrior]
description: When this model begins its activation within 3" of one or more friendly Storm Forge warrior models, this model gains 1 focus point.

name: Repulsor Field
description: When this model is hit with a melee attack, after the attack is resolved the attacking model is pushed 1" directly away from this model.

name: Party Foul
description: If this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, during your next Maintenance Phase one friendly Faction model can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack.

name: Top Off (★Action)
description: RNG B2B. Target Borka Kegslayer. If Borka Kegslayer is in range, he gains 2 fury points and Stumbling Drunk. Stumbling Drunk lasts for one round. (A model with Stumbling Drunk cannot become knocked down. If it is hit by an enemy attack at any time except while it is advancing, after the attack is resolved it is pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model.)

name: Attuned Spirit
description: Once per activation, this model can cast the animus of a warbeast in its battlegroup without spending fury.

name: Defiant Rage
description: When this model is damaged by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved this model gains +2 ARM and +2 to its melee attack damage rolls for one round.

name: Field Marshal [Northkin]
description: Warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup are Northkin models and gain Resistance: Cold.

name: Dismantle
description: This model gains an additional die on its melee and ranged damage rolls against constructs.

name: Drive: Dismantle
description: While within 10" of this model, a warjack under its control gains Dismantle.

name: Jury-Rigged
description: This model can use Jury-Rigged at the start of its activation. This activation, this model gains +2 SPD. At the end of the activation, this model suffers 1 damage point to its first available Movement system box. This model cannot use Jury-Rigged if its Movement system is crippled. Jury-Rigged can be used only once per activation.

name: Lash
description: This model and friendly warrior models B2B with it cannot become knocked down.

name: Bond [Damiano]
description: If this model begins the game in Damiano’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While this model is bonded to Damiano and in his control range, it gains Guard Dog. (While a model with Guard Dog is within 3" of its Leader and is not knocked down or stationary, its Leader gains +2 DEF against melee attack rolls and cannot become knocked down.)

name: Bond [Shae]
description: If Scallywag begins the game in Shae’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Scallywag is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While Scallywag is bonded to Shae and in his battlegroup, it gains Extended Control Range. (When checking to see if Scallywag is in Shae’s control range, double the range.)

name: Gang Fighter
description: When making a melee attack damage roll against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Faction warrior model, this model adds +2 to the roll.

name: No Sleeping on the Job [living Privateer]
description: This model and friendly living Privateer models within 10" of it cannot become knocked down.

name: Earth Magic
description: When a construct warbeast in this model’s battlegroup is forced to use its animus while in this model’s control range, reduce the COST of the animus by 1.

name: Stonebinder
description: Only construct warbeasts can be part of this model’s battlegroup. This model cannot take control of wild living warbeasts.

name: Slammer
description: This model can make slam power attacks without being forced. Models slammed by this model are moved an additional 2".

name: Controlled Warping
description: At the beginning of this model’s activation, choose one of the following warp effects. Warp effects last for one round. If this model frenzies it must choose Warp Strength at the start of its activation.

name: •Ghostly
description: This model can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.

name: •Spell Ward
description: This model cannot be targeted by spells.

name: Fight-or-Flight Instinct
description: This model can run or charge without being forced.

name: Leadership [Trollkin Highwaymen]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Trollkin Highwaymen models gain Dodge.

name: Run & Gun
description: At the end of its activation, if this model destroyed one or more enemy models with ranged attacks that activation, it can make a full advance.

name: Bond [Morvahna]
description: If Brennos begins the game in Morvahna’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Brennos is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Brennos is bonded to Morvahna and in her control range, she can channel spells through him.

name: •Earth Spikes (★Attack)
description: Earth Spikes is a RNG 10, AOE 2, POW 13/7 arcane attack. When making this attack, ignore cover and concealment. On a critical hit, models hit become knocked down.

name: Rites of Spring (★Action)
description: Remove d3 damage points from each friendly living Faction model currently within 6" of this model.

name: Bond [Maddox]
description: If Brickhouse begins the game in Maddox’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Brickhouse is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Brickhouse is bonded to Maddox, it gains Follow Up. (When a model with Follow Up slams an enemy model, immediately after the slam is resolved this model can advance directly toward the slammed model, up to the distance the slammed model was moved.)

name: Force Lock
description: Enemy models beginning an advance in this model’s melee range cannot advance.

name: •Combat Coordination
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model. If the model is in range, during its activation this turn, it can reroll one attack or damage roll, then Combat Coordination expires.

name: •Bring it Down
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the target model/unit is in range, it gains Combat Engineer this tun. (A model with Combat Engineer gains an additional die on its damage rolls against buildings and structures.)

name: Bacon
description: When this model is destroyed, each living warbeast within 1" of it can remove d3 damage points.

name: Companion [Rorsh]
description: This model is included in any army that includes Rorsh. If Rorsh is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Rorsh’s battlegroup.

name: Pain Response
description: While damaged, this model can charge and make power attacks without being forced.

name: Leadership [Titans]
description: When a friendly non-Bronzeback Titan ends its activation within 5" of this model, you can remove 1 fury point from that Titan.

name: Flank [Lug]
description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of Lug, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

name: Limited Battlegroup [Lug]
description: The only warbeast that can be in this model’s battlegroup is Lug.

name: Companion [Brun Cragback]
description: This model is included in any army that includes Brun Cragback. If Cragback is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Cragback’s battlegroup.

name: Return [Cragback]
description: Immediately after resolving a charge attack, this model can make a full advance toward Cragback.

name: •Blood Rage
description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend corpse tokens to make additional melee attacks. It can make one additional attack for each token spent.

name: Granted: Treewalker
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Treewalker. (A model with Treewalker ignores forests when determining LOS. While completely within a forest, a model with Treewalker gains +2 DEF against melee attack rolls.)

name: Habitable [Bunker]
description:
Small- and medium-based non-Leader warrior models can enter this building through a door on the lower level. A model/unit ending its Normal Movement within 1" of the door can choose to enter this building.  

Models entering this building can be placed on either the lower or upper levels. Models in a unit occupying this building can be placed on either floor or both. There can be up to five small-based models or three medium-based models on each floor. There must be room for a model’s base for it to be placed on the top floor.

name: Fortified Walls
description: Models cannot be targeted and do not suffer blast damage while occupying the lower level of this terrain feature.

name: Top Floor [Bunker]
description: The upper level of this building is considered to be elevated terrain.

name: Movement Inside the Bunker
description: Models/units can use their Normal Movement to be placed on the top floor if they were previously on the lower floor or to be placed on the lower floor if they were on the top floor. Units using their Normal Movement to be placed are considered to have moved. Models cannot otherwise move or be placed while occupying inside the building.

name: Out of Action
description: While occupying this building models/units cannot contest, control, hold, or secure flags, objectives, or zones.

name: •Dark Unraveling
description: This model can immediately negate any spell that targets it or a model within 3" of it by spending 1 corpse token. The negated spell does not take effect, but its COST remains spent.

name: Grave Secrets
description: If this model is in its Leader’s control range during your Control Phase, its Leader can spend corpse tokens on this model to upkeep one spell for each token spent.

name: Rattle Bones
description: While this model has one or more corpse tokens and is in its Leader’s control range, its Leader can channel spells through it.

name: War Weaver
description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with an arcane attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".

name: Fate Blessed
description: When a friendly Faction model makes an attack or damage roll during its activation while in this model’s control range, this model can spend 1 focus or fury point to allow the model to reroll that roll. Each roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Fate Blessed.

name: Bond [Asphyxious]
description: If Cankerworm begins the game in Asphyxious’ battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Cankerworm is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While bonded to Asphyxious and in his control range, Cankerworm gains Reposition [5"]. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [5"] can advance up to 5", then its activation ends.)

name: Salvage Harvester
description: When this model destroys an enemy Cohort model with a melee attack, after the attack is resolved remove d3+3 damage points from this model.

name: Field Marshal [Reposition 3"]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Reposition [3"]. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Temptations of Fate
description: While this model is within 3" of its warcaster, the warcaster gains Sucker!. (If a model with Sucker! is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, choose a friendly non-incorporeal warrior model within 3" of it to be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.)

name: Acrobatics
description: This model can advance through other models if it has enough movement to move completely past their bases. This model ignores intervening models when declaring its charge target.

name: Field Marshal [Sprint]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Sprint. (At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, a model with Sprint can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.)

name: •Defensive Measures (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction Cohort model. If the Cohort model is in range, it gains Shield Guard for one round. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

name: Bond [Stryker]
description: If Ol’ Rowdy begins the game in Stryker’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Ol’ Rowdy is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Ol’ Rowdy is bonded to Stryker and in his control range, both models gain +2 DEF against melee attack rolls and cannot become knocked down.

name: Defense Formation
description: While in this model’s control range and B2B with one or more models in its battlegroup, models in this model's battlegroup with an extra-large base or smaller gain +2 ARM and cannot become knocked down.

name: Field Marshal [Overtake]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Overtake.

name: Reciprocate
description: When it is missed by an enemy ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can make one basic ranged attack targeting the attacking model.

name: Leadership [Gun Mages]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Gun Mage models gain Reciprocate.

name: Field Marshal [Prowl]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Prowl.

name: Veteran Leader [Assault Strider]
description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Assault Strider models gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: No Sleeping on the Job [Gatorman]
description: This model and friendly Gatorman models within 10" of it cannot become knocked down.

name: Oath of Vengeance [Undead]
description: This model gains +2 to its attack and damage rolls against Undead models.

name: •Money Shot
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains +2 RAT and +2 to its ranged damage rolls for one turn.

name: Activate Halfjack
description: At the end of your Control Phase, you can put one Halfjack solo into play within 1" of this model if there are fewer than three Halfjacks in play in Darius’ battlegroup.

name: Companion [Captain E. Dominic Darius]
description: This model is included in any army that includes Captain E. Dominic Darius. If Darius is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Darius’ battlegroup. Place all three Halfjacks in play at the start of the game.

name: Prime Mine (★Action)
description: Replace this model with a mine marker. You can have up to three mine markers in play at any time. After resolving continuous effects during your Maintenance Phase, you can detonate any number of friendly mine markers. Models within 3" of a mine marker suffer an unboostable POW 14 blast damage roll, then the mine marker is removed from the table.

name: Repair [1] (★Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove 1 damage point from it.

name: Reserve Accumulator
description: Once per turn during your Control Phase after replenishing focus, if this model is within 5" of its controlling Leader, the Leader can gain 1 focus point. If the Leader gains a focus point, roll a d6. On the roll of 1 or 2, this model loses the Reserve Accumulator special rule for the rest of the game.

name: Sigil of Power (★ Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. Sigil of Power lasts for one turn.

name: Field Marshal [Black Penny]
description: The ranged weapons of Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Black Penny. [Attacks made with weapons with Black Penny ignore the target in melee DEF bonus.]

name: Fortune Hunter
description: This model gains an additional die on its attack and damage rolls against character models.

name: Field Marshal [Run & Gun]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Run & Gun. (At the end of its activation, if it destroyed one or more enemy models with ranged attacks that activation, a model with Run & Gun can make a full advance.)

name: Iron Horse
description: Warjacks in this model’s battlegroup activating in this model's control range gain Pathfinder and Reposition [3"]. Additionally, warjacks in this model’s battlegroup activating in this model’s control range gain +2 SPD when resolving charges. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Field Marshal [True Sight]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain True Sight.

name: Guns Blazing
description: This model can use Guns Blazing once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. This activation, models in this unit can make one additional ranged attack during this unit’s Combat Action.

name: •At All Costs
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Shield Guard for one round. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack during your opponent’s turn while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard directly hit instead. It is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

name: •Press the Advantage
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Swift Hunter for one turn. (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

name: Battle Configuration [Sky Stormer or Ground Assault]
description: Before the start of the game and at the start of each of your Maintenance Phases after your first turn, choose a configuration for this model to take: Sky Stormer or Ground Assault. Use that configuration’s stats and rules for one round.

name: Field Marshal [Steady & Sturdy]
description: Cohort models in this model's battlegroup cannot become knocked down or pushed.

name: Field Marshal [Gang Fighter]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Gang Fighter. (When making a melee attack damage roll against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Faction warrior model, this model adds +2 to the roll.)

name: Call to Sacrifice [Revenant]
description: If this model is disabled by an enemy attack, you can choose a non-disabled friendly Revenant trooper model within 5" of this model to be destroyed. If another model is destroyed as a result of Call to Sacrifice, remove 1 damage point from this model.

name: Veteran Leader [Revenant]
description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Revenant models gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: Veteran Leader [Devil Dog]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Devil Dog models gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: Elite Cadre [Brineblood Marauder Warrior]
description: Friendly non-Leader Faction warrior models gain Undead.

name: Earthworks
description: After deployment but before the first turn, place three Trapdoor markers within 24" of the rear edge of your Deployment Zone and not with 5" of each other.

name: Field Marshal [Ambush and Tunnel Ambush]
description: Medium based cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Ambush and Tunnel Ambush. (When a model with Tunnel Ambush ambushes, instead of being deployed to a table edge, it can be placed in base contact with a friendly Trapdoor marker. The marker is then removed from the table.)

name: Brute Force
description: Each turn, the first medium based cohort model in this model’s battlegroup to ambush gains Sneak Attack until the end of the turn. (The turn a model with Sneak Attack ambushes, it gains +2 to attack and damage rolls against models within 5".)

name: Arcane Vortex
description: This model can immediately negate any spell that targets it or a model within 3" of it by spending 1 focus or fury point. The negated spell does not take effect, but its COST remains spent.

name: Alcohol-Fueled
description: This model cannot forfeit its Normal Movement. When this model makes its Normal Movement, instead of moving it normally you must choose the direction it is moving. It then advances its SPD +d6 in a straight line. On a roll of 6, instead of moving this model explodes with the same effect as Temperamental and is removed from play.

name: Temperamental
description: This model explodes if it contacts an enemy model while advancing or if it becomes knocked down. When this model explodes, models within 2" of it suffer an unboostable POW 12 fire damage roll and the Fire continuous effect, then this model is removed from play.

name: Channeler [Wurmwood, Tree of Fate]
description: While this model is in Wurmwood, Tree of Fate’s control range, Wurmwood can channel spells through it.

name: Fury-Bound
description: While in Wurmwood’s control range, this model can spend fury points on Wurmwood to make additional melee attacks or to boost attack or damage rolls. It can make one additional attack or boost one roll for each fury point spent.

name: Companion [Wurmwood, Tree of Fate]
description: This model is included in any army that includes Wurmwood, Tree of Fate. If Wurmwood is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Wurmwood’s battlegroup. This model is also attached to Wurmwood. Each Leader can have only one model/unit attached to it.

name: Combustion (★ Attack)
description: This attack does not need a target. Other models within 2" of this model suffer a POW 12 fire damage roll and the Fire continuous effect. Combustion damage is simultaneous. This model can make additional melee attacks after making this special attack.

name: Granted: Bulldoze
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Bulldoze. (When a model with Bulldoze is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when a model makes a trample power attack.)

name: Granted: Sacred Ward
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Sacred Ward. (A model with Sacred Ward cannot be targeted by enemy spells.)

name: Fury Bank
description: While this model is in a friendly Faction warlock’s control range during the warlock’s activation, the warlock can move fury points from itself to this model at any time. This model can have up to 3 fury points at any time. During its Combat Action, this model can spend fury points to boost one attack or damage roll for each fury point spent.

name: Power of the Stones
description: During your Control Phase, this model can leech fury from friendly Faction construct warbeasts within 10" of it.

name: Leadership [Paladin]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Paladin models gain Girded.

name: Phantasmal Field
description: This model gains +1 DEF against ranged and arcane attack rolls for each focus point on it.

name: Bond [Xekaar]
description: If Chiron begins the game in Xekaar’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Chiron is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Chiron is bonded to Xekaar and in his control range, it gains boosted ranged attack rolls.

name: Leadership [Basilisks]
description: When another friendly Basilisk model ends its activation while within 10" of this model, you can remove 1 fury point from that model.

name: •Passage (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warjack. If the target warjack is in range, it cannot be targeted by non-magical ranged attacks. Passage lasts for one round.

name: •Battle (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warjack. If the target warjack is in range, it gains +2 to its damage rolls. Battle lasts for one turn.

name: Hymn
description: When a model in this unit performs a Hymn special action, choose a hymn. Each activation, all models in this unit performing a hymn must perform the same one. A model can only be affected by one hymn at any time.

name: •Shielding (★Action)
description: RNG 5.  Target friendly Faction warjack. If the target warjack is in range, it cannot be targeted by enemy spells. Shielding lasts for one round.

name: Homicidal Maniac
description: If there are no models in this model’s melee range after resolving a basic melee attack in which this model destroyed one or more enemy models, this model can advance up to 1".

name: Tunnel Ambush
description: When a model with Tunnel Ambush ambushes, instead of being deployed to a table edge, it can be placed in base contact with a friendly Trapdoor marker. The marker is then removed from the table.

name: Foul Stench
description: While within 5" of this model, living enemy warbeasts suffer –1 FURY and THR.

name: Time Stutter
description: Once per turn, when one or more of this model’s aspects are crippled by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved place this model anywhere completely within 3" of its current location.

name: Realignment
description: This model can use Realignment once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. This activation, models in this unit can reroll failed attack rolls this turn. Each roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Realignment.

name: Field Marshal [Reposition 3"]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Reposition [3"]. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Mechanikally Adept
description: This model can target non-Faction models with Repair special actions.

name: Butcher's Bill
description: If one or more friendly warrior models were damaged by enemy attacks while in this model's control range during your opponent’s last turn, during your Maintenance Phase one model in this model’s battlegroup in its control range can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.

name: Activate Rocket Turret
description: Once per turn at any time during Brisbane’s activation, you can place a Rocket Turret anywhere completely within 3" of him unless he already has a Rocket Turret in play. The Rocket Turret cannot activate the turn it is put into play.

name: Desperate Pace [Trencher] (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Trencher trooper model. If the model is in range,  models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

name: Rocket Pack
description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can spend one focus point to use Rocket Pack. During that activation, this model gains +2 SPD and Flight.

name: Companion [Colonel Brisbane]
description: This model is included in any army that includes Colonel Markus "Siege" Brisbane. If Brisbane is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Brisbane’s battlegroup.

name: Pack It Up
description: If this model is in play during your Maintenance Phase, you can remove it from play.

name: Sentry Fire
description: Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement or is placed within 8" of this model, this model can immediately make one basic ranged attack targeting that model.

name: Turret
description: This model cannot advance. This model cannot become knocked down or be pushed and is automatically hit by melee attacks. This model does not suffer blast damage.

name: Acid Treatment (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target model's ranged and melee weapons gain Continuous Effect Corrosion for one round.

name: Heat Treatment (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target model's ranged and melee weapons gain Continuous Effect Fire for one round.

name: Magical Treatment (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target model's ranged and melee weapons gain Damage Type Magical for one round.

name: Arcane Accumulator
description: When another model in this model’s control range casts a spell, this model gains one power token. This model can have up to three power tokens at any time. After this model replenishes its focus during your next Control Phase, replace each power token with 1 focus point.

name: Overpower
description: After this model replenishes its focus during your Control Phase but before it allocates focus, this model can spend focus to increase its control range for one round by 2" for each focus point spent.

name: Foxhole Buddy
description: While B2B with a friendly model that is dug in, this model gains cover, Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS.

name: Bond [Siege]
description: If Triumph begins the game in Siege’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Triumph is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Triumph is bonded to Siege and in his control range, it gains boosted ranged attack damage rolls.

name: Chain Attack: Flash
description: If this model hits the same target with both its initial melee attacks, after resolving the attacks you can immediately place this model anywhere completely within 3" of its current location.

name: Reversal
description: When a model misses this model with a charge or a power attack, the attacking model becomes knocked down.

name: Snap Strike
description: This model can make one additional attack with each melee weapon for each focus or fury point spent to make additional attacks.

name: Mission Objective
description: Once per game at any time during its unit’s activation, this model can use Mission Objective. When it does, choose an enemy model/unit in this model’s LOS. This activation, models in this unit gains +2 to attack and damage rolls against the chosen model/unit.

name: Granted: Reposition [2"]
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Reposition [2"]. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [2"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 2", then its activation ends.)

name: Paint Target (★Action)
description: RNG 3. Target enemy model. If the model is within range, it suffers Flare. (A model suffering Flare loses Stealth and suffers  –2 DEF for one turn.)

name: Monkey Bite
description: While in melee with this model, living enemy models suffer –2 to melee attack rolls.

name: Open Bar
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly living Faction models with a large or smaller base gain Stumbling Drunk.

name: Leadership [Faction Warrior Models]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly faction warrior models gain Prowl.

name: Hide on Bush
description: When this model ends its activation with concealment, it gains Admonition for one round. (When an enemy model advances and ends its movement or is placed within 6" of a model with Admonition, the model with Admonition can immediately advance up to 3", then Admonition expires.)

name: Self-Propelled
description: This model cannot forfeit its Normal Movement. When this model makes its Normal Movement, instead of moving it normally you must choose the direction it is moving. It then advances its SPD +d6 in a straight line. On a roll of 6, instead of moving this model explodes with the same effect as Explosive Decomposition and is removed from play.

name: Explosive Decomposition
description: This model explodes if it contacts an enemy model while advancing or if it becomes knocked down. When this model explodes, models within 2" of it suffer an unboostable POW 12 corrosion damage roll and the Corrosion continuous effect, then this model is removed from play.

name: Inconsequential
description: This model can not score or contest Objectives, Scenario terrain, or Caches.

name: Battle-Driven
description: When one or more models in this unit are damaged by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved models in this unit gains +2 ARM, +2 to their melee attack damage rolls, and Pathfinder for one round.

name: Granted: Dual Shot
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Dual Shot. (If a model with Dual Shot uses its Normal Movement to aim, it can make one additional ranged attack this activation.)

name: All-Terrain (★Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, it gains Pathfinder for one turn.

name: Granted: Dodge
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Dodge. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

name: •Rituals of Shadow (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly horror. If the horror was in range, it gains 1 essence point.

name: •Touch of Darkness (★Action)
description: RNG 3. Target friendly living soulless model. If that model is in range, remove d3 damage points from it.

name: Granted: Self-Sacrifice
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Self-Sacrifice. (If a model with Self-Sacrifice is disabled by an enemy attack, you can choose a non-disabled model in its unit within 3" of the model with Self-Sacrifice to be destroyed and the model with Self-Sacrifice removes 1 damage point.)

name: •Annihilation (★Attack)
description: Annihilation is a RNG 10, AOE 2, POW 10/10 arcane attack. Models destroyed by Annihilation are removed from play and do not generate corpse tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed by Annihilation, the spellcaster gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

name: •Knowledge of the Damned
description: When a model in this model’s control range makes an attack or damage roll, this model can spend a soul token to cause that model to reroll the roll. Each roll can be rerolled only once due to Knowledge of the Damned.

name: Future Sight
description: This model can boost attack and damage rolls after rolling.

name: Craft Talisman (★ Action)
description: RNG 5. Target a friendly Leader model. If the Leader is in range, when it casts a spell and is the point of origin, the spell gains +2 RNG. Spells with RNG SELF or CTRL are not affected. Craft Talisman lasts for one turn.

name: Primal Magic
description: This model can be forced to cast the animus of any friendly Faction warbeast within 5" of it as if the animus were its own.

name: Charmer
description: When a friendly warbeast would frenzy in this model’s control range, instead of frenzying the warbeast can forfeit its activation.

name: Limited Battlegroup [Skarath]
description: The only warbeast that can be in this model’s battlegroup is Skarath.

name: Bond [Dahlia Hallyr]
description: Skarath begins the game in Dahlia Hallyr’s battlegroup and is bonded to her. Skarath is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. If Skarath is bonded to Dahlia and in her control range, Skarath gains an additional die on attack rolls against models in Hallyr’s control range.

name: Take Down
description: Models disabled by a melee attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by a melee attack made by this model are removed from play.

name: •Death Ride (★Action)
description: Friendly Faction undead models activating within 5" of this model gain +1" movement when advancing as part of their Normal Movement. Death Ride lasts for one turn.

name: •Hellfire (★Attack)
description: Hellfire is a RNG 10, POW 14 arcane attack. Models disabled by Hellfire cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by Hellfire are removed from play.

name: •Invocation of Darkest Night (★Action)
description: This model gains Mortal Fear. Invocation of Darkest Night lasts for one round. (While within 8" of a model with Mortal Fear, living enemy models suffer -2 to damage rolls.)

name: Leadership [Dawnguard Destors]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Dawnguard Destor models gain Tough and Steady.

name: Extended Fire
description: This model can use Extended Fire once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. This activation, the ranged weapons of models in this unit gain Snipe. (An attack with a weapon with Snipe gains +3 RNG.)

name: •Deathly Strike
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, its melee weapons gain Grievous Wounds for one turn. (On a direct hit, a model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)

name: Build Up Power
description: If this model advances during its Normal Movement, it gains 3 power tokens. This model can have up to three power tokens at any time. During its activation, this model can spend power tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.

name: Coordinated Movement
description: Friendly models can ignore this model when determining LOS and can advance through this model if they have enough movement to move completely past it.

name: Psycho Matrix
description: This model can spend power tokens to use the following effects:

name: •Force Shield
description: At any time during its activation, this model can spend one power token to gain Force Barrier for one round. (A model with Force Barrier gains +2 DEF against ranged attack rolls and gains Resistance: Blast.)

name: •Telekinetic Wave
description: When this model ends its Normal Movement, it can spend one power token to use Telekinetic Wave. When it does so, choose one non-huge-based friendly Faction Cohort model within 2" of it. You can place the chosen model any where completely within 2" of its current location. A model can be placed as a result of Telekinetic Wave only once per turn.

name: Flank [friendly Faction Cohort model]
description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of a friendly Faction Cohort model, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

name: Never Ending Pile
description: At the start of this model’s activation, if it does not have any corpse tokens, it gains one corpse token.

name: Special Delivery
description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can remove any number of corpse tokens and place them on a friendly model that can gain corpse tokens within 5" of it.

name: Warmth of the Grave
description: While this model has one or more corpse tokens, friendly Faction models gain +2 ARM while within 4" of this model +1" for each corpse token on this model.

name: Cannibal Magic
description: When a damage roll against this model exceeds its ARM, it can spend a corpse token to suffer 1 damage point instead of the total rolled.

name: Soul Taker: Collector
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed while within 10" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

name: Skulls of Hate
description: This model is a spellcaster. During your Control Phase, this model gains 1 soul token for each of its non-crippled arm systems.

name: •Necrotheurgy
description: Once during its activation this model can spend a soul token to cast a spell without spending focus.

name: •Soul Generator
description: At the start of this model’s activation, you can spend soul tokens on this model to give it 1 focus point for each token spent.

name: •Devour Soul
description: At any time during its activation this model can spend one soul token to remove d3 damage.

name: •Necromancy
description: While this model is in its controller’s control range, it can spend focus points to cast its controller’s spells. This model cannot cast upkeep spells or spells with a RNG of SELF or CTRL.

name: Hate Fueled
description: This model can have up to 5 focus points at any time instead of the normal limit of 3. During your Control Phase, after focus allocation this model gains 1 focus point for each of its non-crippled arm systems.

name: Dark Restoration
description: If Goreshade is disabled while within 5" of this model, this model is destroyed and 1 damage point is removed from Goreshade.

name: Companion [Goreshade The Bastard]
description: This model is included in any army that includes Goreshade The Bastard. If Goreshade is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Goreshade’s battlegroup.

name: Breath Taker
description: Living enemy models suffer –2 DEF and –2 to their melee attack damage rolls while within 5" of this model.

name: •Burning Ash (★ Action)
description: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. While in the template, living enemy models without Immunity: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls.

name: Leadership [Weapon Crew]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly weapon crew models gain Reposition [3"].

name: Soul Mastery
description: At any time during its activation, this model can spend soul tokens to use one of the following effects for each token spent:

name: •Dark Whispers
description: This model can cast a spell with COST 3 or less without spending focus.

name: •Vengeful Spirits
description: Choose a cohort model in this model’s battlegroup within 10" of it. That cohort model gains up to 3 focus points.

name: Soul Weaver
description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can remove soul tokens from one friendly Faction model within 10" of it and place them on itself.

name: Side Step
description: When this model hits an enemy model with an initial melee attack or a melee special attack, it can advance up to 2" after the attack is resolved.

name: Accumulator [Bane]
description: When this model begins its activation within 3" of one or more friendly Bane warrior models, this model gains 1 focus point.

name: Multiple Heads [5]
description: This model can make 5 initial attacks each Combat Action, using any combination of Acid Spray and Bite attacks. This model loses one initial attack for each of its aspects that are currently crippled. This model cannot be forced to make additional Acid Spray attacks.

name: Regeneration [d3 +3]
description: This model can be forced to remove d3 +3 damage points once per activation. This model cannot use Regeneration during an activation it runs.

name: Bond [Mordikaar]
description: If Despoiler begins the game in Mordikaar’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Despoiler is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Despoiler is bonded to Mordikaar and in his control range, once per turn when a living enemy warrior model is boxed while within 5" of this model, remove the boxed model from play and replace it with a friendly Void Spirit model.

name: Superconduction [8"]
description: When a friendly Faction model makes an attack with a ranged weapon with Damage Type: Electricity targeting an enemy model within 8" of this model, the attacking model gains +2 to its attack roll.

name: Accumulator [Gun Mage]
description: When this model begins its activation within 3" of one or more friendly Gun Mage models, this model gains 1 focus point.

name: Rain of Death (★ Attack)
description: This attack does not need a target. Models B2B with this model suffer a POW 18 blast damage roll. Other models within 3" of this model suffer a POW 9 blast damage roll. When this model charges, instead of making a charge attack it can make a Rain of Death attack. Rain of Death damage is simultaneous. After a Rain of Death attack, this model can make additional melee attacks. This model is not affected by Rain of Death.

name: Wild Communion
description: When a warbeast within 3" of this model makes a Threshold check, you can have the warbeast reroll one or more dice of your choice. Dice can be rerolled only once as a result of Wild Communion.

name: Repair [d6] (★ Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d6 damage points from it.

name: Chop Shop
description: When a model in this model's battlegroup destroys an enemy construct model with a melee attack, remove d3 +1 damage points from one model in this model's battlegroup currently in its control range and remove the destroyed model from play.

name: Field Marshal [Retaliatory Strike]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Retaliatory Strike. (If a model with Retaliatory Strike is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved the model with Retaliatory Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. A model can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

name: Bond [Rahn]
description: If Discordia begins the game in Rahn’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Discordia is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. When Discordia spends a focus point to use Focus-Charged: Kinetic Field while it is bonded to Rahn and in his control range, Rahn also gains Kinetic Field for one round.

name: Focus-Charged: Kinetic Field
description: This model can spend 1 focus point at any time during its activation to gain Kinetic Field for one round. (A model with Kinetic Field and friendly Faction models within 3" of it gain +2 ARM against ranged attacks and gain: Resistance Blast.)

name: •Heal [d6] (★Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly living Faction model. If the model is in range, remove d6 damage points from it.

name: No, I’m Fine
description: When a friendly Privateer model makes a Tough roll of 4, 5, or 6 while within 10" of this model, that model removes 1 damage point and becomes knocked down.

name: •Coagulum of Entropy
description: RNG 5. Target friendly faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Resistance: Corrosion. When an affected model is hit by a melee attack, the attacking model suffers the Corrosion continuous effect. Coagulum of Entropy lasts for one round.

name: •Fortemorphic Elixir
description: RNG 5. Target friendly faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and gains Overtake. Fortemorphic Elixir lasts for one round. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

name: •The Good Stuff
description: RNG 5. Target friendly faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Tough and cannot become knocked down but suffers –1 to attack rolls. The Good Stuff lasts for one round.

name: Heal [d3 +2] (★Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly living Faction model. If the model is in range, remove d3 +2 damage points from it.

name: Revivifier
description: This model can use Revivifier once per game at any time during its activation. While within 5" of this model, friendly Faction warrior models gain Tough. Additionally, when a friendly Faction warrior model makes a Tough roll of 4, 5, or 6 while within 5" of this model, that model can remove 1 damage point. Revivifier lasts for one round.

name: Overtake
description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".

name: •Influence (★Attack)
description: Influence is a RNG 10 arcane attack. Take control of target enemy non-Leader warrior model hit. The model immediately makes one basic attack, then Influence expires. A model can be affected by Influence only once per turn.

name: Granted: Inspiration
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: Granted: Inspiration
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: Combined Arms
description: When this model misses an attack roll for a combined ranged attack, it can reroll that attack roll. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Combined Arms.

name: •Cleansing Fire (★Attack)
description: Cleansing Fire is a RNG 8, AOE 2, POW 14/8 arcane attack that causes fire damage. On a critical hit, models hit suffer the Fire continuous effect.

name: •Smoke Bombs (★Action)
description: Center a cloud effect template on this model. This template remains in play for one round.

name: Granted: Silence
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit do not have to make Berserk attacks.

name: •Fell Curse (★Action)
description: While within 5" of this model, enemy models lose Tough and cannot have damage removed from them. Fell Curse lasts for one round.

name: Sacrificial Pawn [Doom Reaver]
description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Doom Reaver model within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

name: Bond [Gunnbjorn]
description: If Dozer & Smigg begin the game in Gunnbjorn’s battlegroup, they are bonded to him. Dozer & Smigg are not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Dozer & Smigg are bonded to Gunnbjorn and in his control range, they gain boosted ranged attack damage rolls.

name: Booster Shot (★ Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction warbeast model. If the warbeast is in range, it suffers 1 damage point and all attack and damage rolls resulting from its next basic attack this turn are boosted.

name: Field Marshal [Channeler]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Channeler. (While a model with Channeler is in a friendly Faction Leader’s control range, the Leader can channel spells through it.)

name: Bond [Vladimir]
description: If Drago begins the game in Vladimir’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Drago is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While bonded to Vladimir and in his control range, Drago gains Poltergeist. (When an enemy model misses a model with Poltergeist with an attack, immediately after the attack is resolved you can choose to push the enemy model d3" directly away from the model with Poltergeist.)

name: Mental Domination [Overtake]
description: While in this model’s control range, warbeasts in its battlegroup gain Overtake. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

name: Ferocity
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain +2 SPD when making a charge.

name: Shortsighted
description: This model cannot upkeep spells.

name: Struggle of Wills
description: Before the start of the game and at the start of each of your Maintenance Phases after your first turn, choose which mind is dominant: Sturm or Drang. Use that mind’s stats and rules for one round.

name: Body Snatcher: Bag Man
description: A model disabled by a melee attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll. When this model destroys a living or undead enemy model with a melee attack, this model gains the destroyed model’s corpse token and the destroyed model is removed from play. This model can have up to one corpse token at any time.

name: Victuals You Can Neither Raise Nor Buy
