description: At any time during its activation while within 5" of this model, a friendly non-Dread Rot model with a Body Snatcher special rule can remove corpse tokens from this model and place them on itself.

name: Vampiric
description: When this model destroys a living or undead model with a melee or ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can remove d3 damage points.

name: •Awaken the Void
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Soulless trooper model. If the model is in range, the weapons of models in its unit gain Blessed for one turn.

name: •Desperate Pace [Soulless]
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Soulless trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

name: Dogfighter
description: This model gains boosted attack and damage rolls against models with Flight.

name: Superconduction [3"]
description: When a friendly Faction model makes an attack with a ranged weapon with Damage Type: Electricity targeting an enemy model within 3" of this model, the attacking model gains +2 to its attack roll.

name: GMP Blast
description: When this model is destroyed, models within 2" of it and without Resistance: Electricity, suffer disruption.

name: Targetable
description: This model can be targeted by attacks made by either player. Friendly models cannot target this model with a charge

name: Cerebral Channeling
description: While this model is in a friendly Faction Leader’s control range, the Leader can channel spells through it. After a spell has been channeled through this model it becomes disabled.

name: Mind Burst
description: Once per turn at any time during this model's activation, you can choose one grunt in this unit. Enemy models within 2" of the chosen grunt suffer an unboostable POW 12 magic blast damage roll, then the chosen grunt is removed from play.

name: Granted: Shield Guard
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Shield Guard. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

name: Granted: Blood-Bound
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Blood-Bound. (When a model with Blood-Bound destroys a living enemy model with an attack, after the attack is resolved you can return one destroyed model in its unit to play. Place the returned model completely within 3" of the attacking model. The returned model cannot activate the turn it returns to play. The destroyed enemy model is removed from play and does not provide a soul or corpse token.)

name: Granted: Ambush
description: This unit gains Ambush.

name: •Obscuring Mist (★ Action)
description: Models in this unit gain concealment for one round.

name: Divine Retribution
description: This model can use Divine Retribution once per game at any time during its unit's activation. This activation, models in this unit gain Divine Inspiration. (A model with Divine Inspiration gains an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls. Discard the lowest die of each roll.)

name: Granted: Elemental Power
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Resistance: Cold, Resistance: Corrosion, Resistance: Electricity, and Resistance: Fire.

name: •Dig In (★Action)
description: This model gains cover, gains Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged. It can begin the game dug in.

name: •Wind Strike (★Attack)
description: Wind Strike is a RNG 10, POW 10 arcane attack. An enemy model hit by this attack can be pushed d3" directly away from this model.

name: Granted: Battle Wizard
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Battle Wizard. (Once per turn, when a model with Battle Wizard destroys or removes from play one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved it can make one Magic Ability special attack or special action.)

name: Field Marshal [Continuous Fire]
description: The ranged weapons of Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Continuous Effect: Fire.

name: Leadership [Rhul Guard warriors]
description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Rhul Guard warrior models gain Hit the Deck! (Ignore a model with Hit the Deck! when determining which models would be hit by an AOE. If a model with Hit the Deck! would be hit by an AOE, it instead becomes knocked down. While this model is knocked down, ranged attacks targeting a model with Hit the Deck! automatically miss.)

name: Elemental Communion
description: While within 2" of shallow water, this model gains +2 DEF. While within 2" of an obstacle or obstruction, this model gains +2 ARM. If this model begins its activation within 2" of rough terrain, it gains +2 SPD this activation.

name: Black Mantle
description: While B2B with this model, friendly Faction models gain Stealth.

name: Sympathetic Link
description: When this model would suffer damage, it can spend 1 focus point to reduce the damage by 5. Assign the remaining damage to one or more Witch Coven of Garlghast models, divided as you choose. Coven models cannot spend focus points to reduce this damage. A Witch cannot be assigned more damage points than she has unmarked damage boxes. This model does not suffer that damage.

name: Arcane Stasis
description: Friendly models can upkeep spells on this model without spending focus or fury points.

name: Spell Breaker
description: When this model hits another model with an attack, enemy upkeep spells on the model hit expire. A spellcaster can keep its upkeep spells in play by suffering d3 damage points.

name: Witch Hunter
description: When an enemy model declares it is casting a spell while within 10" of this model, this model can immediately make a basic attack targeting the enemy spellcaster. If the spellcaster is destroyed as a result of this damage, the spell does not take effect.

name: Field Marshal [Retaliatory Strike]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Retaliatory Strike.

name: Bond [Garryth]
description: If Moros begins the game in Garryth’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Moros is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Moros is bonded to Garryth and in his control range, it gains Acrobatics. (A model with Acrobatics can advance through other models if it has enough movement to move completely past their bases. A model with Acrobatics ignores intervening models when declaring its charge target.)

name: Oracular Vision
description: Once per turn when this model is directly hit by an attack, it can immediately spend 1 focus or fury point to not suffer a damage roll from the attack.

name: Force Gate
description: This model can spend focus points at any time during its activation to gain the following special rules, one per focus point spent. Force Gate special rules last for one round. This model loses all benefits of Force Gate while its G system is crippled.

name: •Broadcast Power
description: Other friendly Faction warjacks that activate within 6" of this model gain 1 focus point at the start of their activations. A warjack can gain only 1 focus point per round as a result of Broadcast Power.

name: •Distortion Field
description: This model gains +2 DEF.

name: •Repulsor Field
description: When this model is hit with a melee attack, after the attack is resolved the attacking model is pushed 1" directly away from this model.

name: Configuration
description: At the start of each of this model’s activations, it gains +2 MAT or RAT until the start of its next activation.

name: Reinforcements [small or medium-based constructs]
description: During your Maintenance Phase, return d3 small or medium-based friendly destroyed construct Grunts to play. Models return with 1 unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts within 8" this model and within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

name: Variable
description: At the start of this unit’s activation, choose one of the following effects. The chosen effect lasts for one round.

name: •Accuracy
description: This model gains +2 on its attack rolls.

name: •Shields Up
description: This model's weapons gain the Buckler advantage

name: Bond [Scaverous]
description: If this model begins the game in Scaverous’ battlegroup, it is bonded to him. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While this model is bonded to Scaverous and in his control range, he can channel spells through it.

name: Outrage
description: When this model is damaged by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved this model gains +2 ARM, +2 to its melee attack damage rolls, and Pathfinder for one round.

name: Set Defense
description: Models suffer –2 on charge and slam power attack rolls against this model.

name: Drive: Rhythm of Steel
description: While within 10" of this model, a warjack under its control gains Flank [Bastion]. (When a model with Flank [Bastion] makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of a friendly Bastion model, the model with Flank gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.)

name: Leadership [Exemplar Bastions]
description: Friendly Exemplar Bastion models can remove 1 damage point when they begin an activation within 10" of one or more Exemplar Bastion Seneschals

name: Bond [Kreoss]
description: If this model begins the game in Kreoss’ battlegroup, it is bonded to him. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While this model is bonded to Kreoss and in his control range, it gains Divine Inspiration. (A model with Divine Inspiration gains an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls. Discard the lowest die of each roll.)

name: Roadblock
description: This model provides cover to friendly models as if it were an obstacle. This model loses Roadblock while it is incorporeal or knocked down.

name: Sanguine Bond
description: When this model would suffer damage from an enemy attack, you can choose one or more models in its unit to suffer any amount of that damage instead, divided as you choose. If you do, this model does not suffer that damage. A model cannot suffer more damage as a result of Sanguine Bond than it has unmarked damage boxes.

name: Granted: Take Down
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Take Down. (Models disabled by a melee attack made by a model with Take Down cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by a melee attack made by a model with Take Down are removed from play.)

name: Granted: Sturdy
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit cannot be pushed.

name: Self-Sacrifice
description: If this model is disabled by an enemy attack, you can choose a non-disabled model in this unit within 3" of this model to be destroyed and this model removes 1 damage point.

name: Granted: Dual Attack
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Dual Attack.

name: Purity
description: This model can use Purity once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. Enemy upkeep spells and animi on this unit immediately expire. Models in this unit cannot be targeted by enemy spells. Purity lasts for one round.

name: Call to Sacrifice [Exemplar Errant trooper]
description: If this model is disabled by an enemy attack, you can choose a non-disabled friendly Exemplar Errant trooper model within 5" of this model to be destroyed. If another model is destroyed as a result of Call to Sacrifice, remove 1 damage point from this model.

name: Leadership [Exemplar Errants]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Exemplar Errants models gain Unyielding.

name: Self-Sacrifice
description: If this model is disabled by an enemy attack, you can choose a non-disabled model in this unit within 3" of this model to be destroyed and this model removes 1 damage point.

name: Call to Sacrifice [Exemplar Errant trooper]
description: If this model is disabled by an enemy attack, you can choose a non-disabled friendly Exemplar Errant trooper model within 5" of this model to be destroyed. If another model is destroyed as a result of Call to Sacrifice, remove 1 damage point from this model.

name: Inhuman Resolve
description: When a friendly Faction model within 10" of this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved this model can remove 1 damage point. When this model is disabled, it becomes knocked down instead of becoming boxed and its activation immediately ends. While this model is disabled, it cannot activate. If this model is disabled at the beginning of your Maintenance Phase, it is destroyed.

name: Companion [Iron Mother Directrix]
description: Two of these models are included in any army that includes Iron Mother Directrix. If Directrix is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Directrix’s battlegroup.

name: Sacrificial Pawn [Immortal]
description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Immortal model within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

name: •Grave Mist
description: At any time during its activation, this model can spend one soul token to give models in its unit +2 DEF for one round.

name: Leadership [Construct]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Construct models cannot become knocked down.

name: •Stones’ Wrath (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, it gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls this turn.

name: •Spirit Guide (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction model with Soul Taker: Requiem. If the model is in range, move any number of soul tokens to it from this model.

name: Bond [Malekus]
description: If Eye of Truth begins the game in Malekus’ battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Eye of Truth is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While Eye of Truth is bonded to Malekus and in his control range, he can channel spells through it.

name: Holy Light
description: While within 5" of this model, friendly models ignore bonuses from spells that add to an enemy model’s ARM or DEF.

name: •Desperate Mission
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model. If the model is in range, it gains Last Word. Desperate Mission lasts for one round. (When a model with Last Word is disabled by an enemy attack, it can immediately advance up to 3" and can make one basic melee attack.)

name: Guard Dog
description: While this model is within 3" of its Leader and is not knocked down or stationary, its Leader gains +2 DEF against melee attack rolls and cannot become knocked down.

name: Total Devotion
description: While this model is within 10" of its Leader, it gains +4 ARM and cannot become knocked down.

name: •Condition (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, you can place 1 fury point on it or remove 1 fury point from it.

name: Hit the Deck!
description: Ignore this model when determining which models would be hit by an AOE. If it would be hit by an AOE, it instead becomes knocked down. While this model is knocked down, ranged attacks targeting it automatically miss.

name: Arcane Sinkhole
description: Once per turn at any point during Wroughtmourn’s activation, choose a friendly Trapdoor marker in her control range. While within 5" of the marker, enemy models cannot cast or channel spells. Arcane Sinkhole lasts for one round.

name: Earthen Conduit
description: Wroughtmourn can determine line of sight and channel spells through friendly Trapdoor markers in her control range. After using a Trapdoor marker to channel, remove it from the table.

name: Leadership [Fennblade]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Fennblade models gain Side Step.

name: Leadership [Doom Reavers]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Doom Reaver models gain Relentless Charge.

name: Field Marshal [Aggressive]
description: Warjacks in this model’s battlegroup can run or charge without spending focus.

name: Whip the Flames
description: Enemy models suffering the fire continuous effect while in this model’s control range suffer –2 to attack rolls.

name: Caustic Presence [Fire]
description: Fire continuous effects that affect enemy models in this model’s control range cannot expire.

name: Righteous Flames
description: An enemy model that ends its activation within 2" of this model suffers the Fire continuous effect.

name: •Protective Plates
description: This model gains +2 ARM.

name: •Warp Speed
description: This model gains +2 SPD.

name: Spirit Bind
description: When a living warbeast within 5" of this model is destroyed but not removed from play by an attack, you can remove this model from play to use Spirit Bind. If you do, the warbeast is not destroyed and remains on the table under your control. If the warbeast was part of a battlegroup, the controller of that battlegroup can reave fury points on the warbeast as if it had been destroyed, and fury points that are not reaved are removed from the warbeast. The warbeast becomes a friendly Mercenary model, gains Undead, and no longer belongs to a battlegroup. Remove 1 damage point from each of the warbeast’s aspects. The warbeast cannot activate the turn Spirit Bind is used, cannot be forced, and loses its animus.

name: Repair [d3] (★Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d3 damage points from it.

name: Cultists
description: Choose one friendly living non-Morrowan Faction unit at the beginning of the game to be Cultists. Cultists are Thamarite models. This model can upkeep one spell without spending focus if there is one or more Cultist models in its control range during the Control Phase. Additionally, Cultist models do not suffer damage when spells are channeled through them as a result of Dark Rituals.

name: Whiplash
description: When an enemy model misses this model with an arcane attack, the attacking model becomes the target and is automatically hit by the attack. This model is the point of origin for all these attacks.

name: Leadership [Friendly Faction]
description: When another model within 8" of this model casts a spell and is the point of origin for the spell, the spell gains +2 RNG.

name: Distant Deployment [12"]
description: This model can be placed at the same time as your models with Advance Deployment, up to 12" beyond your deployment zone.

name: Veteran Leader [Marauder Crew]
description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Marauder Crew models gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: Object of Desire
description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Privateer Warrior models gain +2 to their melee attack damage rolls.

name: Field Marshal [Reconstruct]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Reconstruct. (When a model with Reconstruct is disabled by an enemy attack, place it anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Then, remove 1 damage point from each system. A model can only use Reconstruct once per turn. Reconstruct only effects models with a large base or smaller.)

name: Ferocious
description: During its activation, this model can spend fury points to make additional attacks or to boost attack or damage rolls. It can make one additional attack or boost one roll for each fury point spent.

name: •Blight Shroud (★Action)
description: Remove all fury points from this model. Enemy models within 1" of this model for each fury point removed suffer a POW 8 magical damage roll. Add an additional die to the damage roll for each focus or fury point on the enemy model. This model must have at least 1 fury point to make a Blight Shroud special action.

name: •Consume Fury (★Action)
description: RNG 8. Target friendly Faction warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, remove up to 5 fury points from it and place them on this model. This model can have up to 5 fury points at any time.

name: Freezer
description: When an enemy model without Resistance: Cold ends its activation within 2" of this model, the enemy model becomes stationary for one round.

name: Return [Leader]
description: Immediately after resolving a charge attack, this model can make a full advance toward its Leader model.

name: Noisy (★Action)
description: While within 8" of this model, enemy models lose Stealth. Noisy lasts for one round.

name: No Sleeping on the Job [Winter Guard]
description: This model and friendly Winter Guard models within 10" of it cannot become knocked down.

name: Smasher
description: This model can make trample power attacks without spending focus and gains an additional die on trample attack rolls.

name: Bond [Strakhov]
description: If Torch begins the game in Strakhov’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Torch is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Torch is bonded to Strakhov and in his control range, it gains Sprint. (At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, a model with Sprint can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.)

name: Vent Steam
description: This model can use Vent Steam once per activation at any time. Center a cloud effect template on this model. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. Living and undead models in the template when it is placed suffer an unboostable POW 12 damage roll.

name: Bond [Butcher]
description: If Ruin begins the game in Butcher’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Ruin is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While Ruin is bonded to Butcher and in his control range, it gains Boundless Charge. (During its activation, a model with Boundless Charge can charge without spending focus or being forced and gains +2 SPD and Pathfinder when it charges.)

name: Spectral Vortex
description: This model can immediately negate any spell that targets it or a model within 3" of it by spending 1 soul token. The negated spell does not take effect, but its COST remains spent.

name: Field Marshal [Flank Man-O-War]
description: Warjacks in this model’s battlegroup gain Flank [Man-O-War]. (When a model with Flank [Man-O-War] makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of a friendly Man-O-War model, the model with Flank gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.)

name: Storm’s Embrace
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Faction models gain concealment.

name: Arcane Pattern Array
description: When another model within 10" of this model casts a spell, this model gains one power token. This model can have up to three power tokens at any time. During its Combat Action, this model can spend power tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.

name: Toad Licker
description: At the beginning of this model’s activation, choose one of the following toad effects. Toad effects last for one round.

name: •Death Crazed
description: This model gains Berserk and Last Word. (When a model with Berserk destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.) (When a model with Last Word is disabled by an enemy attack, it can immediately advance up to 3" and can make one basic melee attack.)

name: •Blood Sweats
description: This model gains +2 ARM. If this model is hit by a melee attack, immediately after the attack is resolved the attacking model suffers the Corrosion continuous unless this model was destroyed or removed from play by the attack.

name: •Psychonaut
description: This model gains Eyeless Sight and Stumbling Drunk. (A model with Stumbling Drunk cannot become knocked down. If it is hit by an enemy attack at any time except while it is advancing, after the attack is resolved a model with Stumbling Drunk is pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model.)

name: Field Marshal [Overtake]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Overtake. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

name: Strange Growth
description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, place this model anywhere completely within 5" of its current location.

name: Serenity
description: At the beginning of your Control Phase, before leeching, you can remove 1 fury point from a friendly Faction warbeast within 1" of this model.

name: Field Marshal [Pathfinder and Prowl]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Pathfinder and Prowl.

name: Arcane Secrets (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target this model’s Leader. If the Leader is in range, it gains an additional die on arcane  attack rolls and magical damage rolls for the next spell it casts. Discard the lowest die in each roll. Arcane Secrets lasts for one turn.

name: Arcane Consumption
description: When an enemy model declares it is casting a spell while within 10" of this model, the enemy spellcaster immediately suffers d3 damage points and this model can remove d3 damage points. If the enemy spellcaster is destroyed as a result of this damage, the spell does not take effect.

name: •Seasoning the Sauce (★Action)
description: This model gains d3 corpse tokens.

name: •Spectral Lash (★Attack)
description: Spectral Lash is a RNG 10, POW 12 arcane attack. When an enemy model is hit by this attack, it can be pushed d6" directly toward Spectral Lash’s point of origin.

name: •Hand of Glory (★ Attack)
description: Hand of Glory is a RNG 7 arcane attack. Target enemy model hit becomes stationary for one round.

name: Eruption of Flies
description: When this model suffers damage as a result of an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved this model can target the attacking model with a SP 8, POW 14 ranged attack that causes corrosion damage. This attack ignores the firing into melee penalty. Models hit suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.

name: Carnivorous Swarm
description: When this model is disabled, center a cloud effect template on it, then remove this model from play. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. Enemy models without Resistance: Corrosion entering or ending their activation in the template suffer 1 point of corrosion damage

name: •Sacrificial Strike (★Action)
description: RNG 12. Target a model in this model’s LOS. If that model is in range, remove one friendly Faction trooper model within 1" of this model from play. The target model suffers an unboostable magical damage roll with POW equal to the base ARM of the removed model.

name: Focus Matrix
description: This model can allocate focus points during its activation. Once per turn during its activation, you can remove focus points from warjacks in this model’s battlegroup that are in its control range and give those focus points to this model. This model cannot have more focus points than its ARC as a result of Focus Matrix.

name: Elite Cadre [Bloodgorgers]
description: Friendly Bloodgorgers models in this army gain Berserk

name: Veteran Leader [Pyg]
description: While within 10" of this model, other Pyg models gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: Pain Maddened
description: When this model is damaged by an enemy attack, it gains +2 SPD for one round.

name: Accumulator [Undead]
description: When this model begins its activation within 3" of one or more friendly undead warrior models, this model gains 1 focus point.

name: Bond [Kromac]
description: If Ghetorix begins the game in Kromac’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Ghetorix is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While bonded to Kromac and in his control range, Ghetorix gains Overtake. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

name: •Murderous
description: This model gains an additional die on melee attack rolls against warrior models.

name: •Snacking
description: When this model boxes a living model with a melee attack, it can choose to remove the boxed model from play. When it does, this model can remove d3 damage points.

name: Experimental Brainspike
description: During the Control Phase, after focus allocating, roll a d3. This model gains that amount of focus points.

name: Aggressive
description: This model can run or charge without spending a focus point.

name: Storm’s Embrace [5"]
description: While within 5" of this model, friendly Northkin models gain concealment.

name: Paralyzing Gaze
description: While within 5" of this model, enemy models with LOS to this model suffer –2 DEF.

name: Leadership [Order of Illumination Vigilants]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Order of Illumination Vigilants models gain True Sight.

name: Blood Drinker
description: Immediately after this model resolves a melee attack in which it destroys one or more living models, it can end its activation and remove d3 damage points.

name: Reinforced
description: This model always has cover.

name: Spell Vortex
description: If an enemy model cast a spell in this model’s control range last turn, this model can cast one spell without spending focus during its activation this turn.

name: •Entropic Force
description: While within 5" of this model, enemy models lose Tough and cannot have damage removed from them. Entropic Force lasts for one round.

name: Primordial Rage
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Shapeshifter models gain Retaliation. (If a model with Retaliation was damaged by an enemy attack during the last round, during your Maintenance Phase it can advance up to 3" and make one basic melee attack.)

name: Primordial Resillience
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Shapeshifter models gain Unyielding. (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

name: Primordial Warding
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Shapeshifter models gain Sacred Ward. (A model with Sacred Ward cannot be targeted by enemy spells.)

name: Bone Working
description: When a model within 8" of this model makes an attack or damage roll, this model can spend a corpse token to cause that model to reroll the roll. Each roll can be rerolled only once due to Bone Working.

name: Buzzing Swarm
description: While within 2" of this model, models gain concealment. Additionally, while within 2" of this model, enemy models suffer –2 to attack rolls.

name: Field Marshal [Reposition 3"]
description: Cohort in this model’s battlegroup gain Reposition [3"]. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Imperishable Conviction
description: When a friendly Faction model in its control range is destroyed by an enemy attack, this model can remove 1 damage point.

name: Paragon of the Faith
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Exemplar warrior models gain Tough.

name: Blessed Wards
description: This model gains +3 ARM against damage rolls made by Infernal or undead models.

name: Eye of Menoth
description: While in this model’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +1 to attack and damage rolls.

name: •Bone Working
description: When a model within 8" of this model makes an attack or damage roll, this model can spend a corpse token to cause that model to reroll the roll. Each roll can be rerolled only once due to Bone Working.

name: Grave Digger (★Action)
description: RNG 3. Target friendly non-Leader Faction model. If the model is in range, it becomes dug in. (While dug in, a model gains cover and Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged.)

name: I Found One! (★Action)
description: RNG 3. Target friendly Faction model with a Body Snatcher special rule. If the model is in range and does not have any corpse tokens, it gains one corpse token. A model can only be targeted by I Found One once per turn.

name: Undertaker
description: This model gains an additional die on attack and damage rolls against undead models.

name: Cautious Advance
description:
This model can use Cautious Advance once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. This activation, this unit must make a full advance as its Normal Movement, then each model in the unit performs the Dig In special action and can take their Combat
Actions.

name: Drive: Foxhole Buddy
description: While within 10" of this model, a warjack under its control gains Foxhole Buddy. (While B2B with a friendly model that is dug in, a model with Fox Hole Buddy gains cover, Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS.)

name: Leadership [Wolf Sworn]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Wolf Sworn models gain Prowl and Side Step.

name: Mage Ward
description: While within 6" of this model, friendly models gain Magic Resistance. (When this model is targeted by an arcane attack roll, roll one additional die. Discard the highest die of each roll).

name: Immovable Object
description: This model cannot become knocked down, cannot be placed, and cannot be moved by a push, slam, or throw.

name: Master Infernalist
description: This model is not an infernal master or Leader but has all the rules of an infernal master except it does not have a feat and cannot summon horrors. This model can have only light or lesser horrors in its battlegroup and must start with one in it's battlegroup at the begining of the game. This model replenishes its essence without sacrificing a model during its Control Phase.

name: Mischief
description: When an enemy warjack or battle engine begins its activation B2B with this model, roll a d3. On a roll of 1, the warjack or battle engine suffers –2 SPD that activation. On a 2, it suffers –2 to attack rolls that activation. On a 3, it suffers –2 to damage rolls that activation.

name: •Call of Defiance
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Faction models do not lose Tough while knocked down. Call of Defiance lasts for one round.

name: Snow-Wreathed
description: This model has concealment.

name: Primal Rage
description: Once per turn, when this model suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance toward the attacking model and can make one basic melee attack.

name: •Desperate Pace [Trollkin]
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Trollkin trooper model. If the model is in range, models inits unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

name: Leadership [Grotesques]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Grotesques models gain Stealth.

name: Secured Perimeter [6"]
description: Friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF while within 6" of this model.

name: Habitable [Guard Tower]
description:
Small and medium-based units and solos can enter this building through a door on the lower level. A model/unit ending its Normal Movement within 1" of the door can choose to enter this building.
 
Models entering this building can be placed on either the lower or upper levels. Models in a unit occupying this building can placed on either floor or both. There can be up to five small-based models or three medium-based models on each floor. There must be room for a model’s base for it to be placed on either floor.

name: Movement Inside the Guard Tower
description: Models/units can use their Normal Movement to be placed on the top floor if they were previously on the lower floor or to be placed on the lower floor if they were on the top floor. Units using their Normal Movement to be placed are considered to have moved. Models cannot otherwise move or be placed while inside the building.

name: Top Floor [Guard Tower]
description: The upper level of this building is considered to be elevated terrain. Additionally, arcane and ranged attacks made by models on the top floor gain +4 RNG.

name: Hollow Ward
description: While within 4" of this model, friendly horrors gain +2 ARM against melee attack damage rolls made by construct, soulless, or undead models.

name: Unsummonable
description: This model cannot be summoned.

name: Soul Claiming
description: When a living non-soulless enemy model is destroyed within 4" of this model while this model is in its controller’s control range, its controller gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

name: Catastrophic Explosion
description: When this model is disabled by an enemy attack, enemy models within 3" of it suffer an unboostable POW 12 fire damage roll and the Fire continuous effect. Then remove this model from play.

name: Binge Drinking
description: This model can use Binge Drinking once per game at any time during its activation. This model becomes knocked down.

name: Hangover
description: The first time this model is disabled by an enemy attack, it removes all damage and becomes knocked down.

name: Soul Taker: Body Count
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When this model destroys a living enemy model with an attack, this model gains the destroyed model's soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

name: •Soul Transfer (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction model with a Soul Taker special rule. If the model is in range, remove any number of soul tokens from this model and place them on the target friendly model.

name: Time Projection
description: This model is not a warcaster or Leader, but has the following warcaster special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Focus Manipulation, Power Field, and Spellcaster. During your Control Phase, this model can allocate focus points to warjacks in its control range that are in Haley Prime’s battlegroup. This model can channel spells through warjacks in Haley Prime’s battlegroup that have the Arc Node advantage and are in this model’s control range.

name: Raw Talent
description: This model gains an additional die on damage rolls.

name: Reinforcements [Rhul Guard]
description: During your Maintenance Phase, return d3 small-based friendly destroyed Rhulic Grunts to play. Models return with 1 unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts within 8" this model and within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

name: Periscope
description: This model can use Periscope once per activation at any time. Choose an enemy model in this model’s LOS. That model loses Stealth for one turn.

name: Blazing Wrath
description: This model can charge enemy models suffering the Fire continuous effect without spending focus or being forced.

name: Bond [Feora]
description: If Hand of Judgment begins the game in Feora’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Hand of Judgment is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Hand of Judgment is bonded to Feora and in her control range, it gains boosted ranged attack rolls.

name: •Strength of Death
description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend soul tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.

name: Direct Spirits
description: When a friendly living Faction warrior model is destroyed within 10" of this model and generates a soul token, you choose which model with the Soul Taker ability gains the destroyed model’s soul, regardless of the proximity of other models. Enemy models are not eligible to gain soul tokens from friendly models destroyed within 10" of this model.

name: Ashen Veil
description: This model has concealment. Living enemy models without Immunity: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls while within 2" of this model.

name: Soul Ravager
description: When this model destroys an enemy model with an attack, its controller gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models and the destroyed model is removed from play.

name: Soul Shatter
description: Once per turn, when a non-soulless living enemy model advances and ends is movement or is placed within 4" of this model, this model can spend 1 essence point. When it does the living model gains Soulless for the rest of the game and this model's Leader gains its soul token.

name: Invocations of Dust
description: When a friendly undead non-Leader Faction warrior model within 10" of this model is disabled, this model can spend 1 focus point to remove 1 damage point from the disabled model.

name: Beer Wagon
description: While within 5" of this model, friendly Northkin warbeasts and warrior models gain Stumbling Drunk. Beer Wagon lasts for one round. (A model with Stumbling Drunk cannot become knocked down. If it is hit by an enemy attack at any time except while it is advancing, after the attack is resolved it is pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model.)

name: Coordinated Barrage
description: This model can make ranged attacks targeting enemy models suffering Flare, ignoring RNG and LOS.

name: Forward Deployment
description: This model can be deployed up to 8" beyond your deployment zone.

name: Danger Close
description: Once per turn during a friendly Faction model’s activation, after an attack or special action that applies Flare to an enemy model is resolved, this model may immediately make a basic ranged attack targeting the enemy model.

name: Field Marshal [Pathfinder and Reposition 3"]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Pathfinder and Reposition [3"]. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Veteran Leader [Farrow Valkyries]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Farrow Valkyries gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: Tendrils
description: If there are fewer than three Tentacles in this unit in play during your Maintenance Phase, you can put one Tentacle into play within 2" of this model. If this model is destroyed or removed from play, the Tentacles in its unit are removed from play.

name: Carapace Grenades
description: Once per turn when this model is hit by a melee attack, after the attack has been resolved this model can use Carapace Grenades. When it does so, enemy models within 3" of it suffer an unboostable POW 12 blast damage roll. This model loses Carapace Grenades while its S system is crippled.

name: Tunneler
description: This model can forfeit its Normal Movement to be placed anywhere completely within 10" of its current location. Colossal Movement does not apply to this model while resolving this rule. After it has been placed, enemy models within 2" of this model can be pushed up to 3" directly away from this model in the order you choose.

name: Debris Field
description: Enemy models treat open terrain within 4" of this model as rough terrain.

name: Threshing Maw
description: After this model is placed by Tunneler but before pushing enemy models as a result of Tunneler, enemy models within 2" of this model suffer an unboostable POW 12 melee damage roll.

name: Void Disruptor
description:
The first time each turn each enemy warjack or monstrosity ends a movement or is placed within 3" of one more more models with Void Disruptor, it loses 1 focus. The first time each turn each enemy horrors ends a movement or is placed within 3" of one more more models with Void Disruptor, it loses 1 essence. The first time each turn each enemy warbeast ends a movement or is placed within 3" of one more more models with Void Disruptor, it gains 1 fury.

While the Hellraker has two functional Void Disruptors, enemy cohorts are affected by this ability within 6" rather than 3".

name: Weapons Platform
description: As long as a model has two options that include Weapons Platform special rule this model gains the Gunfighter advantage.

name: Soul Taker: Body Count
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When this model destroys a living enemy model with an attack, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

name: Empowered Arc Node
description: Once per turn, when its controller channels a spell through this model, reduce the COST of the spell by 1.

name: Bond [Issyria]
description: If Hemera begins the game in Issyria’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Hemera is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While Hemera is bonded to Issyria and in her control range, Issyria can upkeep one spell without spending focus.

name: Guidance (★ Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly model. If the model is in range, it gains Eyeless Sight and its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical for one turn.

name: Field Marshal [Oracular Vision]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Oracular Vision.

name: Field Marshal [Unstoppable]
description: Cohort models in this model's battlegroup gain Unstoppable.

name: Excruciator
description: When this model boxes a living enemy warrior model with a melee attack, you can place a Wrack into play completely within 4" of this model. If you do, remove the boxed model from play.

name: Witch Hound
description: When an enemy model hits one or more models in this model’s battlegroup with an arcane attack, immediately after the attack is resolved one model in this model’s battlegroup in its control range can advance up to 3" and make one basic attack.

name: Fiery Blast
description: When this model is destroyed, models within 2" of it suffer a POW 14 blast fire damage roll.

name: Suffering’s Prayer
description:
This model begins the game with 1 focus point. During your Control Phase, this model receives 1 focus point if it does not have any. This model cannot have more than 1 focus point at any time. While this model has a focus point, it cannot be damaged by ranged attacks. During a friendly Faction warcaster’s activation, it can remove 1 focus point from this model in its control range and gain that focus point. Each warcaster can do this only once per turn. When a focus point is removed from this model, roll a d6. On a 1 or 2, this model explodes with the same effect as Fiery Blast and is removed from
play.

name: Battle Plan
description: This model can use one of the following plans at any time during its activation.

name: Brother’s Keeper [Exemplar]
description: While  within 10" of this model, friendly Exemplar models cannot become knocked down or stationary.

name: •Desperate Pace [small- or medium-based Exemplar]
description: RNG 5. Target friendly small- or medium-based Exemplar trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2" movement during their Normal Movement this turn.

name: Leadership [Paladins of the Order of the Wall]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Paladins of the Order of the Wall gain Righteous Vengeance.

name: Stone-and-Mortar Stance
description: During its activation, this model can forfeit its Normal Movement or Combat Action to gain +3 ARM. The affected model cannot become knocked down. Stone-and-Mortar Stance lasts for one round.

name: Treasure Hunter
description: While this model is securing an area or holding an objective, friendly models within 8" of it gain Pathfinder.

name: Claim Jumper
description: Ignore enemy models within 5" of this model when determining if an area or objective is contested.

name: Greedy
description: This model can secure or hold any objective regardless of its model type.

name: Revenant [Hoard]
description: While this model is securing an area or holding an objective, it gains +3 DEF and ARM. Additionally, during your Control Phase remove d3+3 damage points from this model if it is securing an area or holding an objective.

name: Raider's Curse
description: While this model is securing an area or holding an objective, enemy models within 5" of this model suffer –2 ARM and lose Tough.

name: Condition (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, you can place 1 fury point on it or remove 1 fury point from it.

name: Scroll Bearer
description: This model can use one of the following scrolls at any time during its activation while within 1" of Hoarluk. Each scroll can be used only once per game.

name: •Scroll of the Call of Troqal
description: While in Doomshaper’s control range, each warbeast in his battlegroup can gain 0 fury when forced to use its animus instead of gaining fury points equal to the COST of the animus. Scroll of the Call of Troqal lasts for one turn.

name: •Scroll of the Hand of Yolandi
description: While in Doomshaper’s control range, enemy models pay double the focus or fury point cost to cast or upkeep spells. Scroll of the Hand of Yolandi lasts for one round.

name: •Scroll of the Strength of the Molgur
description: While in Doomshaper’s control range, friendly Faction warrior models gain an additional die on attack rolls. Discard the lowest die in each roll. Scroll of the Strength of the Molgur lasts for one turn.

name: Prod
description: When a warbeast in this model’s battlegroup destroys one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can force the warbeast to advance up to 2".

name: Scroll of the Will of Balasar
description: This model can use Scroll of the Will of Balasar once per game when a warbeast frenzies in its control range. This model’s controller chooses the warbeast’s frenzy target.

name: Sniper
description: Instead of making a damage roll to resolve a ranged attack, this model can inflict 1 damage point. A model disabled by a ranged attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll.

name: Granted: Snap Fire
description: While this model is in play the ranged weapons of models in its unit gain Snap Fire. (When a model destroys one or more enemy models with a weapon with Snap Fire during its Combat Action, immediately after that attack is resolved the model can make one basic ranged attack with the same weapon. Attacks gained from Snap Fire cannot generate additional attacks from Snap Fire.)

name: Prayers
description: At the start of this unit's activation, choose one of the following special rules:

name: •Fervor
description: Models in this unit gain +2 to damage rolls this activation.

name: •Path of Flames
description: Models in this unit gain Resistance: Fire for one round.

name: •Warding
description: Models in this unit cannot be trargeted by enemy spells for one round.

name: Greater Destiny
description: This model can use Greater Destiny once per game at the start of its unit’s activation. Immediately return all Grunts to this unit that were destroyed during your opponent’s last turn to play. Place them within 2" of this model. Returned Grunts must forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

name: Holy Monolith
description: When one or more other models in this unit are damaged by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved models in this unit gain +4 ARM for one turn.

name: Call to Sacrifice [Holy Zealot]
description: If this model is disabled by an enemy attack, you can choose a non-disabled friendly Holy Zealot trooper model within 5" of this model to be destroyed. If another model is destroyed as a result of Call to Sacrifice, remove 1 damage point from this model.

name: Burnt Meat
description: Warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup can charge enemy models suffering the Fire continuous effect without being forced.

name: Bond [Doomshaper]
description: If Mulg begins the game in Doomshaper’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Mulg is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Mulg is bonded to Doomshaper, it gains +1 FURY.

name: Bond [Borka]
description: If Rök begins the game in Borka’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Rök is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While bonded to Borka and in his control range, Rök gains Stumbling Drunk. (A model with Stumbling Drunk cannot become knocked down. If it is hit by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it is pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model.)

name: Field Marshal [Resistance: Fire]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Resistance: Fire.

name: Hell Marked
description: Models destroyed by attacks made by this model never generate soul tokens.

name: Orgoth Monstrosity
description:
This model is a monstrosity that can be included in any Orgoth warcaster's battlegroup. An Orgoth warcaster can allocate focus points to this model as if it was a warjack. If this model's warcaster is destroyed or removed from the table, it becomes autonomous. An Orgoth warcaster can take control of an autonomous friendly Orgoth monstrosity. To do this, an Orgoth warcaster must spend 1 focus point during its activation while B2B with the autonomous Orgoth monstrosity. The monstrosity must forfeit its Combat Action the turn it becomes controlled. The monstrosity becomes a part of the battlegroup of the warcaster that took control of it.

At any time during its activation, an Orgoth warcaster can spend focus points to heal damage a monstrosity in its battlegroup in its control range has suffered. For each focus point spent this way, remove 1 damage point.

name: Leadership [Long Riders]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Long Rider models gain Relentless Charge.

name: Granted: Shield Wall
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Shield Wall. (While a model with Shield Wall is B2B with one or more models in its unit, it gains +2 ARM and cannot be knocked down.)

name: Leadership [House Ellowuyr]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly House Ellowuyr models gain Side Step.

name: •Heal [d3+1] (★ Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly living Faction model. If the model is in range, remove d3+1 damage points from it.

name: •Power of Faith (★Action)
description: For one round, friendly Faction models cannot become knocked down or stationary while within 5" of this model.

name: •Force Bolt (★Attack)
description: Force Bolt is a RNG 10, POW 10 arcane attack. An enemy model hit by this attack can be pushed d3" directly toward or directly away from this model. Choose the direction before rolling the distance. On a critical hit, the enemy model becomes knocked down after being pushed.

name: •Force Wall (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Force Barrier for one round.

name: Leadership [Battle Mages]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Battle Mage models gain Battle Wizard.

name: •Whip Snap (★Attack)
description: Whip Snap is a RNG 6, POW 12 arcane attack. If this attack hits an enemy model, immediately after the attack is resolved this model or a friendly Faction non-trooper model within 3" of it can advance up to 2". A model can advance only once per turn as a result of Whip Snap.

name: Veteran Leader [Shyeel trooper]
description: While within 10" of this model, Shyeel trooper models gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: •Desperate Pace [Houseguard]
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Houseguard trooper model. If the model is in range,  models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

name: •Firing Solution [Houseguard]
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Houseguard trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit ignore Stealth this turn.

name: Trapper (★Action)
description: Place a 3" template anywhere within 2" of this model. The template remains in play for one round. Living and undead models entering or ending their activations in the template suffer a POW 10 damage roll. Models damaged by Trapper become knocked down. Models with Flight are not affected.

name: Kinetic Capacitor
description: The first time this model is hit by an enemy attack each turn, after the attack is resolved this model gains 1 focus point.

name: Bond [Ossyan]
description: If Hypnos begins the game in Ossyan’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Hypnos is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Hypnos is bonded to Ossyan and in his control range, enemy models directly hit by Hypnos’ Phase Cannon weapon suffer Shadow Bind.

name: Go to Ground
description: This model can use Go to Ground once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. For one round, models in this unit gain cover and Resistance: Blast and do not block LOS.

name: Granted: Prowl
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Prowl. (While a model with Prowl has concealment, it gains Stealth.)

name: Phoenix Protocols
description: Choose a protocol at the beginning of each of this model’s activations. It retains that protocol until the beginning of its next activation. A protocol cannot be chosen a second time until each protocol has been chosen once. A protocol cannot be chosen a third time until each protocol has been chosen twice.

name: •Wildfire Protocol
description: This model gains Evasive and cannot be made stationary. (When a model with Evasive is hit by an enemy ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

name: •Retribution Protocol
description: This model gains Side Step and can charge without spending focus. (When a model with Side Step hits an enemy model with an initial melee attack or special attack, it can advance 2" after the attack is resolved.)

name: Rekindled
description: The first time this model would be disabled, each model within 2" of it suffers an unboostable POW 12 fire damage roll. Then remove all damage from its System boxes, ignoring all effects that prevent damage from being removed from a model. It gains inconsequential until the end of the turn. If it is within its battlegroup controller’s control range, it can be placed within 2" of that model. (A model with Inconsequential cannot score or contest scenario elements.)

name: •Voidwalker Protocol
description: This model gains Ghostly, Dodge, +2 DEF against ranged attack rolls, and cannot become knocked down. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.) (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

name: Bond [Vyros]
description: If Imperatus begins the game in Vyros’ battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Imperatus is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Imperatus is bonded to Vyros and in his control range, it can run or charge without spending focus.

name: Phoenix Protocol
description: This model can use Phoenix Protocol once per game during your Maintenance Phase or when disabled. Remove up to 1 damage point from each of its systems.

name: •Firestarter (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction model. If the model is in range, its melee and ranged weapons gain Continuous Effect: Fire for one turn.

name: •Howling Flames (★Attack)
description: Howling Flames is a RNG SP 10 and POW 13 arcane attack. This attack causes fire damage and models hit suffer the Fire continuous effect.

name: Host
description: Incubus models do not begin the game in play. When a friendly living non-soulless, small-based Faction warrior model is disabled by an enemy attack, collateral damage, or a continuous effect, you can replace it with an Incubus model that has not been put into play. The replaced model is removed from play.

name: Consecration
description: While within 6" of this model, enemy models cannot cast, channel, or upkeep spells.

name: Infernal Portal
description: When a model summons a horror while within 8" of this model, reduce the number of essence points the summoning model must spend by 1

name: Soul Taker: Vortex of Souls
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living model is destroyed while within 15" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to five soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

name: •Gate of Worlds
description: At any time during its activation, this model can spend one soul token to place a friendly Faction model within 5" of this model anywhere completely within 2" of its current location. A model can be placed as a result of Gate of Worlds only once per turn.

name: Soul Conduit
description: At the start of this models activation, if this model has no soul tokens on it, and there are no living non souless enemy modles within 15" of this model, this model gains a soul token.

name: •Dark Abyss
description: Anytime during this models activation, you can remove up to three soul tokens from this model to return one destroyed small- or medium-based friendly Faction soulless Grunt to play for each token removed. Grunts return with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts completely within within 12" of this model and completely within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

name: Reliquary
description: This model gains an additional die on attack damage rolls. Discard the lowest die of each roll. While its S system is disabled, this model loses the benefits of Reliquary.

name: Feretory
description: This model ignores concealment and Stealth. Additionally, this model’s weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. While its S system is disabled, this model loses the benefits of Feretory.

name: Soul Taker: Cenotaph
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a friendly living Faction model is destroyed within 10" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. At the start of this model’s activation, you can remove soul tokens from this model to give it 1 focus point for each token removed.

name: Bond [Reznik]
description: If Scourge of Heresy begins the game in Reznik’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Scourge of Heresy is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. Once per turn when Reznik destroys an enemy model or causes it to be removed from play as a result of a melee attack while Scourge of Heresy is bonded to him and in his control range, immediately after the attack is resolved Scourge of Heresy can make a full advance.

name: Unbreakable Wall
description: This model gains a cumulative +3 ARM for each other model in this unit it is currently B2B with. Additionally, while B2B with another model in its unit, this model cannot become knocked down, cannot be placed outside Normal Movement, and cannot be moved by a push, slam, or throw.

name: Leadership [Exemplar Vengers]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Exemplar Venger models gain Divine Inspiration.

name: Leadership [Tharn]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Tharn models gain Dodge.

name: •Harmonious Exaltation (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target this model’s Leader. If it is in range, once this turn when the Leader casts a spell, reduce the COST of the spell by 1.

name: No Sleeping on the Job [Iron Fang]
description: This model and friendly  Iron Fang models within 10" of it cannot become knocked down.

name: •Invocation of Bitterest Night (★Action)
description: This model gains Stealth and Black Mantle for one round. (While B2B with a model with Black Mantle, friendly Faction models gain Stealth.)

name: Drive: Reposition [3"]
description: While within 10" of this model, a warjack under its control gains Reposition [3"]. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Drive: Dark Shroud
description: While within 10" of this model, a warjack under its control gains  Dark Shroud. (While within 2" of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.)

name: •Cloak of Darkness (★Action)
description: This model gains Stealth. While a warjack this model controls is B2B with it, the warjack also gains Stealth. Cloak of Darkness lasts for one round.

name: Bond [Deneghra]
description: If Nightmare begins the game in Deneghra’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Nightmare is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Nightmare is bonded to Deneghra and in her control range, it gains Stealth.

name: Activate Exponent Servitor
description: At the end of your Control Phase, you can put one Exponent Servitor into play completely within 2" of this model if there are fewer than two Exponent Servitors in play in Directrix’s battlegroup.

name: Field Marshal [Arc Node]
description: Warjacks in this model’s battlegroup gain Arc Node.

name: Soul Vessel
description: This model generates soul tokens as if it were a living model.

name: Leadership [Dread Rot]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Dread Rot models gain Ghostly.

name: Bond (Channeler)
description: This model is bonded to your Leader. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While this model is bonded to your Leader and in its control range, your Leader can channel spells through it.

name: Bond (Reposition [3"])
description: This model is bonded to your Leader. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While this model is bonded to your Leader and in its control range, it gains Reposition [3]. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Bond (Unyielding)
description: This model is bonded to your Leader. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While this model is bonded to your Leader and in its control range, it gains Unyielding. (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

name: Field Marshal [Death Rage]
description: Warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup gain Death Rage. (When a model with Death Rage is disabled by an enemy attack at any time except while it is advancing, it can immediately advance up to 3" and can make one basic melee attack, then the model is then destroyed. When making this attack, ignore the effects of crippled aspects on the affected warbeast.)

name: Leadership [Runeshapers]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Runeshaper models gain Battle Wizard.

name: •High Ground (★Action)
description: Place a 3" template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template remains in play for one round. While completely within the template, models gain +2 DEF against ranged and arcane attacks and their ranged weapons gain Arcing Fire. (When attacking with a weapon with Arcing Fire, a model can ignore intervening models.)

name: •Tectonic Shift (★Action)
description: Choose a table edge. Enemy models currently within 3" of this model are pushed 3" directly toward the chosen edge in the order you choose.

name: Field Marshal [Swift Hunter]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Swift Hunter.

name: Bond [Haley]
description: If Thorn begins the game in Haley’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Thorn is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Thorn is bonded to Haley and in her control range, Haley can channel spells through Thorn as if it were not engaged.

name: Compost (★Action)
description: Place a 3" diameter template anywhere in base contact with this model. The template is forest terrain and remains in play for one round. After making this special action, this model cannot move during the same activation.

name: Blazing Path
description: While in this model's' control range, warbeasts in its battlegroup can charge or power attack slam an enemy model suffering the Fire continuous effect without being forced. Additionally, when a friendly Faction model in this model's control range begins a charge or slam power attack targeting an enemy model suffering the Fire continuous effect the charging or slamming model gains +2 SPD

name: Field Marshal [Hand of the Dragon]
description: The weapons of warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup gain Continuous Effect: Fire.

name: Unconquerable
description: While while within 10" of this model, friendly Faction warrior models gain Unyielding.

name: Tempered Shifting
description: Morozov begins the game in Human Form. When Morozov suffers damage from a continuous effect or enemy attack, after the damage has been resolved you can choose to replace Morozov's Human Form with his Shifted Form. If you choose to do so, remove all damage from Morozov. Effects on the replaced model are applied to the alternate form. When one form replaces another, the new form is not considered to have entered an area and does not trigger effects triggered by entering.

name: Field Marshal [Righteous Vengeance]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Righteous Vengeance.

name: Ursine Shifted
description: This model counts as an Ursine Shifted and shapeshifter model.

name: •Soothing Call
description: Remove up to 1 fury point from each friendly living Faction warbeast currently within 10" of this model.

name: •Battle Formation
description: While in this model's control range and B2B with one or more models in its battlegroup, friendly Faction warrior models gain +2 ARM and cannot become knocked down. Battle Formation lasts for one round.

name: Veteran Leader [Iron Fang]
description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Iron Fang models gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: Conferred Rage
description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models during its activation, Cohort models in its battlegroup beginning their activations in its control range gain +2 SPD and MAT for one turn.

name: Man in the Machine
description: This model is a living model but is neither a warjack nor a warrior model. It has a damage grid and suffers damage like a warjack. This model can make power attacks without spending focus. Effects modifying the amount of damage to or the manner in which damage is applied to a warjack also apply to this model. This model cannot spend focus points to remove damage.

name: Necromantic Power
description: During your Control Phase, after focus allocation this model gains 1 focus point for each of its non-crippled arm systems.

name: Arcantrik Turbine
description: At the start of this model’s activation, it can spend 1 focus point to gain +2 SPD and Pathfinder for one turn.

name: Bond [Kaya the Moonhunter]
description: Laris begins the game bonded to Kaya the Moonhunter. Laris is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Laris is bonded to Kaya and in her control range, she can channel spells through him.

name: Granted: Duelist
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain +2 DEF against melee attacks.

name: Dual Shot
description: If this model/unit uses its Normal Movement to aim, this model can make one additional ranged attack this activation.

name: Swift Hunter
description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".

name: Hell Hunter
description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved one Cohort model in this model’s battlegroup that is in its control range can advance up to 3"

name: Support Weapons [Kithguard Infantry]
description: Each time you add this unit to your army, choose two Support Weapon Troopers to add to the unit. You can add two of the same Support Weapon Trooper to the unit. The options for Support Weapon Troopers to add to this unit are Flamethrower, Mortar, and Slugger.

name: Been Here Before
description: Models in this unit gain Ambush and Extended Ambush. (when a model/unit with Extended Ambush ambushes, it can be placed completely within 5"of the table edge, instead of 3".)

name: Close Control
description: While a cohort model in this model’s battlegroup is in play, this model cannot go into the tunnels.

name: Battle-Driven
description: When one or more models in this unit are damaged by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved models in this unit gain +2 ARM, +2 to their melee attack damage rolls, and Pathfinder for one round.

name: Treewalker
description: This model ignores forests when determining LOS. While completely within a forest, this model gains +2 DEF against melee attack rolls.

name: •Winter’s Wind (★ Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction model with Resistance: Cold. If the model is in range, it gains Freezer. Winter’s Wind lasts for one round. (When an enemy model without Resistance: Cold ends its activation within 2" of a model with Freezer, the enemy model becomes stationary for one round.)

name: Arcane Artifacts
description: When this model casts a spell, you can choose to use one of the following special rules. Each special rule can be used only once per activation and expires after the spell is cast.

name: •Focus Sphere
description: Reduce the COST of the spell by 1.

name: •True Sight
description: This model ignores cloud effects when determining LOS. This model also ignores Stealth.

name: •Range Amplifier
description: When this model casts a spell and is the point of origin for the spell, the spell gains +5 RNG.

name: Leadership [Greylords]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Greylord models gain Battle Wizard.

name: •Brittle Frost (★Attack)
description: Brittle Frost is a RNG 10 arcane attack. A model hit by this attack suffers a POW 10 cold damage roll and suffers  –2 ARM for one turn unless it has Resistance: Cold.

name: Owl’s Wisdom (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction model. If the model is in range, enemy upkeep spells and animi on it expire and it cannot be targeted by enemy spells for one round.

name: •Unstoppable Fury [Man-O-War]
description: - RNG 5. Target friendly Man-O-War model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Retaliatory Strike for one round. (If a model with Retaliatory Strike is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved the model with Retaliatory Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. A model can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

name: Rallying Point
description: While this model is in play, increase the RNG of Arconovich’s Battle Plans by +3

name: •Fighting Dirty
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, its melee weapons gain Grievous Wounds. Dirty Fighting lasts for one turn. (A model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)

name: Veteran Leader [Assault Kommando]
description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Assault Kommando models gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: Arcane Dementia
description: Zoktavir begins the game with 7 focus points and a base ARC of 7. At the start of each of your turns, if Zoktavir destroyed three or more enemy models with melee attacks during the last round, his base ARC becomes 7 for one round. Otherwise, his ARC becomes d6 + 1 for one round.

name: Leadership [Man-O-War]
description: Other friendly Faction Man-O-War models beginning their activation within 10" of this model gain +2 SPD for one turn.

name: •Kill Order
description: RNG 10. Target an enemy model/unit. Friendly Faction warrior models gain +2 to attack damage rolls against the chosen model/unit. Kill Order lasts for one turn.

name: Sacrificial Pawn [War Argus]
description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal War Argus within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

name: Tune Up (★ Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction Cohort model. If the Cohort model is in range, it immediately stands up and is no longer stationary, continuous effects on the model expire, and it gains Pathfinder for one turn.

name: Destruction-Spawned
description: This model does not begin the game in play. When a friendly Exalted solo with Soul Taker: Requiem is destroyed in Supreme Aptimus Zaal’s control range, replace the Exalted solo with a Kovaas unless there is already a friendly Kovaas in play. If the Exalted solo had soul tokens on it when it was destroyed, place up to three of those soul tokens on the Kovaas replacing it. Effects on the destroyed Exalted solo expire. The Kovaas cannot activate the turn it is put in play.

name: Sacrificial Pawn [Winter Guard trooper]
description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Winter Guard trooper model within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

name: •Desperate Pace [Winter Guard]
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Winter Guard trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

name: Granted: Pathfinder
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Pathfinder

name: Protective Aura
description: Friendly Faction models gain +2 ARM while within 8" of this model.

name: Stone Warp
description: This model can use one of the following effects each turn at any time during its unit’s activation:

name: •Combat Warding
description: Continuous effects on friendly Faction models affected by this unit’s Protective Aura expire. While affected by this unit’s Protective Aura, a model is immune to continuous effects. Combat Warding lasts for one round.

name: •Spirit Chaser
description: While within the area affected by this unit’s Protective Aura, enemy models lose Incorporeal and Stealth. Spirit Chaser lasts for one round.

name: •Stone Strength
description: While within the area affected by this unit’s Protective Aura, friendly Faction models gain +1 to their melee attack damage rolls. Stone Strength lasts for one turn.

name: Northkin Unit
description: Models in this model’s unit are Northkin models and gain Resistance: Cold.

name: •Stone Cold
description: While within the area affected by this unit’s Protective Aura, friendly Northkin warrior models gain +2 to their melee attack damage rolls. Stone Cold lasts for one round.

name: •Wild Winds
description: This unit and friendly Northkin models activating within the area affected by this unit’s Protective Aura gain +1 SPD. Wild Winds lasts for one turn.

name: •Winter Magic
