description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Strider models gain Swift Hunter.

name: Admonition
description: Once per round when an enemy model advances and ends its movement or is placed within 6" of this model, this model can immediately advance up to 3".

name: Chain Attack: Dark Shroud
description: If this model hits the same target with both its initial melee attacks, after resolving the attacks this model gains Dark Shroud for one turn. (While in the melee range of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.)

name: Mental Domination [Shield Guard]
description: While in this model’s control range, warbeasts in its battlegroup gain Shield Guard. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

name: Albatross
description: If this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, for the rest of this turn enemy models suffer –1 to their attack and damage rolls.

name: Ghost Sight
description: This model does not require LOS to a target when casting spells or making making ranged or arcane attacks. This model ignores concealment and cover when resolving ranged and arcane attacks.

name: Soul Converter
description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can spend 1 fury point to give each friendly Exalted model with Soul Taker: Requiem currently in its control range one soul token.

name: Elite Cadre [small-based Praetorian]
description: Friendly small-based Praetorian models gain Vengeance. (During your Maintenance Phase, if one or more models in a unit with Vengeance were damaged by enemy attacks during the last round, each model in the unit can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack.)

name: Stay Death
description: When a friendly living non-Leader Faction warrior model within 10" of this model is disabled, this model can spend 1 fury point to remove 1 damage point from the disabled model.

name: Total Obedience
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly warrior models gain Tough.

name: Partner [Rutger Shaw]
description: While within 10" of Rutger Shaw, this model gains Tough.

name: Soul Phase
description: This model can spend a soul token at the beginning of your Control Phase to gain Incorporeal for one turn.

name: Athanc
description: Immediately after leeching, this model gains up to its ARC in fury points. It cannot exceed its ARC in fury points as a result of Athanc.

name: Death Shroud
description: While within  10" of this model, enemy models suffer –2 to their melee attack damage rolls.

name: Blood Spawn
description: Once per game, when this model suffers damage from an enemy attack and the damage is not transferred, after the attack is resolved you can place a non-character Faction lesser warbeast in play anywhere completely within 3" of this model. The warbeast is part of this model’s battlegroup. The warbeast cannot activate this turn.

name: Sacrificial Pawn [Lesser Warbeast]
description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal lesser warbeast within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

name: Blessed of Thamar
description: When this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, each Infernal model within 5" of this model loses 1 essence point.

name: •Barring the Gates (★Action)
description: When a model within 10" of this model casts a spell, increase the COST of the spell by 1. Additionally, when an Infernal model within 10" of this model summons a horror, the Infernal must spend 1 additional essence point to summon the horror. Barring the Gates lasts for one round.

name: Mass Carnage
description: This model can use Mass Carnage once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. This activation, models in this unit gain Overtake. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

name: •Hunter’s Grace (★ Action)
description: Friendly Tharn models cannot become knocked down while within 5" of this model. Hunter’s Grace lasts for one round.

name: •Sky Shaker (★Action)
description: This model gains Warping Winds for one round. (When a friendly Faction model is targeted by a ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Warping Winds, the attack suffers –3 RNG. Additionally, while within 3" of this model friendly Faction models gain Resistance: Blast.)

name: Leadership [Wolf Riders]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Wolf Riders models gain Prowl.

name: Unpredictable Movement
description: When placing unit models during their unit’s Normal Movement, after determining the advancing model’s movement place the remaining troopers in the squad within 4" of that model, not 2".

name: •Dark Seduction (★Attack)
description: RNG 8. Target enemy non-Leader warrior model. If the attack hits you take control of the target model and can immediately make a full advance with that enemy model followed by a basic attack, then Dark Seduction expires. Dark Seduction can be cast only once per activation. A model can be affected by Dark Seduction only once per turn.

name: Shadow Walk
description: Once per activation, when this model hits an enemy model with an arcane attack, after the attack is resolved, you may place this model completely within 5" of this current location.

name: No escape
description: Enemy model/units that are this model’s Prey roll one less die on attack rolls when attacking this model.

name: •A Fate Worse Than Death (★Action)
description: When a non-Leader model that is this model’s Prey activates within 6" of this model, it becomes stationary for one round. A Fate Worse than Death lasts for one round.

name: Arcana Infused
description: This model can have up to two Command Cards played on it each turn.

name: Heavy Artillery
description: This model is not a warrior model. If this model is placed during its unit’s activation, Crewmen in the unit cannot make a Fire! special attack that activation. This model is automatically hit by melee attacks and cannot become knocked down or stationary.

name: Fire! (★Attack)
description: This model must be within 1" of the Commodore to make a Fire! special attack. Only one model in this unit can make a Fire! special attack each activation. This model makes a ranged attack with the Commodore. Both models must have LOS to the target. This model does not gain a bonus for aiming when resolving a Fire! special attack. Base the RNG and all modifiers for the attack on the Commodore.

name: Gunnery (★ Action)
description: RNG 3. Target Commodore. If the Commodore is in range, a model attacking with the Commodore this activation gains a cumulative +2 RAT.

name: •Flames of Wrath (★Action)
description: Choose a friendly Faction model/unit. For one round, enemy models directly hit by melee or ranged attacks made by the affected models suffer the Fire continuous effect.

name: •Lawgiver’s Creed (★Action)
description: For one round, enemy models cannot cast spells while within 10" of this model.

name: Dream State
description: At the End of your Control Phase, this model can use Dream State. If it does, models in its battlegroup gain Incorporeal for one round. This model cannot use Dream State if it became Incorporeal during the last round.

name: Hat Trick
description: When an enemy model is boxed while in this model’s control range, you can replace the boxed model with a Phantasm model with the same or smaller base size. The replaced model is removed from play. You can have only one Phantasm model of each base size in play at any time.

name: Accursed Armor
description: A living enemy model that hits this model with an attack gains Weaken for one round. (A model with Weaken suffers -2 DEF and -2 to its melee attack damage rolls.)

name: The End of All Things
description: At the start of this model’s activation, choose one of the following special rules:

name: •Famine
description: This model’s melee weapons gain Starve this activation. (A model damaged by a weapon with Starve must forfeit either its Normal Movement or its Combat Action during its next activation.)

name: •Pestilence
description: Center a cloud effect template on this model. The template is a hazard and remains centered on this model for one round. Enemy models suffer –2 DEF while in the template.

name: Divinity
description: This model cannot become knocked down and never suffers Blind.

name: Martyrdom
description: When a friendly living Faction non-Leader warrior model within 10" of this model is disabled, this model can suffer d3 damage points to remove 1 damage point from the disabled model. This model cannot spend focus points to reduce this damage.

name: Godlike Power
description: Once per turn during its activation, this model can cast a non-animus spell that was cast by the enemy leader while in this model’s control range during your opponent’s last turn as if it were one of its own spells without spending fury. This model cannot upkeep spells that do not appear on its card.

name: Master of Ruin (★Action)
description: Other models, friendly or enemy, suffer –2 ARM while within 5" of this model. Master of Ruin lasts for one round.

name: Kingdom of Silence
description: Once per turn, when a Cohort model in this model’s battlegroup is damaged by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can cast a spell without spending fury.

name: Precision Fire
description: This model can reroll its ranged attack damage rolls. Each damage roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Precision Fire.

name: •Putrid Decay
description: During its activation, this model can spend a corpse token to gain Foul Stench for one round. (While within 5" of a model with Foul Stench, living enemy warbeasts suffer –1 FURY and THR.)

name: •Hunger Pain
description: During its activation, this model can spend a corpse token to gain Gnawing Pain for one round. (While within 8" of a model with Gnawing Pain, enemy models suffer –2 to their melee attack damage rolls.)

name: •Unstable Concoction
description: Unstable Concoction is a RNG 8, AOE 2, POW 12/8 arcane attack. Add 1 to the AOE value of this attack if the target is suffering from the Fire or Corrosion continuous effect. Add 2 to the AOE if the target is suffering from both.

name: Combat Chemistry
description: At the start of each of this model's activations, it gains one elixir token. This model can have up to three elixir tokens at any time. During its Combat Action, this model can spend elixir tokens to gain additional melee attacks, boost an attack roll, or boost a damage roll. It can make one additional attack or boost one roll for each token spent.

name: •Spontaneous Combustion
description: Spontaneous Combustion RNG 8, Pow 10 arcane attack. On a direct hit, add an additional die to this weapon’s damage roll if the model hit is suffering a continuous effect. Add two dice instead if the model hit is suffering from two different continuous effects. Then, all continuous effects on that model expire.

name: •Ice Cage
description: Ice Cage is a RNG 10 arcane attack. On a direct hit a model hit suffers a cumulative –2 DEF for one turn unless it has Resistance: Cold. When a model without Resistance: Cold is affected by two or more directly hitting Ice Cage attacks in the same turn, it becomes stationary for one round.

name: Combat Alchemy
description: Once during this model's combat action, this model can spend an elixir token to cast a spell.

name: Crossroads
description: At the end of your turn, place three road markers anywhere completely within 6" of this model. At the start of your Maintenance Phase, you can place this model in the location of any of its road markers. The road markers are then removed whether or not this model was placed. If a model contacts a road marker, remove the road marker from the table.

name: Hidden Paths
description: When an enemy model contacts a road marker while advancing, after that model completes its movement one friendly Faction model currently in this model’s control range can advance up to 2". A model can move only once per turn as a result of Hidden Paths.

name: Deflect
description: When an enemy model misses this model with a non-spray ranged attack, the attacking model becomes the target of the attack and is directly hit by the attack. This model becomes the point of origin for the attack.

name: Take A Bullet
description: When a friendly model is targeted by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of this model, you can choose to have this model become the target of the attack instead. If you do, this model is considered to be within the attacker’s LOS and within the RNG of the attack. This model can use Take A Bullet only once per round and cannot use Take A Bullet if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary.

name: Coven
description: The Witch Coven of Garlghast is made up of Helleana, Morgaen, and Selene. The Coven shares a single focus pool, and Coven models do not receive focus individually. The Coven’s base ARC is three times the number of models in the Coven that are in play. When the Coven replenishes its focus, the Egregore receives those focus points. The Coven’s control range is measured from the Egregore. Any Coven model in the Coven’s control range can spend focus points on the Egregore. Effects that reduce or remove focus never affect the Egregore. The Coven can use its feat only once. The Coven counts as a single warcaster when calculating Field Allowance. The Coven can have up to one attached model, which is attached to the Coven, not to an individual model in the Coven. The Coven can have only one of each of its upkeep spells in play at any time.

name: Perfect Conjunction
description: A Perfect Conjunction is established any time the Egregore is completely within the triangular area between all three Witches. During a Perfect Conjunction, arcane attack rolls made by one of the Witches are automatically boosted.

name: •Fly’s Kiss (★Attack)
description: Fly's Kiss is a RNG 8, POW 12 arcane attack. If this attack boxes an enemy model, models within 2" of the boxed model suffer an unboostable POW 10 corrosion blast damage roll, then the boxed model is removed from play.

name: •Dark Calling (★Action)
description: RNG 3. Target friendly horror. If the horror is in range, it immediately makes one basic melee or ranged attack. A model can be targeted by Dark Calling special action only once per turn.

name: Veteran Leader [Warwitch Coven]
description: While within 10" of this model, Warwitch models gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: •Spine Burst (★Attack)
description: Spine Burst is a RNG 10, POW 10 arcane attack. If target model is hit, the d3 nearest models within 5" of it suffer a POW 10 magical damage roll. These additional damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Spine Burst damage rolls are simultaneous.

name: Elite Cadre [Daughters of the Flame]
description: Friendly Daughters of the Flame models gain Vengeance.  (During your Maintenance Phase, if one or more models in a unit with Vengeance were damaged by enemy attacks during the last round, each model in the unit can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.)

name: Gates of Death
description: At the end of your turn, place this model anywhere completely within 5" of its current location.

name: Field Marshal [Side Step]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Side Step.

name: Sacrificial Pawn [Permutation Servitor]
description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Permutation Servitor model within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

name: Servitor Satellites
description: At the start of this model’s activation, remove any Permutation Servitors this model put into play from the table. Once per activation, after its Normal Movement, this model can place up to three Permutation Servitors anywhere within 1" of itself. During its Combat Action, this model can make one additional Aperture Pulse ranged attack for each Permutation Servitor it did not place that activation.

name: Trap Door (★ Action)
description: Replace this model with a trap door marker. At the beginning of each of your Maintenance Phases, you can choose to put this model back in play. If you do, place this model anywhere completely within 3" of the trap door marker, then remove the marker from the table. This model cannot use Trap Door that turn.

name: Flank [Trencher]
description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Trencher model, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

name: Reinforcements [Trencher]
description: During your Maintenance Phase, return d3 small-based friendly destroyed Trencher Grunts to play. Models return with 1 unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts within 8" this model and within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

name: Trench Network
description: Immediately after placing this model during deployment, you can place up to two trench terrain features on the table. These trench terrain features must be placed either in base contact with this model or in contact with a trench terrain feature that is in base contact with this model. These trench terrain features cannot be placed in contact with a non-trench terrain feature.

name: Ammo Feeder (★Action)
description: While this model is B2B with the Gunner, the Gunner’s ranged attack damage rolls against warrior models are boosted. Ammo Feeder lasts for one round.

name: Granted: Precision Fire
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit can reroll ranged attack damage rolls. Each damage roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Precision Fire.

name: Arcane Negation
description: When an enemy model targets this model or another model within 3" of it with a spell, you can force this model to negate the spell. The negated spell does not take effect, but its COST remains spent.

name: Leadership [Trollkin Champions]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Trollkin Champions models gain Retaliatory Strike.

name: Desperate Pace [Weapon Crew] (★Action)
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Weapon Crew trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

name: •Trembler (★Action)
description: Enemy models within 1" of this model become knocked down.

name: Place Charges
description: RNG 6. One model in this unit can use Place Charges once per game at any time during its activation to remove a defence within range from the table

name: Leadership [Praetorian Ferox]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Praetorian Ferox models gain Dodge.

name: Shadow Guardian
description: You can choose not to deploy this model at the start of the game. If it is not deployed normally, you can put it into play when a friendly non-Umbral Faction model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack. Place this model completely within 3" of the hit model. This model is automatically hit by the ranged attack instead and suffers all damage and effects.

name: Birds of Prey
description: While in Una’s control range, Griffon warbeasts in her battlegroup gain Flank [another Griffon in Una’s battlegroup]. (When a model with Flank [another Griffon in Una’s battlegroup] makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of another Griffon in Una’s battlegroup, the model with Flank gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.)

name: Leadership [Ursine Shifted]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Ursine Shifted models gain Defiant Rage, and Retaliatory Strike.

name: Protective Rage
description: When a friendly Faction model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack, if this model is not yet in play you can choose to have this model replace a friendly Faction Marked model within 3" of the model hit.  This model is automatically hit instead and suffers all damage and effects. Remove the replaced Marked model from play. Protective Rage can only be used once per attack.

name: Spirit Vessel
description: This model begins the game as Living Vaelyss. When Living Vaelyss is destroyed by an enemy attack, before removing her from the table place the Avenging Spirit anywhere completely within 5" of her current location.

name: •Brother’s Keeper
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Faction models cannot become knocked down or made stationary. Brothers Keeper lasts for one round.

name: •Arcane Bolt (★Attack)
description: Arcane Bolt is a RNG 12, POW 11 arcane attack.

name: Dark Sentinel
description: Once per turn, when an enemy model advances and ends its movement within 5" of this model, a friendly Faction Cohort model within 5" of this model can immediately make a full advance followed by a basic melee or ranged attack targeting the enemy model.

name: •Combat Coordination [Venator]
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Venator model. If the target model is in range, during its activation this turn, it can reroll one attack or damage roll, then Combat Coordination expires.

name: •Desperate Pace [Faction weapon crew]
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction weapon crew trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

name: Holy Reliquary
description: This model can use each of the following miracles once per turn. This model suffers d3 damage points each time it uses a miracle. This damage is suffered immediately after the miracle takes effect.

name: •Bonds of Faith
description: This model can use this miracle at any time during its activation. Remove d3 damage points from each other friendly Faction models within 10" of this model. Additionally, when this miracle is used, enemy upkeep spells and animi on models/units within 10" of this model immediately expire. A spellcaster can keep any of its upkeep spells in play by suffering d3 damage points per spell.

name: •Doors of Judgment
description: Once per turn when a friendly living Faction warrior model within 10" of this model is disabled by an enemy attack at any time except while it is advancing, this model can use this miracle. The disabled model can immediately make a full advance and can make one basic attack, then the disabled model is destroyed.

name: •Eruption of Faith
description: This model can use this miracle once per turn at any time during its activation. When this miracle is used, enemy models currently within 2" of this model suffer an unboostable POW 12 fire damage roll and the Fire continuous effect and are pushed 4" directly away from this model in the order you choose.

name: •God’s Wrath
description: This model can use this miracle at any time during its activation. This model can make one additional ranged attack during its Combat Action this activation.

name: •Beast Lore
description: RNG 3. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains boosted attack rolls against warbeasts for one turn.

name: Caustic Presence [Corrosion]
description: Corrosion continuous effects that affect enemy models in this model’s control range cannot expire.

name: •Menoth's Sight (★Action)
description: Choose a friendly Faction model. While within 6" of this model, the chosen model gains Eyeless Sight. Menoth’s Sight lasts for one turn.

name: Might of Kings
description: While this model is damaged, it gains +2 ARM and +2 to its melee attack damage rolls. If a friendly model damages this model with an attack, this model loses Might of Kings for the rest of the game.

name: Arcantrik Capacitor
description: When a model within 10" of this model casts a spell, this model gains 1 power token. This model can have up to 3 power tokens at any time. During its Combat Action, this model can spend power tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each power token spent.

name: Void Induction
description: When a friendly soulless model is disabled by an enemy attack while within 10" of this model, this model can spend one power token to replace that model with a Wight model. The replaced model is destroyed. You can have up to three friendly Wights in play at any time for each friendly Void Engine in play.

name: Power-Charged [Kinetic field]
description: This model can spend 1 power token at any time during its activation to gain Kinetic Field for one round. (A model with Kinetic Field and friendly Faction models within 3" of it gain +2 ARM against ranged attacks and gain Resistance: Blast.)

name: Wasting Power
description: This model can use Wasting Power at any time during its activation. When it does, animi and upkeep spells on models within 8" of this model immediately expire, then this model is removed from play.

name: Leadership [Void Spirits]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Void Spirit models gain Tough and Stealth.

name: •Recalibration (★Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, you can have it reroll one attack or damage roll, then Recalibration expires. Recalibration lasts for one turn.

name: Alter the Deal (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly non-soulless warrior model/unit gains Marked Soul for one turn. (Mark Soul - This model is a Marked Soul.)

name: Master Summoner
description: Horrors summoned by this model enter play with essence equal to their ESSENCE stat.

name: Sic ’Em
description: Once per turn if this model is not engaged, when a friendly model hits an enemy model with a melee or ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can charge the model hit. This model’s charge attack roll is boosted.

name: Field Marshal [Fuel for the Flames]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Fuel for the Flames [5"].

name: Leadership [Blighted Ogruns]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Blighted Ogrun models gain Blood Drinker.

name: •Berserk
description: When this model destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.

name: •Prowl
description: While this model has concealment, it gains Stealth.

name: •Deathly Power (★ Action)
description: This model gains Dark Shroud for one turn. (While within 2" of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.)

name: •Flesh Eater (★ Attack)
description: Flesh Eater is a RNG 8, POW 10 arcane attack. When Flesh Eater destroys an enemy warrior model, you can remove d3 damage points from a friendly living model within 6" of this model.

name: Escapees
description: If this model is disabled by an enemy attack, replace it with a Gremlin Swarm solo and remove this model from play.

name: Practiced Shot
description: If this model uses its Normal Movement to aim, it ignores Stealth and this weapon gains +3 RNG that activation.

name: Waken the Stones
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Faction construct warbeasts gain Hyper-Aggressive. (When a model with Hyper-Aggressive suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance directly toward the attacking model.)

name: Reinforcements [Small-based]
description: During your Maintenance Phase, return d3 small-based friendly destroyed small-based Grunts to play. Models return with 1 unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts within 8" this model and within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

name: Leadership [Widowmaker Scouts]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Widowmaker Scout models gain Swift Hunter.

name: Support Weapons [Winter Korps Infantry]
description: Each time you add this unit to your army, choose two Support Weapon Troopers to add to the unit. You can add two of the same Support Weapon Trooper to the unit. The options for Support Weapon Troopers to add to this unit are Auto Cannon, Grenade Porter, and Rocketeer.

name: Human Wave
description: During your Maintenance Phase, return all destroyed Grunts in this unit to play. Place the returned Grunts within 2" of this model. Returned Grunts must forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

name: Granted: Fragmentation Grenades
description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Fragmentation Grenade weapons.

name: •Desperate Pace [Small and Medium-Based Winter Korps]
description: RNG 5. Target friendly small or medium-based Winter Korps trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

name: Sniper
description: Instead of making a damage roll to resolve a ranged attack, this model can inflict 1 damage point. A model disabled by a ranged attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll.

name: Arcane Manifestation
description: Once per turn, at any time during its activation, place this model anywhere completely within 10" of its current location.

name: Briar Thicket
description: An enemy model without Flight entering or ending its activation within 2" of this model suffers a POW 10 damage roll. Warrior models damaged by this roll become knocked down.

name: Immovable
description: This model has no Normal Movement, cannot become knocked down or be moved, and is automatically hit by melee attacks.

name: Flank [Wolf Sworn ]
description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Wolf Sworn model, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

name: Soul Bondage
description: Once per round when a living enemy warrior model is destroyed within 2" of this model, you can replace the destroyed model with a Machine Wraith solo. The destroyed model is removed from play and does not provide a soul token.

name: Unhallowed
description: While within 10", friendly Faction undead models gain +2 ARM against ranged and arcane attacks.

name: Wraith Walker
description: At the end of your Control Phase, this model can gain Incorporeal for one round unless it gained Incorporeal during the last round.

name: Wraithbinder
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Incorporeal models gain +3 ARM.

name: Grappling Hook
description: At the end this models activation, this model can spend 1 focus point to be placed completely within 5" of its current location.

name: Soul Taker: Altar of Sacrifice
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living model is destroyed in this model’s control range, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. After this model leeches during your next Control Phase, replace each soul token with 1 fury point.

name: Field Marshal [+2 SPD]
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain +2 SPD.

name: •Freezing Mist (★ Action)
description: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. While in the template, living enemy models without Resistance: Cold suffer –2 to attack rolls.

name: Elite Cadre [Kossite Woodsmen and Manhunters]
description: Friendly Kossite Woodsmen and Manhunters models gain Treewalker.

name: Dark Legacy
description: When a friendly Faction model within 5" of this model is targeted by a ranged attack, the attack suffers –3 RNG.

name: Veneficium
description: When a spell or special rule on an enemy model causes one or more of this model’s upkeep spells to expire, the enemy model suffers d3 damage points for each of this model’s upkeep spells that expire. Roll a separate d3 for each spell.

name: •Divinator
description: While in this model’s control range, models in its battlegroup can reroll failed attack rolls. Each roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Divinator.

name: •Hellhole
description: Return d3 friendly destroyed Faction Grunts to play. Models return with 1 unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts completely within this model’s control range and within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn it is returned to play.

name: •Power Magnifier
description: This model can spend 1 focus point at any time during its activation to give 2 focus points to a warjack in its battlegroup that is in its control range.

name: Bond [Rhyas or Saeryn]
description: If Zuriel begins the game in Rhyas’ or Saeryn’s battlegroup, it is bonded to that model. Zuriel is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While this model is bonded to Rhyas and in her control range, it gains Stealth. While this model is bonded to Saeryn and in her control range, it gains Unstoppable.

name: Cumbersome
description: This model cannot attack with this weapon and with another weapon during the same activation.

name: Powerful Attack
description: When attacking with this weapon, this model can spend 1 focus point or be forced to boost all attack and damage rolls for the attack.

name: Armor-Piercing (★Attack)
description: When calculating damage from this weapon, halve the base ARM stats of models hit.

name: Beat Back
description: Immediately after a basic attack with this weapon is resolved during this model’s Combat Action, the enemy model hit can be pushed 1" directly away from the attacking model. After the enemy model is pushed, the attacking model can advance up to 1" directly toward it.

name: Arcing Fire
description: When attacking with this weapon, this model can ignore intervening models.

name: Critical Knockdown
description: On a critical hit, models hit become knocked down.

name: Critical Shred
description: On a critical hit with this weapon during this model’s Combat Action, after the attack is resolved this model can make one additional attack with this weapon against the model hit.

name: Sustained Attack
description: During this model’s activation, when it makes an attack with this weapon against the last model hit by the weapon this activation, the attack automatically hits.

name: Critical Knockdown
description: On a critical hit, the model hit becomes knocked down.

name: Thresher (★Attack)
description: This model makes one melee attack with this weapon against each model in its LOS that is in this weapon’s melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model. Thresher attacks are simultaneous.

name: Both Barrels (★Attack)
description: This model gains +4 to the damage roll for this attack. This model cannot make additional ranged attacks with this weapon during an activation in which it makes a Both Barrels attack.

name: Critical Pitch
description: On a critical hit against a model with an equal or smaller base, the model hit can be thrown d6" directly away from this model. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this attack.

name: Volume Fire
description: Gain +1 to attack and damage rolls with this weapon against medium-based models and +2 to attack and damage rolls against larger-based models.

name: Forced Reload [1]
description: This model can be forced once during its activation to make one additional ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action.

name: Critical Shred
description: On a critical hit with this weapon during this model’s Combat Action, after the attack is resolved this model can make one additional attack with this weapon against the model hit.

name: Inflict Pain
description: When it hits a warbeast with this weapon, this model can place 1 fury point on or remove 1 fury point from the warbeast.

name: Brain Damage
description: A model damaged by an attack with this weapon cannot cast spells for one round.

featDescription: This activation, Sabbreth can cast each of her spells once without spending focus points. Friendly Faction warrior models beginning a charge in Sabbreth’s control range gain +2 SPD during that charge. Invocations of Fire lasts for one turn.

name: Saeryn, Omen of Everblight
featDescription: While in Saeryn’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +3 ARM and models in her battlegroup gain Retaliatory Strike. Foreboding lasts for one round. (If a model with Retaliatory Strike is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved the model with Retaliatory Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. A model can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

name: Saeryn, Talon of Everblight
cards.portraitPath: /Media/Portraits/portrait legion saeryn & rhyas talons of everblight.png
featDescription: Conjoined Spirits can be used once per game by either Saeryn or Rhyas. When it is used, you can either have Saeryn and Rhyas immediately trade places or you can return one of them to play. If you choose to return Saeryn or Rhyas to play, place the returned model completely within 3" of the model that used Conjoined Spirits. The returned model comes into play with a number of fury points equal to its ARC. After Conjoined Spirits is used, Saeryn and Rhyas cannot advance for the rest of the turn. If you return Saeryn to play as a result of Conjoined Spirits, Rhyas is no longer a warlock or a Leader model  and returns to being a solo.

name: Scyrafael, Nis-Issyr of Desolations
featDescription: Enemy models that advance and end their movement in or are placed in Scyrafael’s control range and closer to her than they began suffer an unboostable pow 10 magical damage roll, then are pushed d3" directly away from Scyrafael in the order you choose. Iron Storm lasts for one round.

name: Sergeant Brunaugh "Bruno" Ramjaw
cards.devNotes: I feel like this guy is an anti-personnel hunter. He is walking around with this machine hun mowing down anything in his path.

name: Sergeant Hulder Craghorn
featDescription: You may choose a friendly Trapdoor marker within 7" of Craghorn. A friendly Faction model/unit with the Tunnel Ambush rule that is not in play immediately ambushes to the chosen marker.  Choose up to 3 friendly Faction models/units that ambushed this turn. They gain +2 to damage rolls. Break Out! lasts one turn.

name: Servath Reznik, Wrath of Ages
cards.portraitPath: /Media/Portraits/portrait protectorate servath reznik wrath of ages.png
featDescription: When an enemy model is boxed by a melee or ranged attack while in Reznik’s control range, enemy models within 2" of the boxed models suffer an unboostable POW 12 fire damage roll. After resolving this damage, the boxed model is removed from play. This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack. Purge the Faithless lasts for one turn.

name: Shyryss, the Flawless Dark
featDescription: While in Shyryss' control range, friendly models gain concealment and Dodge. Additionally when a friendly Faction model within Shyryss’ control range is targeted by a charge or slam, the charging or slamming model suffers –3 SPD when resolving the charge or slam. The Dark Silence lasts for one round. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

name: Sir Dreyfus the Storm Knight
cards.portraitPath: /Media/Portraits/portrait cygnar sir dreyfus the storm knight.png

name: Skarre, Admiral of the Blackfleet
cards.portraitPath: /Media/Portraits/portrait cryx skarre admiral of the black fleet.png
featDescription: Skarre can suffer 1 damage point to cast a spell instead of spending focus this activation. She can cast each of her spells once as a result of Blood Rites.

name: Skarre, Queen of the Broken Coast
cards.portraitPath: /Media/Portraits/portrait cryx skarre queen of the broken coast.png
featDescription: Skarre immediately suffers up to 5 damage points. Skarrel cannot spend focus points to reduce this damage. For each damage point she suffers as a result of Fate Weaver, one model currently in her control range can be affected by Fate Weaver. An affected friendly model cannot be targeted by charges and gains +5 DEF for one round. An affected enemy model suffers –5 to attack rolls for one round.

name: Sovereign Tristan Durant
featDescription: Warjacks in Durant’s battlegroup currently in his control range gain 1 focus point. Durant gains 1 focus point for each warjack in his battlegroup currently in his control range. Durant cannot have more focus points than his current ARC as a result of Prayers of War.

name: Storm Lances
cards.devNotes: Gained +1 ARM, Unyielding, and Shield Weapon in shield cleanup pass. Cost 10.

name: Stormblade Captain
cards.devNotes: Gained +1 ARM in shield cleanup pass.

name: Sturgis the Corrupted
featDescription: Enemy non-Leader models in Sturgis’ control range are immediately pushed 3" directly toward Sturgis in the order you choose. Then enemy models within 3" of Sturgis suffer a POW 12 magical damage roll. These damage rolls are simultaneous. For each model destroyed by Dead on Arrival, you can allocate 1 focus point to a warjack in Sturgis’ battlegroup in his control range.

name: Sturm & Drang
featDescription: While in Strum & Drang’s control range enemy Cohort models cannot gain, be allocated, or spend focus or essence points, or be forced. While in Sturm & Drang’s control range, enemy models cannot be used to channel spells. Psychic Apocalypse lasts for one round.

name: Supreme Aptimus Zaal
featDescription: Zaal gains a number of ancestral rage tokens equal to the number of friendly Faction warrior models that have been destroyed and not returned to play since the start of the game. While in Zaal’s control range, friendly Faction models can spend ancestral rage tokens on Zaal to boost one melee attack or melee damage roll for each token spent. At the end of the turn, remove unspent ancestral rage tokens from Zaal.

name: Supreme Archdomina Makeda
featDescription: While in Makeda’s control range, friendly Faction models gain boosted melee attack rolls and cannot become knocked down. Instruments of War lasts for one round.

name: Supreme Kommandant Irusk
featDescription: Friendly Faction models currently in Irusk’s control range ignore cloud effects and forests when determining LOS and gain Pathfinder. Affected models currently knocked down immediately stand up. Enemy models/units beginning their activations in Irusk’s control range suffer –3 SPD. Desperate Ground lasts for one round.

name: Tanith the Feral Song
featDescription: Tanith can channel spells through warbeasts in her battlegroup while they are in her control range. Additionally, when Tanith or a warbeast in her battlegroup in her control range casts a spell, reduce the COST of the spell by 1. When Tanith casts a spell affected by Rites of the Wurm, the COST of a spell cannot be reduced to less than 1. Rites of the Wurm lasts for one turn.

name: Taryn di la Rovissi, Llaelese Gun Mage
cards.portraitPath: /Media/Portraits/portrait mercenary taryn di la rovissi llaelese gun mage.png

name: Testament of Menoth
featDescription: Friendly Faction models currently in the Testament’s control range gain Incorporeal. When declaring charges and slam power attacks or when making attacks, friendly Faction models can ignore models in the Testament’s control range when determining LOS. Essence of Dust lasts for one turn.

name: Thagrosh, Prophet of Everblight
featDescription: Return one destroyed large-based or smaller warbeast that was part of Thagrosh’s battlegroup to play. Place it anywhere completely within 3" of him. The warbeast must forfeit its Combat Action this turn.

name: Thagrosh, the Messiah
featDescription: After all friendly models have completed their activations this turn, each warbeast in Thagrosh’s battlegroup that is in his control range can make a full advance followed by one basic melee attack. Completely resolve each warbeast’s movement and attack before moving on to the next.

name: The Harbinger of Menoth
featDescription: For one round, advancing enemy models that end their movement within 10" of the Harbinger and closer to her than they began suffer an unboostable POW 14 fire damage roll.

name: The High Reclaimer
featDescription: Return d3 + 5 friendly destroyed Faction troopers to play. Place those models within 2" of another model in their unit and completely within the High Reclaimer’s control range. Returned models must forfeit thier Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

name: The Old Witch of Khador
cards.portraitPath: /Media/Portraits/portrait khador the old witch of khador.png
featDescription: Enemy models that advance and end their movement in or are placed in the Old Witch’s control range immediately suffer an unboostable POW 14 magical damage roll. Warrior models damaged by Field of Talons become knocked down. Field of Talons lasts for one round.

name: The Witch Coven of Garlghast
cards.portraitPath: /Media/Portraits/portrait cryx the witch coven of garlghast.png
featDescription: While in the Coven’s control range, enemy models have their LOS reduced to 5". Nightfall lasts for one round.

name: Thyra, Flame of Sorrow
featDescription: Immediately place Thyra anywhere completely within 2" of her current location. When a friendly Faction model activates in Thyra’s control range, at the start of its activation you can place it anywhere completely within 2" of its current location. Shadows of Urcaen lasts for one turn.

name: Thyron, Sword of Truth
featDescription: Thyron and friendly Faction models beginning their activations in his control range gain +2 SPD. Additionally, while in Thyron’s control range, friendly Faction models gain Duelist. Blades of Vengeance lasts for one round.

name: Tyrant Xerxis
featDescription: While in Xerxis’ control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on their melee damage rolls. While in Xerxis’ control range and B2B with another friendly Faction model, friendly Faction models gain +2 ARM. Total Annihilation lasts for one round.

name: Tyrus, Nis-Arsyr of Spiders
cards.portraitPath: /Media/Portraits/portrait dusk tyrus nis arsyr of spiders.png
featDescription: Immediately place Tyrus and friendly Faction models currently in his control range anywhere completely within 2" of their current locations. Additionally, Tyrus and friendly Faction models/units activating in his control range gain Ghostly. Invocation of Shadow lasts for one turn. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

name: Una the Skyhunter
featDescription: Friendly Faction models with Flight currently in Una’s control range gain +2 SPD for one turn. Additionally, while in Una’s control range friendly Faction light warbeasts with Flight cannot be targeted by melee attacks. From on High lasts for one round.

name: Vaelyss, The Hand of Mourning
cards.portraitPath: /Media/Portraits/portrait dusk vaelyss the hand of mourning.png

name: Valka Curseborn, Chieftain of the North
cards.portraitPath: /Media/Portraits/portrait trollblood valka curseborn chieftain of the north.png

name: Vallyx, Fate's Eclipse
featDescription: When a friendly Faction model directly hits a model in Vallyx's control range with an attack, resolve the attack as if it was a critical hit. Blood Moon lasts for one round.

name: Vayl, Consul of Everblight
featDescription: This activation, Vayl can cast each of her spells once without spending fury.

name: Vayl, Disciple of Everblight
featDescription: At the end of this turn after all friendly models have ended their activations, each friendly non-trooper Faction model in Vayl’s control range can make a full advance.

name: Vice Scrutator Vindictus
featDescription: While in Vindictus’ control range, friendly Faction warrior models cannot be targeted by charges, slam power attacks, enemy spells, or non-magical ranged attacks. Divine Protection lasts for one round.

name: Visgoth Juviah Rhoven & Honor Guard
cards.portraitPath: /Media/Portraits/portrait protectorate visgoth juviah rhoven & honor guard.png

name: Vladimir Tzepesci, Great Prince of Umbrey
cards.portraitPath: /Media/Portraits/portrait khador vladimir tzepesci great prince of umbrey.png
featDescription: While in Vladimir’s control range, friendly Faction warjacks and cavalry models gain Side Step and Sprint. Charge of the Horse Lords lasts for one turn. (When a model with Side Step hits an enemy model with an initial melee attack or a melee special attack, the model with Side Step can advance up to 2" after the attack is resolved.) (At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, a model with Sprint can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.)

name: Vladimir Tzepesci, The Dark Champion
cards.portraitPath: /Media/Portraits/portrait khador vladimir tzepesci the dark champion.png
featDescription: Choose d3 + 3 friendly Faction non-character warrior models currently in Vladimir’s control range. Those models gain +3 SPD, MAT, RAT, DEF, and ARM. Additionally, affected models gain +3 to their melee attack damage rolls. Blood Legacy lasts for one round.

name: Vladimir Tzepesci, The Dark Prince
cards.portraitPath: /Media/Portraits/portrait khador vladimir tzepesci the dark prince.png
featDescription: Warjacks in Vladimir’s battlegroup beginning their activations in his control range double their base SPD and can run, charge, and make power attacks without spending focus. Forced March lasts for one turn.

name: Void Seer Mordikaar
featDescription: While in Mordikaar’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF and Poltergeist. Void Wind lasts for one round.

name: Vorgoroth, Conduit of the Abyss
featDescription: Summon a horror without spending essence. Malignant Conduit does not count towards the maximum number of horrors this model can summon per activation or game. The horror summoned by Malignant Conduit must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat action the turn it is summoned.

name: Vyros, Incissar of the Dawnguard
cards.portraitPath: /Media/Portraits/portrait retribution vyros incissar of the dawnguard.png
featDescription: When one or more friendly Faction models are destroyed or removed from play by an enemy attack while in Vyros’ control range at any time except while advancing, immediately after the attack is resolved one friendly Faction model in Vyros’ control range can advance up to 3". Tide of Battle lasts for one round.

name: Warchief Bagadibawm
featDescription: Friendly Faction models in Bagadibawm’s control area gain +2 SPD and Ghostly for one round. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

name: Warwitch Deneghra
featDescription: Enemy models currently in Deneghra’s control range suffer –2 SPD, MAT, RAT, DEF, and ARM. The Withering lasts for one round.

name: Winter Guard Field Gun Crew
cards.portraitPath: /Media/Portraits/portrait khador winter guard field gun crew.png

name: Winter Guard Infantry Officer & Standard
cards.portraitPath: /Media/Portraits/portrait khador winter guard infantry officer & standard.png

name: Winter Korps Infantry
pointCostDescription: 3 Grunts and Two Support Weapon Troopers

name: Wolves of Orboros Chieftain & Standard
cards.portraitPath: /Media/Portraits/portrait circle wolves of orboros chieftain & standard.png

name: Wraith Witch Deneghra
featDescription: Choose d3 + 3 friendly non-Leader Faction models currently in Deneghra’s control range. The chosen models gain Incorporeal for one round.

name: Wraithbinder Nekane
featDescription: Nekane can suffer one damage point to cast a spell instead of paying the COST of the spell in focus points. Each spell can be cast once as a result of Wrath of Lyliss. Additionally, Nekane can suffer one damage point to boost an attack or damage roll instead of spending a focus point. Wrath of Lyliss lasts for one round.

name: Wurmwood, Tree of Fate
featDescription: The area within 10" of Wurmwood becomes a forest. Enemy models that become knocked down while within 10" of Wurmwood suffer 1 damage point. Black Roots lasts for one round.

name: Xerxis, Fury of Halaak
featDescription: All models are considered to be in Xerxis’ control range. Friendly Faction models gain an additional die on attack and damage rolls. For each of those rolls, discard one die of your choice. Hand of the Ancients lasts for one turn.

name: Zaal, The Ancestral Advocate
featDescription: Remove d6 + 3 damage points from each friendly Faction construct model currently in Zaal’s control range. While in Zaal’s control range, friendly Faction construct models gain +3 ARM. Strength Eternal lasts for one round.

name: Zaateroth, The Weaver of Shadows
featDescription: While in Zaateroth’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF. When an enemy model misses a friendly Faction model in Zaateroth’s control range with an attack, immediately after the attack is resolved place the friendly model anywhere completely within 2" of its current location. Whispering Void lasts for one round.

name: Zevanna Agha, The Fate Keeper
cards.portraitPath: /Media/Portraits/portrait grymkin zevanna agha the fate keeper.png
featDescription: The Old Witch gains the benefit of all of her Arcane Machinery effects this activation.

name: Convection
description: When Convection destroys a living enemy model, you can give 1 focus point to a warjack in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range.

name: Energizer
description: Each model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is currently in its control range can immediately advance up to 2". Energizer can be cast only once per activation.

name: Hellwrought
description: Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 ARM and Retaliation. (If a model with Retaliation was damaged by an enemy attack during the last round, during your Maintenance Phase it can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.)

name: Quagmire
description: While B2B with target friendly Faction model/unit, enemy models suffer –2 DEF and cannot advance.

name: Batten Down the Hatches
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup cannot become knocked down and gain +3 ARM but suffer –2 DEF. Batten Down the Hatches lasts for one round.

name: Torment
description: When a model is damaged by Torment, for one round it loses Tough, cannot remove damage, and cannot transfer damage.

name: Recoil
description: The spellcaster gains Swift Hunter. Recoil lasts for one turn. (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

name: Bombshell
description: On a critical hit, models hit are thrown d6" directly away from the attacker. Roll distance once for all models affected. Move models farthest from the attacker first. Instead of suffering blast damage, models hit but not directly hit suffer a POW 10 damage roll. The POW of collateral damage is 10.

name: Mobility
description: Models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup currently in its control range gain +2 SPD and Pathfinder for one turn.

name: Revive
description: Target one friendly trooper model. Return one destroyed Grunt model to the target model’s unit. The Grunt is returned with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunt within 2" of the target model. The Grunt model must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is returned to play.

name: Vision
description: When target friendly Faction model is directly hit by an attack, you can choose to have it suffer no damage roll from the attack, then Vision expires.

name: Dark Seduction
description: Take control of target enemy non-Leader warrior model. You can immediately make a full advance with that enemy model followed by a basic attack, then Dark Seduction expires. Dark Seduction can be cast only once per activation. A model can be affected by Dark Seduction only once per turn.

name: Hand of Morrow
description: Target friendly Faction model’s/unit’s weapons gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical.

name: Flashing Blade
description: The spellcaster immediately makes one basic attack with one of its melee weapons against each enemy model in its LOS that is in the weapon’s melee range. These attacks are simultaneous.

name: Ward
description: Enemy spells that target an affected friendly model suffer and -5 RNG and +1 COST. When an affected model it directly hit bay an enemy arcane attack, Ward expires.

name: Crusader's Call
description: Friendly Faction models beginning a charge in the spellcaster’s control range gain +2 SPD. Crusader’s Call lasts for one turn.

name: Fortune
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit can reroll its missed attack rolls. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Fortune.

name: Repudiate
description: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on the model/unit directly hit by Repudiate immediately expire. When an upkeep spell expires as a result of Repudiate, the model maintaining the spell suffers d3 damage points.

name: Sunburst
description: Sunburst blast damage affects only enemy models. Models boxed by Sunburst are removed from play.

name: Arcantrik Bolt
description: A warjack damaged by this attack becomes stationary for one round.

name: Blur
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +3 DEF against ranged and arcane attacks.

name: Death Ward
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM. If an affected warjack is damaged, choose which column suffers the damage.

name: Iron Aggression
description: Target friendly Faction warjack can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without spending focus and gains boosted melee attack rolls.

name: Scourge
description: On a direct hit, models hit by this attack become knocked down.

name: Snipe
description: Target friendly Faction model’s/unit’s ranged weapons gain +3 RNG.

name: Bullet Dodger
description: Target friendly Faction model gains +2 DEF and Dodge. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

name: Calamity
description: Target enemy model/unit suffers –2 DEF and ARM.

name: Escort
description: Cohort models in the spellcaster's battlegroup beginning their activations in the spellcaster's control range gain +2 SPD when advancing as part of their Normal Movement. The spellcaster gains +2 ARM while one or more cohort models in its battlegroup are within 3" of it.

name: Obliteration
description: On a critical hit, models hit are knocked down.

name: Flicker
description: Place models in Caine’s battlegroup currently in his control range  anywhere completely within 2" of their current locations. Flicker can be cast only once per activation.

name: Mage Sight
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Eyeless Sight.

name: Fire Group
description: While models in the spellcaster's battlegroup are in its control range, their ranged weapons gain +2 RNG. Fire Group lasts for one turn.

name: Moving Shadows
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Run & Gun. (At the end of its activation, if it destroyed one or more enemy models with ranged attacks that activation, a model with Run & Gun can make a full advance.)

name: Psycho Surgery
description: Each model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup currently in its control range can immediately remove d3 + 1 damage points. This spell can be cast only once per activation.

name: Deadweight
description: When Deadweight destroys an enemy living or undead model, choose an enemy model within 2" of it. The chosen model must forfeit either its Normal Movement or its Combat Action during its next activation, as its controller chooses.

name: Psychic Assault
description: This spell ignores LOS.

name: Scything Touch
description: Target friendly Faction model gains Dark Shroud. (While within 2" of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer – 2 ARM.)

name: Occult Whispers
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on their Arcane Attack rolls. Occult Whispers lasts for one turn.

name: Avenging Force
description: If one or more friendly Faction warrior models were damaged by enemy attacks while in the spellcaster's control range during your opponent’s last turn, during your Maintenance Phase one model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup in its control range can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.

name: Burning Ash
description: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. While in the template, living enemy models without Resistance: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls.

name: Fortify
description: Target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 ARM. That model and any friendly models B2B with it cannot become knocked down, be pushed, or be moved by a slam.

name: Return Fire
description: When target friendly Faction model is targeted by an enemy ranged attack, after the attack is resolved the affected model can make one basic melee or ranged attack, then Return Fire expires. Return Fire lasts for one round.

name: Bleed
description: When Bleed damages a living enemy model, this model can remove d3 damage points.

name: Blood Rain
description: Blood Rain causes corrosion damage. Models hit suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.

name: Playing God
description: Target friendly living Faction warbeast is affected by Spontaneous Mutation effects while they affect Absylonia. Additionally, once per turn Absylonia can transfer damage to the affected warbeast without spending fury.

name: Refuge
description: At the end of an activation in which target friendly Faction model hit an enemy model with an attack, the affected model can make a full advance.

name: Wild Aggression
description: Target friendly living warbeast in the spellcaster’s battlegroup can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without being forced and gains boosted melee attack rolls.

name: Indomitable
description: The spellcaster gains Unyielding. Indomitable lasts for one round. (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

name: Counterblast
description: When an enemy model advances and ends its movement or is placed within 5" of the spellcaster, the spellcaster can make one basic melee or ranged attack targeting that model, then Counterblast expires. Counterblast lasts for one round.

name: Force Blast
description: Target a model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range. Enemy models currently within 2" of the target model are pushed 2" directly away from it in the order you choose.

name: Force Hammer
description: Instead of suffering a normal damage roll, a non-incorporeal model Force Hammer hits is slammed d6" directly away from the spell’s point of origin and suffers a POW 12 damage roll. Collateral damage from this slam is POW 12.

name: Polarity Shield
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Polarity Field. (A model with Polarity Field cannot be targeted by a charge or slam power attack made by a construct model.)

name: Telekinesis
description: Place target friendly model completely within 2" of its current location. A model can be placed by Telekinesis only once per turn.

name: Storm Rager
description: Target friendly Faction warrior model gains +2 MAT and ARM and +2 on melee attack damage rolls and cannot be targeted by combined ranged attacks or combined melee attacks.

name: Onslaught
description: The spellcaster and friendly Faction models beginning their activations in its control range gain Relentless Charge for one turn. (While advancing as part of a charge, a model with Relentless Charge gains Pathfinder.)

name: Perdition
description: When an enemy model is damaged by Perdition, immediately after the attack is resolved the spellcaster or one model in its battlegroup that is currently in its control range can advance up to 5" directly toward the nearest enemy model. A model can advance as a result of Perdition only once per turn.

name: Rough Seas
description: When a friendly model in the spellcaster’s control range is targeted with a ranged attack, the attacking model rolls an additional die on its attack roll. Discard the highest die of each roll. Rough Seas lasts for one round.

name: Attractor
description: Enemy models currently within 2" of the spellcaster are immediately pushed 2" directly toward it in the order you choose.

name: Censure
description: Enemy upkeep spells in the spellcaster’s control range immediately expire. A model can keep any of its upkeep spells in play by suffering d3 damage points per spell. Roll a separate d3 for each spell. This damage cannot be transferred or reduced by spending focus points. Remove one damage point from the spellcaster for each damage point caused by Censure. Censure can be cast only one per activation.

name: Curse of Shadows
description: Target model/unit suffers –2 ARM. A model can advance through an affected model if it has enough movement to move completely past its base.

name: Hellmouth
description: On a direct hit, before making the damage roll, push models within 2" of the model directly hit 2" directly toward it in the order you choose. Models boxed by Hellmouth are removed from play.

name: Teleport
description: Place the spellcaster anywhere completely within 6" of its current location, then its activation ends.

name: Tether
description: Immediately after the spellcaster ends its Normal Movement, target cohort in its battlegroup can advance up to 3" directly toward it.

name: Hellfire
description: Models disabled by Hellfire cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by Hellfire are removed from play.

name: Occultation
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Stealth.

name: Repulsion
description: Enemy models currently within 2" of the spellcaster are immediately pushed 3" directly away from it in the order you choose.

name: Deathbringers
description: While within the spellcaster’s control range, the melee weapons of models in its battlegroup gain Grievous Wounds. Deathbringers lasts for one turn. (A model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)

name: Caustic Mist
description: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. A model entering or ending its activation in the template suffers the Corrosion continuous effect.

name: Bond of Gristle & Bone
description: Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit gains +2 ARM and Feign Death. (A model with Feign Death cannot be targeted by ranged or magic attacks while knocked down.)

name: Carnage
description: Friendly Faction models gain +2 to melee attack rolls against enemy models in the spellcaster’s control range. Carnage lasts for one turn.

name: Fury’s Strength
description: Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls for one turn.

name: Gallows
description: When an enemy model is hit by this attack, it can be pushed d6" directly toward Gallows’ point of origin.

name: Hex Blast
description: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on the model/unit directly hit by Hex Blast immediately expire.

name: Disintegration
description: The model hit suffers –2 ARM for one round. A model boxed by Disintegration is removed from play.

name: Impending Doom
description: Enemy models within 5" of the spellcaster are pushed 5" directly toward it in the order you choose.

name: Affliction
description: Target model/unit suffers –2 DEF. When a damage roll resulting from a direct hit fails to exceed the ARM of an affected model, the model suffers 1 damage point.

name: Well of Secrets
description: Enemy upkeep spells on the spellcaster immediately expire. Additionally, the spellcaster gains Sacred Ward for one round. (A model with Sacred Ward cannot be targeted by enemy spells.)

name: Lightning Strike
description: The spellcaster gains Sprint. Lightning Strike lasts for one turn. (At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, a model with Sprint can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.)

name: Boundless Charge
description: During its activation, target friendly Faction model can charge without spending focus or being forced and gains +2 SPD and Pathfinder when it charges. Boundless Charge lasts for one turn.

name: Bulwark
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range and B2B with one or more models in its battlegroup, models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gain +2 DEF and cannot become knocked down.

name: Cleansing Fire
description: Cleansing Fire causes fire damage. On a critical hit, models hit suffer the Fire continuous effect.

name: Deceleration
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 ARM against ranged and arcane attack damage rolls. Deceleration lasts for one round.

name: Hallowed Avenger
description: Target friendly Faction Cohort model gains Righteous Vengeance. (If one or more friendly Faction warrior models were destroyed or removed from play by enemy attacks while within 5" of a model with Righteous Vengeance during the last round, during your Maintenance Phase the model with Righteous Vengeance can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.)

name: Scuttler
description: The spellcaster gains Dig In. (A model with Dig In gains cover, gains Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged.)

name: Acidic Touch
description: The spellcaster gains Resistance: Corrosion and its melee weapons gain the Continuous Effect: Corrosion. Acidic Touch lasts for one round.

name: Swarm
description: The spellcaster gains concealment. Living enemy models suffer –2 to attack rolls while within 2" of the spellcaster. Swarm lasts for one round.

name: Draconic Aura
description: When an enemy model suffers a fire damage roll while within 10" of the spellcaster, add +2 to the roll. Fire continuous effects affecting enemy models within 10" of the spellcaster cannot expire. Draconic Aura lasts for one round.

name: Jackhammer
description: Target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup currently in its control range immediately makes one basic melee attack.

name: The Lash
description: When The Lash damages an enemy model, immediately after the attack is resolved this model or a friendly Faction model within 3" of it can advance up to 2". A model can advance only once per turn as a result of The Lash.

name: Quicken
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 SPD and DEF against ranged and magic attack rolls.

name: Arcane Propulsion
description: Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 SPD, +2 DEF, and Flight.

name: Bladed Gale
description: Models hit lose Flight for one round.

name: Hand of Destruction
description: Friendly models in this model’s battlegroup gain an additional die on attack and damage rolls against target model/unit. Discard the lowest die in each roll.

name: Spirit Door
description: Choose a model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range. Immediately place that model completely within 2" of the spellcaster. If the chosen model is the spellcaster, immediately place it completely within 2" of another model in its battlegroup that was in its control range at the time the spell was cast. A model cannot advance or attack after being placed by Spirit Door this turn.

name: Admonition
description: When an enemy model advances and ends its movement or is placed within 6" of target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup, the affected model can immediately advance up to 3", then Admonition expires.

name: Hunting Howls
description: Enemy models lose Stealth while within 5" of the spellcaster. Hunting Howls lasts for one turn.

name: Chain Lightning
description: A model hit by Chain Lightning suffers a POW 10 electrical damage roll, and lightning arcs from that model to d3 consecutive additional models. The lightning arcs to the nearest model it has not already arced to within 3" of the last model it arced to, ignoring this model. Each model the lightning arcs to suffers a POW 10 electrical damage roll. Lightning arc damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Resolve lightning arc damage rolls simultaneously with the damage from the attack that caused the leap.

name: Electrify
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls, Resistance: Electricity, and Repulsor Field. (When a model model with Repulsor Field is hit with a melee attack, after the attack is resolved the attacking model is pushed 1" directly away from that model.)

name: Force Field
description: The spellcaster cannot become knocked down. While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain Resistance: Blast and do not suffer collateral damage.

name: Fail-Safe
description: Target friendly Faction warjack gains +2 ARM and does not suffer the effects of crippled systems.

name: Locomotion
description: The spellcaster spends up to 3 focus points to cast Locomotion. Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup immediately advances up to 1" for each focus point spent. A Cohort model can be targeted by Locomotion only once per activation.

name: Watcher
description: Once per turn when an enemy model advances and ends its movement within 6" of the spellcaster, you can choose a Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range. That Cohort model can immediately make a full advance toward the enemy model and then can make one basic attack targeting the enemy model.

name: Artifice of Deviation
description: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. While in the template, friendly Faction models gain cover. Enemy models treat the template as rough terrain.

name: Blood of Liberty
description: While in the spellcaster's control range, friendly Llaelese models gain Tough and +2 ARM.

name: Chosen Ground
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Pathfinder and cannot become knocked down.

name: Distraction
description: Target warrior model/unit cannot make ranged attacks and suffers –2 DEF and MAT for one round.

name: Cloak of Ash
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Ashen Veil. (A model with Ashen Veil has concealment. Living enemy models without Resistance: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls while within 2" of a model with Ashen Veil.)

name: Inviolable Resolve
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM and cannot be knocked down or moved by a push or a slam.

name: Last Stand
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains an additional die on its melee attack and melee damage rolls. If an affected model makes a melee attack, it is destroyed at the end of the turn.

name: Lock the Target
description: A model damaged by Lock the Target cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks for one round.

name: Aerogenesis
description: The spellcaster and friendly Faction warrior models/units beginning their activations in its control range gain +2 SPD and Flight during their activations. Aerogenesis lasts for one turn.

name: Arcane Might
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction non-Leader warrior models can spend 1 focus or fury point on the spellcaster to boost a melee attack or melee damage roll during their activations.

name: Ignite
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to melee attack damage rolls. Affected models gain Critical Fire on their melee attacks.

name: Purification
description: Continuous effects, animi, and upkeep spells in the spellcaster’s control range immediately expire.

name: Stygian Abyss
description: On a critical hit, the model hit suffers Blind for one round. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or arcane attacks, suffers –4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)

name: Iron Flesh
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM and Resistance: Blast.

name: Engine of Destruction
description: The spellcaster gains +2 SPD and +4 MAT and +4 to its melee damage rolls for one turn.

name: Redline
description: Target warjack in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 SPD and can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without spending focus. Additionally, the affected model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and collateral damage rolls. At the end of each of its activations, the affected warjack suffers d3 damage points.

name: Road to War
description: When a friendly Faction model in the spellcaster’s control range destroys one or more enemy models with a melee or ranged attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved one Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range can advance up to 3". A model can advance as a result of Road to War only once per turn.

name: Sentry
description: Target friendly Faction model gains Rapid Fire. (A model with Rapid Fire can make one basic ranged attack during your Maintenance Phase.)

name: Battering Ram
description: An enemy model hit by Battering Ram can be pushed 3" directly away from the spell’s point of origin.

name: Razor Wall
description: Place a wall template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range where it does not touch a model’s base, an obstruction, or an obstacle. When a model enters or ends its activation in the wall template, it suffers 1 damage point.

name: Unstoppable Force
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Bulldoze. Unstoppable Force lasts for one turn. (When a model with Bulldoze is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when a model makes a trample power attack.)
